8.67.d: तयान नु कषत्रियानव आदित्यान याचिषामहे | सुम्र्ळीकानभिष्टये ||
8.67.e: We solicit for protection those kṣatriyas, the Ādityas who bless (their votaries) abundantly to theattainment of their desires.

8.67.d: मित्रो नो अत्यंहतिं वरुणः पर्षदर्यमा | आदित्यासो यथा विदुः ||
8.67.e: May the Ādityas, Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, bear us across our distress, as they know it well.

8.67.d: तेषां हि चित्रमुक्थ्यं वरूथमस्ति दाशुषे | आदित्यानामरंक्र्ते ||
8.67.e: To those Ādityas belongs wonderful wealth, worthy of all praise, (laid up) for the offerer of oblationsand the sacrificer.

8.67.d: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्रार्यमन | अवांस्या वर्णीमहे ||
8.67.e: You are great, Varuṇa, Mitra and Aryaman, and great is your protection; your protections we implore.

8.67.d: जीवान नो अभि धेतनादित्यासः पुरा हथात | कद ध सथहवनश्रुतः ||
8.67.e: Ādityas, hasten to us before our death, while we are yet alive; where are you, hearers of prayer?

8.67.d: यद वः शरान्ताय सुन्वते वरूथमस्ति यच्छर्दिः | तेना नो अधि वोचत ||
8.67.e: Whatever wealh, whatever dwelling is yours (to give) to the wearied offerer of libations-- with thesespeak to us a kindly answer.

8.67.d: अस्ति देवा अंहोरुर्वस्ति रत्नमनागसः | आदित्या अद्भुतैनसः ||
8.67.e: Great, O deities, is (the guild) of the sinner, but to the sinless is happiness; Ādityas, you are void of sin.

8.67.d: मा नः सेतुः सिषेदयं महे वर्णक्तु नस परि | इन्द्र इद धि शरुतो वशी ||
8.67.e: Let not the snare bind us; may Indra, the renowned, the subduer of all, deliver us for a glorious act.

8.67.d: मा नो मर्चा रिपूणां वर्जिनानामविष्यवः | देवा अभि पर मर्क्षत ||
8.67.e: O deities, ready to protect, move us not with the destructive net of our wicked enemieṣ

8.67.d: उत तवामदिते मह्यहं देव्युप बरुवे | सुम्र्ळीकामभिष्टये ||
8.67.e: I address you, who give abundant delight, the great goddess, Aditi, for the attainment of my desire.

8.67.d: पर्षि दीने गभीर आनुग्रपुत्रे जिघांसतः | माकिस्तोकस्य नो रिषत ||
8.67.e: You protect on every side; let not (the net) of the destroyer hurt our children, in this shallow water full ofmighhty offspring.

8.67.d: अनेहो न उरुव्रज उरूचि वि परसर्तवे | कर्धि तोकाय जीवसे ||
8.67.e: Wide-traversing, far-reaching goddess, put forth your power to come to us, innocent ones, that ourchildren may live.

8.67.d: ये मूर्धानः कषितीनामदब्धासः सवयशसः | वरता रक्षन्ते अद्रुहः ||
8.67.e: You who are the heads of men, unharming, and of self-sustained glory, who, benevolent ones, protectour rites.

8.67.d: ते न आस्नो वर्काणामादित्यासो मुमोचत | सतेनं बद्धमिवादिते ||
8.67.e: Ādityas, deliver us from the jaws of the destroyers like a bound thief; O Aditi, (deliver us).

8.67.d: अपो षु ण इयं शरुरादित्या अप दुर्मतिः | अस्मदेत्वजघ्नुषी ||
8.67.e: Ādityas, let this net, let the malevolent design turn away from us innocuous

8.67.d: शश्वद धि वः सुदानव आदित्या ऊतिभिर्वयम | पुरा नूनं बुभुज्महे ||
8.67.e: Bounteous Ādityas, by your protections we have continually possessed enjoyments from of old.

8.67.d: शश्वन्तं हि परचेतसः परतियन्तं चिदेनसः | देवाः कर्णुथ जीवसे ||
8.67.e: Wise deities, keep away from us, that we may live, the many doers of sin who come against us.

8.67.d: तत सु नो नव्यं सन्यस आदित्या यन मुमोचति | बन्धाद बद्धमिवादिते ||
8.67.e: Ādityas and Aditi, let that which releases us as a prisoner from his bond, be ever the object of ourpraise and worship.

8.67.d: नास्माकमस्ति तत तर आदित्यासो अतिष्कदे | यूयमस्मभ्यं मर्ळत ||
8.67.e: Not to us is there strength enough to burst from this (net); O Ādityas, do you grant us your favour.

8.67.d: मा नो हेतिर्विवस्वत आदित्याः कर्त्रिमा शरुः | पुरा नुजरसो वधीत ||
8.67.e: Let not this weapon of Vivasvat, this net made with hands, Ādityas, destroy us before old age.

8.67.d: वि षु दवेषो वयंहतिमादित्यासो वि संहितम | विष्वग वि वर्हता रपः ||
8.67.e: Let not this weapon of Vivasvat, this net made with hands, Ādityas, destroy us before old age.

8.81.d: आ तू न इन्द्र कषुमन्तं चित्रं गराभं सं गर्भाय | महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ||
8.81.e: INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice,  All-conquering Śatakratu, most munificent of all who live.

8.81.d: विद्मा हि तवा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम | तुविमात्रमवोभिः ||
8.81.e: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old:  His name is Indra, tell it forth.

8.81.d: नहि तवा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम | भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ||
8.81.e: Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength:  May he, the mighty, bring it near.

8.81.d: एतो नविन्द्रं सतवामेशानं वस्वः सवराजम | न राधसा मर्धिषन नः ||
8.81.e: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught,  The Soma juice with barley mixt.

8.81.d: पर सतोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत साम गीयमानम | अभि राधसा जुगुरत ||
8.81.e: Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice.  For this is what augments his stiength.

8.81.d: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन पर मर्श | इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक ||
8.81.e: When he hath drqnk its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God  Hath far surpassed all things that are.

8.81.d: उप करमस्वा भर धर्षता धर्ष्णो जनानाम | अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ||
8.81.e: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours,  Him who is drawn to all our songs

8.81.d: इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः | अस्माभिःसु तं सनुहि ||
8.81.e: The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne’er o’erthrown,  The Chieftain of resistless might.

8.81.d: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः | वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते ||
8.81.e: O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise:  Help us in the decisive fray.

8.82.d: आ पर दरव परावतो.अर्वावतश्च वर्त्रहन | मध्वः परतिप्रभर्मणि ||
8.82.e: SURYA, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth,  Who hurls the bolt and works for man

8.82.d: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः | पिबा दध्र्ग यथोचिषे ||
8.82.e: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down,  Slew Vṛtra and smote Ahi dead.

8.82.d: इषा मन्दस्वादु ते.अरं वराय मन्यवे | भुवत त इन्द्र शं हर्दे ||
8.82.e: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream  Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

8.82.d: आ तवशत्रवा गहि नयुक्थानि च हूयसे | उपमे रोचने दिवः ||
8.82.e: Whatever, Vṛtra-slayer! thou, Sūrya, hast risen upon to-day,  Tbat, Indra, all is in thy power.

8.82.d: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः शरीतो मदाय कम | पर सोम इन्द्र हूयते ||
8.82.e: When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die,  That thought of thine is true indeed.

8.82.d: इन्द्र शरुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः | वि पीतिन्त्र्प्तिमश्नुहि ||
8.82.e: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee,  Both far away and near at hand.

8.82.d: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः | पिबेदस्य तवमीशिषे ||
8.82.e: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vṛtra dead:  A vigorous Hero shall he be.

8.82.d: यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु दद्र्शे | पिबेदस्य तवमीशिषे ||
8.82.e: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o’er the joyous draught.  Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

8.82.d: यं ते शयेनः पदाभरत तिरो रजांस्यस्प्र्तम | पिबेदस्य तवमीशिषे ||
8.82.e: By song as ’twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared  Lofty, invincible he grew.

8.83.d: देवानामिदवो महत तदा वर्णीमहे वयम | वर्ष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ||
8.83.e: THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk:  Both horses of the cars are yoked,—

8.83.d: ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा | वर्धासश्च परचेतसः ||
8.83.e: She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see,  Maintain their everlasting Laws.

8.83.d: अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ | यूयं रतस्यरथ्यः ||
8.83.e: This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore:  The Maruts to the Soma-draught

8.83.d: वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन वामं वरुण शंस्यम | वामं हयाव्र्णीमहे ||
8.83.e: Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this  Self-luminous the Aśvins drink.

8.83.d: वामस्य हि परचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः | नेमादित्या अघस्य यत ||
8.83.e: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant,  Drink Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.

8.83.d: वयमिद वः सुदानवः कषियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना | देवा वर्धाय हूमहे ||
8.83.e: And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice,  At early morn will quaff thereof.

8.83.d: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम | इता मरुतो अश्विना ||
8.83.e: When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'?  When hasten they whose might ispure?

8.83.d: पर भरात्र्त्वं सुदानवो.अध दविता समान्या | मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे ||
8.83.e: What favour do I claim this day of you  great Deities, you who are  Wondrously splendid in yourselves?

8.83.d: यूयं हि षठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः | अधाचिद व उत बरुवे ||
8.83.e: 1 call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth  And luminous regions of the sky.

8.84.d: परेष्ठं वो अतिथिं सतुषे मित्रमिव परियम | अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम ||
8.84.e: SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows.  O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.

8.84.d: कविमिव परचेतसं यं देवासो अध दविता | नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ||
8.84.e: Bright juices bitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song.  Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house ’tis set for thee.

8.84.d: तवं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄन पाहि शर्णुधी गिरः | रक्षा तोकमुत तमना ||
8.84.e: Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought:  For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.

8.84.d: कया ते अग्ने अङगिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम | वराय देव मन्यवे ||
8.84.e: O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee.  Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.

8.84.d: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो | कदु वोच इदंनमः ||
8.84.e: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song,  A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.

8.84.d: अधा तवं हि नस करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः | वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ||
8.84.e: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified.  Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.

8.84.d: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते | गोषाता यस्यते गिरः ||
8.84.e: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sāma hymns.  Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.

8.84.d: तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु | सवेषु कषयेषुवाजिनम ||
8.84.e: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself.  Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.

8.84.d: कषेति कषेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घनन्ति हन्ति यः | अग्ने सुवीर एधते ||
8.84.e: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper.  Pure, thou dost strike the Vṛtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.

8.85.d: आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गछतं युवम | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra.  For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.

8.85.d: इमं मे सतोममश्विनेमं मे शर्णुतं हवम | मध्वः सोमस्यपीतये ||
8.85.e: The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains.  Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.

8.85.d: अयं वां कर्ष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra.  His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.

8.85.d: शर्णुतं जरितुर्हवं कर्ष्णस्य सतुवतो नरा | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: 1 count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne’er been shaken.  I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.

8.85.d: छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय सतुवते नरा | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon,  The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.

8.85.d: गछतं दाशुषो गर्हमित्था सतुवतो अश्विना | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being.  May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.

8.85.d: युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङगे वर्षण्वसू | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: Flying in terror from the snort of Vṛtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee.  So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.

8.85.d: तरिवन्धुरेण तरिव्र्ता रथेना यातमश्विना | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship.  We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.

8.85.d: नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना परावतं युवम | मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ||
8.85.e: A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder?  Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.

8.86.d: उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः | ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूक्र्थे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम ||
8.86.e: O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras,  Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.

8.86.d: कथा नूनं वां विमना उप सतवद युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यैष्तये | ता वां विश्वको ... ||
8.86.e: The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured,  Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.

8.86.d: युवं हि षमा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यैष्टये | ता वां विश्वको ... ||
8.86.e: The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,—  May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.

8.86.d: उत तयं वीरं धनसां रजीषिणं दूरे चित सन्तमवसे हवामहे | यस्य सवादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम ||
8.86.e: Whether, O Śakra, thou be far, or, Vṛtra-slayer, near at hand,  Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.

8.86.d: रतेन देवः सविता शमायत रतस्य शर्ङगमुर्विया वि पप्रथे | रतं सासाह महि चित पर्तन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम ||
8.86.e: Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea;  Whether, chief Vṛtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.

8.87.d: दयुम्नी वां सतोमो अश्विना करिविर्न सेक आ गतम | मध्वःसुतस्य स दिवि परियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ||
8.87.e: To Indra sing a Sāma hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage,  To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.

8.87.d: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा | ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ||
8.87.e: Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun.  Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.

8.87.d: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः परियमेधा अहूषत | ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वर्क्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ||
8.87.e: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven.  ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.

8.87.d: पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत | ता वाव्र्धाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम ||
8.87.e: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable,  Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.

8.87.d: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः परुषितप्सुभिः | दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस पती पातं सोमं रताव्र्धा ||
8.87.e: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds.  Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.

8.87.d: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये | तावल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना शरुष्ट्या गतम ||
8.87.e: For thou art he, O Indra, wiio stormeth all castles of the foe,  Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.

8.88.d: तं वो दस्मं रतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः | अभि वत्सं न सवसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ||
8.88.e: O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday.  So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwellingplace.

8.88.d: दयुक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिराव्र्तं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम | कषुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ||
8.88.e: Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee.  Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.

8.88.d: न तवा बर्हन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः | यद दित्ससि सतुवते मावते वसु नकिष टदा मिनाति ते ||
8.88.e: Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things.  When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

8.88.d: योद्धासि करत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना | आ तवायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन ||
8.88.e: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants.  He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.

8.88.d: पर हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस परि | न तवा विव्याचरज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु सवधां ववक्षिथ ||
8.88.e: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands.  Father art thou, aIl-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.

8.88.d: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन मघस्य ते यद दाशुषे दशस्यसि | अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ||
8.88.e: The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows.  When thou attackest Vṛtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.

8.89.d: बर्हदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वर्त्रहन्तमम | येन जयोतिरजनयन्न्र्ताव्र्धो देवं देवाय जाग्र्वि ||
8.89.e: I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me.  When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions.

8.89.d: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो दयुम्न्याभवत | देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बर्हद्भानो मरुद्गण ||
8.89.e: The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed.  Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman.

8.89.d: पर व इन्द्राय बर्हते मरुतो बरह्मार्चत | वर्त्रं हनति वर्त्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ||
8.89.e: Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth.  One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour?

8.89.d: अभि पर भर धर्षता धर्षन्मनः शरवश्चित ते असद बर्हत | अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वर्त्रं जया सवः ||
8.89.e: Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth 1 surpass in greatness.  The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder.

8.89.d: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन वर्त्रहत्याय | तत पर्थिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत दयाम ||
8.89.e: When the Law's lovers mounted and ap. proached me as 1 sate lone upon the dear sky's summit.  Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children.

8.89.d: तत ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्क्र्तिः | तद विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम ||
8.89.e: All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice,  When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarablia, the Ṛṣi's kin.

8.89.d: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि | घर्मं न सामन तपता सुव्र्क्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बर्हत ||
8.89.e: Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back.  For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vṛtra's vital part?

8.90.d: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु | उप बरह्माणि सवनानि वर्त्रहा परमज्या रचीषमः ||
8.90.e: YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods,  Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuṇa. to share his sacrificial gifts.

8.90.d: तवं दाता परथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानक्र्त | तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वर्णीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ||
8.90.e: Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away,  Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Sūrya's beams.

8.90.d: बरह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः करियन्ते अनतिद्भुता | इमा जुषस्वहर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि ||
8.90.e: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuṇa, with iron head, swift to the draught,

8.90.d: तवं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वर्त्रा भूरि नय्र्ञ्जसे | सत्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषे.अर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कर्धि ||
8.90.e: He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,—  From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.

8.90.d: तवमिन्द्र यशा अस्य रजीषी शवसस पते | तवं वर्त्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीध्र्ता ||
8.90.e: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one,  A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuṇa: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.

8.90.d: तमु तवा नूनमसुर परचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे | महीव कर्त्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र पर ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन ||
8.90.e: The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three.  They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.

8.91.d: कन्या वारवायती सोममपि सरुताविदत | अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै तवा शक्राय सुनवै तवा ||
8.91.e: LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God,  Thou givest to thy worshipper.

8.91.d: असौ य एषि वीरको गर्हं-गर्हं विचाकशद | इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम ||
8.91.e: So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light,  Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.

8.91.d: आ चन तवा चिकित्सामो.अधि चन तवा नेमसि | शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि सरव ||
8.91.e: For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally,  We overcome, to win the spoil.

8.91.d: कुविच्छकत कुवित करत कुविन नो वस्यसस करत | कुवित पतिद्विषो यतीरिन्द्रेण संगमामहै ||
8.91.e: As Aurva Bhṛgu used, as Apnavāna used, I call the pure  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.91.d: इमानि तरीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय | शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ||
8.91.e: 1 call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars,  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.91.d: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं मम | अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कर्धि ||
8.91.e: As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.91.d: खे रथस्य खे.अनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो | अपालामिन्द्रत्रिष पूत्व्यक्र्णोः सूर्यत्वचम ||
8.91.e: Hither, for powerful kirship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you,  Most frequent at our solemn rites

8.95.d: आ तवा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः | अभि तवा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ||
8.95.e: As with Manu Samvarani, Indra, thou drankest Soma juice,  And, Maghavan, with Nipatithi, Medbyatithi, with Pustigu and Srustigu,—

8.95.d: आ तवा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः | पिबा तवस्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम ||
8.95.e: T'he son of Prsadvana was Praskaniva's host, who lay decrepit and forlorn.  Aided by thee the Ṛṣi Dasyave-vrka strove to obtain thousands of kine.

8.95.d: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र शयेनाभ्र्तं सुतम | तवं हिशश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ||
8.95.e: Call hither with thy newest song Indra who lacks not hymns of praise,  Him who observes and knows, inspirer of the sage, him who seems eager to enjoy.

8.95.d: शरुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति | सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस पूर्धि महानसि ||
8.95.e: He unto whom they sang the seven-headed hymn, three-parted, in the loftiest place,  He sent his thunder down on all these living things, and so displayed heroic might.

8.95.d: इन्द्र यस्ते नवायसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत | चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं परत्नां रतस्य पिप्युषीम ||
8.95.e: We invocate that Indra who bestoweth precious things on us.  Now do we know his newest favour; may we gain a stable that is full of kine.

8.95.d: तमु षटवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वाव्र्धुः | पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ||
8.95.e: He whom thou aidest, gracious Lord, to give again, obtains great wealth to nourish him.  We with our Soma ready, Lover of the Song! call, Indra Maghavan, on thee.

8.95.d: एतो नविन्द्रं सतवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना | शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वाव्र्ध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान ममत्तु ||
8.95.e: Ne’er art thou fruitless, Indra ne’er dost thou desert the worshipper  But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.

8.95.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः | शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ||
8.95.e: He who hath. overtaken Krvi with his might, and silenced Śuṣṇa with deathbolts,—  When he supported yonder heaven and spread it out, then first the son of earth was born.

8.95.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे | शुद्धो वर्त्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ||
8.95.e: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Āryas, Dāsas here belong.  Directly unto thee, the pious Ruśama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

9.1.d: सवादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया | इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ||
9.1.e: In sweetest and most gladdening stream  flow pure, O Soma, on thy way,  Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.
Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto  His place, his iron-fashioned home.

9.1.d: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वर्त्रहन्तमः | पर्षि राधोमघोनाम ||
9.1.e: Be thou best Vṛtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal:  Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.

9.1.d: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा | अभि वाजमुत शरवः ||
9.1.e: Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods:  Flow hither for our strength and fame.

9.1.d: तवामछा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवे-दिवे | इन्दो तवे न आशसः ||
9.1.e: O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day:  To thee alone our prayers are said

9.1.d: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता | वारेण शश्वता तना ||
9.1.e: By means of this eternal fleece may Sūrya's Daughter purify  Thy Soma that is foaming forth.

9.1.d: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गर्भ्णन्ति योषणो दश | सवसारः पार्ये दिवि ||
9.1.e: Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold  Him firmly on the final day.

9.1.d: तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दर्तिम | तरिधातु वारणं मधु ||
9.1.e: The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse  The triple foe-repelling meath.

9.1.d: अभीममघ्न्या उत शरीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम | सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ||
9.1.e: Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink,  The fresh young Soma with their milk.

9.1.d: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वर्त्राणि जिघ्नते | शूरो मघा च मंहते ||
9.1.e: In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vṛtras: he,  The Hero, pours his wealth on us.

9.2.d: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या | इन्द्रमिन्दो वर्षा विश ||
9.2.e: Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth:  Pass into Indra, as a Bull.

9.2.d: आ वच्यस्व महि पसरो वर्षेन्दो दयुम्नवत्तमः | आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ||
9.2.e: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer:  Sit in thy place as one with strength.

9.2.d: अधुक्षत परियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः | अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ||
9.2.e: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice  ne Sage drew waters to himself.

9.2.d: महान्तं तवा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः | यद गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ||
9.2.e: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One,  When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

9.2.d: समुद्रो अप्सु माम्र्जे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः | सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ||
9.2.e: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay,  Falls on the purifying cloth.

9.2.d: अचिक्रदद वर्षा हरिर्महान मित्रो न दर्शतः | सं सूर्येण रोचते ||
9.2.e: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold:  He shines together with the Sun.

9.2.d: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्म्र्ज्यन्ते अपस्युवः | याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ||
9.2.e: Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith  Thou deckest thee for our delight.

9.2.d: तं तवा मदाय घर्ष्वय उ लोकक्र्त्नुमीमहे | तव परशस्तयो महीः ||
9.2.e: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught:  Great are the praise& due to thee.
Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like  Parjanya sender of the rain.

9.2.d: गोषा इन्दो नर्षा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत | आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ||
9.2.e: Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength  Primeval Soul of sacrifice.

9.3.d: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति | अभि दरोणान्यासदम ||
9.3.e: HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings,  To settle in the vats of wood.

9.3.d: एष देवो विपा कर्तो.अति हवरांसि धावति | पवमानो अदाभ्यः ||
9.3.e: This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways,  Inviolable as he flows.

9.3.d: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान रतायुभिः | हरिर्वाजाय मर्ज्यते ||
9.3.e: This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men  Devout and skilled in holy songs.

9.3.d: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः | पवमानःसिषासति ||
9.3.e: He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along  Is fain to win all precious boons.

9.3.d: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति | आविष कर्णोति वग्वनुम ||
9.3.e: This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts:  He lets his voice be heard of all

9.3.d: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतो.अपो देवो वि गाहते | दधद रत्नानिदाशुषे ||
9.3.e: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows  Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

9.3.d: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया | पवमानःकनिक्रदत ||
9.3.e: Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven,  And roars as he is flowing on.

9.3.d: एष दिवं वयासरत तिरो रजाण्स्यस्प्र्तः | पवमानः सवध्वरः ||
9.3.e: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across  The regions, irresistible.

9.3.d: एष परत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः | हरिः पवित्रेर्षति ||
9.3.e: After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities,  Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

9.3.d: एष उ सय पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः | धारया पवते सुतः ||
9.3.e: This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength,  Effused, flows onward in a stream.

9.4.d: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि शरवः | अथा नो वस्यसस कर्धि ||
9.4.e: O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: सना जयोतिः सना सवर्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा | अथा ... ||
9.4.e: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: सना दक्षमुत करतुमप सोम मर्धो जहि | अथा ... ||
9.4.e: Win skilful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes;  And make us better than we are.
Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink:  Make thou us better than we are.

9.4.d: तवं सूर्ये न आ भज तव करत्वा तवोतिभिः | अथा ... ||
9.4.e: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: तव करत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक पश्येम सूर्यम | अथा ... ||
9.4.e: Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun;  Make thou us better than we are.

9.4.d: अभ्यर्ष सवायुध सोम दविबर्हसं रयिम | अथा ... ||
9.4.e: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to usa stream of riches doubly great;  And make us better than we are.
As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us;  And make us better than we are.
By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law:  Make thou us better than we are.
O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life;  And mate us better than we are.

9.5.d: समिद्धो विश्वतस पतिः पवमानो वि राजति | परीणन वर्षा कनिक्रदत ||
9.5.e: ENKINDLED, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side  In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.

9.5.d: तनूनपात पवमानः शर्ङगे शिशानो अर्षति | अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत ||
9.5.e: He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns:  He glitters through the firmament.

9.5.d: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति दयुमान | मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ||
9.5.e: Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines,  Mightily with the streams of meath.

9.5.d: बर्हिः पराचीनमोजसा पवमान सत्र्णन हरिः | देवेषु देव ईयते ||
9.5.e: The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might,  Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.

9.5.d: उदातैर्जिहते बर्हद दवारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः | पवमानेन सुष्टुताः ||
9.5.e: The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high,  By Pavamana glorified.

9.5.d: सुशिल्पे बर्हती मही पवमानो वर्षण्यति | नक्तोषासा नदर्शते ||
9.5.e: With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed  Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn

9.5.d: उभा देवा नर्चक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे | पवमान इन्द्रोव्र्षा ||
9.5.e: Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self  Is Pavamana, yea, the Bull.

9.5.d: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही | इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ||
9.5.e: This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses,  Sarasvatī and Bhāratī and Iḷā, Mighty One, attend.

9.5.d: तवष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे | इन्दुरिन्द्रो वर्षा हरिः पवमानः परजापतिः ||
9.5.e: 1 summon Tvaṣṭar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born,  Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajāpati.

9.5.d: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङगधि धारया | सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भराजमानं हिरण्ययम ||
9.5.e: O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati,  The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.

9.5.d: विश्वे देवाः सवाहाक्र्तिं पवमानस्या गत | वायुर्ब्र्हस्पतिः सूर्यो.अग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः ||
9.5.e: Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,—  Vāyu, Sūrya, Bṛhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.

9.6.d: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वर्षा पवस्व देवयुः | अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ||
9.6.e: SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods,  Our Friend, unto the woollen sieve.

9.6.d: अभि तयं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति कषर | अभि वाजिनोर्वतः ||
9.6.e: Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine,  And send us coursers full of strength.

9.6.d: अभि तयं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ | अभि वाजमुत शरवः ||
9.6.e: Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice,  Streaming forth power and high renown.

9.6.d: अनु दरप्सास इन्दव आपो न परवतासरन | पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ||
9.6.e: Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent  They have reached Indra purified.

9.6.d: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मर्जन्ति योषणो दश | वने करीळन्तमत्यविम ||
9.6.e: Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as ’twere a vigorous steed,  While he disports him in the wood,—

9.6.d: तं गोभिर्व्र्षणं रसं मदाय देववीतये | सुतं भराय सं सर्ज ||
9.6.e: The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods,  To him who bears away the draught.

9.6.d: देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः | पयो यदस्य पीपयत ||
9.6.e: Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God,  So that his milk may strengthen him.

9.6.d: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः | परत्नंनि पाति काव्यम ||
9.6.e: Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps  His ancient wisdom of a Sage.

9.6.d: एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये | गुहा चिद दधिषे गिरः ||
9.6.e: So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast,  Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.

9.7.d: अस्र्ग्रम इन्दवः पथा धर्मन्न रतस्य सुश्रियः | विदाना अस्य योजनम ||
9.7.e: FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law,  Knowing this sacrifice's course.

9.7.d: पर धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीर अपो वि गाहते | हविर हविष्षु वन्द्यः ||
9.7.e: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent,  Oblation best of all in worth.

9.7.d: पर युजो वाचो अग्रियो वर्षाव चक्रदद वने | सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ||
9.7.e: About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth  Continuous voices in the wood.

9.7.d: परि यत काव्या कविर नर्म्णा वसानो अर्षति | सवर वाजी सिषासति ||
9.7.e: When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round,  The Strong would win the light of heaven.

9.7.d: पवमानो अभि सप्र्धो विशो राजेव सीदति | यद ईम रण्वन्ति वेधसः ||
9.7.e: When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk,  What time the sages bring him nigh.

9.7.d: अव्यो वारे परि परियो हरिर वनेषु सीदति | रेभो वनुष्यते मती ||
9.7.e: Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood:  The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.

9.7.d: स वायुम इन्द्रम अश्विना साकम मदेन गछति | रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ||
9.7.e: He goes to Indra, Vāyu, to the Aśvins, as his custom is,  With gladdening juice which gives them joy.

9.7.d: आ मित्रावरुणा भगम मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः | विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ||
9.7.e: Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuṇa,—  Well-knowing through his mighty powers.

9.7.d: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिम मध्वो वाजस्य सातये | शरवो वसूनि सं जितम ||
9.7.e: Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth:  Gain for us treasures and renown.

9.8.d: एते सोमा अभि परियम इन्द्रस्य कामम अक्षरन | वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम ||
9.8.e: OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth,  Increasing his heroic might.

9.8.d: पुनानासश चमूषदो गछन्तो वायुम अश्विना | ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम ||
9.8.e: Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vāyu and the Aśvins, may  These give us great heroic strength.

9.8.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय | रतस्य योनिम आसदम ||
9.8.e: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart,  To sit in place of sacrifice.

9.8.d: मर्जन्ति तवा दश कषिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः | अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ||
9.8.e: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on:  The sages have rejoiced in thee.

9.8.d: देवेभ्यस तवा मदाय कं सर्जानम अति मेष्यः | सं गोभिर वासयामसि ||
9.8.e: When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk  To be a gladdening draught for Gods.

9.8.d: पुनानः कलशेष्व आ वस्त्राण्य अरुषो हरिः | परि गव्यान्य अव्यत ||
9.8.e: When purified within the jars, Soma, brightred and golden-hued,  Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.

9.8.d: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप दविषः | इन्दो सखायम आ विश ||
9.8.e: Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away.  O Indu, flow into thy Friend.

9.8.d: वर्ष्टिं दिवः परि सरव दयुम्नम पर्थिव्या अधि | सहो नः सोम पर्त्सु धाः ||
9.8.e: Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us,  O Soma, victory in war.

9.8.d: नर्चक्षसं तवा वयम इन्द्रपीतं सवर्विदम | भक्षीमहि परजाम इषम ||
9.8.e: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light,  Gain thee, and progeny and food.

9.9.d: परि परिया दिवः कविर वयांसि नप्त्य्र हितः | सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ||
9.9.e: THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed,  Sends us delightful powers of life.

9.9.d: पर-पर कषयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे | वीत्य अर्ष चनिष्ठया ||
9.9.e: On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile,  With excellent enjoyment, flow.

9.9.d: स सूनुर मातरा शुचिर जातो जाते अरोचयत | महान मही रताव्र्धा ||
9.9.e: He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life,  Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.

9.9.d: स सप्त धीतिभिर हितो नद्य अजिन्वद अद्रुहः | या एकम अक्षि वाव्र्धुः ||
9.9.e: Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which  Have magnified the Single Eye.

9.9.d: ता अभि सन्तम अस्त्र्तम महे युवानम आ दधुः | इन्दुम इन्द्र तव वरते ||
9.9.e: These helped to might theYouthful One, high over all, invincible,  Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.

9.9.d: अभि वह्निर अमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः | करिविर देवीर अतर्पयत ||
9.9.e: The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount  Hath satisfied the Goddesses

9.9.d: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस तमांसि सोम योध्या | तानि पुनान जघनः ||
9.9.e: Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive away  Dark shades that must be met in fight.

9.9.d: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः | परत्नवद रोचया रुचः ||
9.9.e: Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore:  Make the lights shine as erst they shone.

9.9.d: पवमान महि शरवो गाम अश्वं रासि वीरवत | सना मेधां सना सवः ||
9.9.e: Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons:  Win for us wisdom, win the light.

9.10.d: पर सवानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न शरवस्यवः | सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ||
9.10.e: LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown,  Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.

9.10.d: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः | भरासः कारिणाम इव ||
9.10.e: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed,  Like joyful songs of singing-men.

9.10.d: राजानो न परशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिर अञ्जते | यज्ञो न सप्त धात्र्भिः ||
9.10.e: The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies,  And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

9.10.d: परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा | सुता अर्षन्ति धारया ||
9.10.e: Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song,  The Soma juices in a stream.

9.10.d: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम | सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ||
9.10.e: Winning Vivasvān's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns  Pass through the openings of the cloth.

9.10.d: अप दवारा मतीनाम परत्ना रण्वन्ति कारवः | वर्ष्णो हरस आयवः ||
9.10.e: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,—  Men, for the mighty to accept.

9.10.d: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः | पदम एकस्य पिप्रतः ||
9.10.e: Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood,  Filling the station of the One.

9.10.d: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश चित सूर्ये सचा | कवेर अपत्यम आ दुहे ||
9.10.e: He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye:  The Sage's ofrspring hath appeared.

9.10.d: अभि परिया दिवस पदम अध्वर्युभिर गुहा हितम | सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ||
9.10.e: The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests  Have placed within the sacred cell.

9.11.d: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे | अभि देवां इयक्षते ||
9.11.e: SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified,  Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

9.11.d: अभि ते मधुना पयो ऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः | देवं देवाय देवयु ||
9.11.e: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk,  Divine, devoted to the God.

9.11.d: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शम अर्वते | शं राजन्न ओषधीभ्यः ||
9.11.e: Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds.  Weal, O thou King, to growing plants

9.11.d: बभ्रवे नु सवतवसे ऽरुणाय दिविस्प्र्शे | सोमाय गाथम अर्चत ||
9.11.e: Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might.  The Red, who reaches up to heaven.

9.11.d: हस्तच्युतेभिर अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमम पुनीतन | मधाव आ धावता मधु ||
9.11.e: Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly,  And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

9.11.d: नमसेद उप सीदत दध्नेद अभि शरीणीतन | इन्दुम इन्द्रे दधातन ||
9.11.e: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds:  To Indra offer Indu up.

9.11.d: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे | देवेभ्यो अनुकामक्र्त ||
9.11.e: Soma, foe-que chief o’er men, doing the will of pour forth  Prosperity upon our kine.

9.11.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे | मनश्चिन मनसस पतिः ||
9.11.e: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.

9.11.d: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः | इन्दव इन्द्रेण नो युजा ||
9.11.e: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,—  Indu! with. Indra for ally.

9.12.d: सोमा अस्र्ग्रमिन्दवः सुता रतस्य सादने | इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ||
9.12.e: To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured,  Shed in the seat of sacrifice.

9.12.d: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः | इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ||
9.12.e: As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called,  Called him to drink the Soma juice.

9.12.d: मदच्युत कषेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित | सोमो गौरीधि शरितः ||
9.12.e: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat,  Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.

9.12.d: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणो.अव्यो वारे महीयते | सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ||
9.12.e: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point  Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

9.12.d: यः सोमः कलशेष्वा अन्तः पवित्र आहितः | तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ||
9.12.e: In close embraces Indu holds Soma when  poured within the jars.  And on the. purifying sieve.

9.12.d: पर वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि | जिन्वन कोशं मधुश्चुतम ||
9.12.e: Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air,  Shaking the vase that drops with meath.
The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns,  Urging men's generations on.

9.12.d: अभि परिया दिवस पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति | विप्रस्य धारया कविः ||
9.12.e: The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on  To the dear places of the sky.

9.12.d: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम | अस्मे इन्दो सवाभुवम ||
9.12.e: O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea.  O Indu, give us ready help.

9.13.d: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः | वायोरिन्द्रस्यनिष्क्र्तम ||
9.13.e: PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on  To Indra's, Viyu's special place.

9.13.d: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि पर गायत | सुष्वाणं देववीतये ||
9.13.e: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage,  Effused to entertain the Gods.

9.13.d: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः | गर्णाना देववीतये ||
9.13.e: The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory,  Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

9.13.d: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बर्हतीरिषः | दयुमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम ||
9.13.e: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil  Indu, bring splendid manly might.

9.13.d: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम | सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ||
9.13.e: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,—  These Godlike Soma-drops effused.

9.13.d: अत्या हियाना न हेत्र्भिरस्र्ग्रं वाजसातये | वि वारमव्यमाशवः ||
9.13.e: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory,  Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

9.13.d: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवो.अभि वत्सं न धेनवः | दधन्विरेगभस्त्योः ||
9.13.e: Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves:  They have run forth from both the hands.

9.13.d: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत | विश्वा अप दविषो जहि ||
9.13.e: As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roar  Drive all our enemies away.

9.13.d: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः सवर्द्र्शः | योनाव रतस्य सीदत ||
9.13.e: O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light,  Sit in the place of sacrifice.

9.14.d: परि परासिष्यदत कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि शरितः | कारं बिभ्रत पुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.14.e: REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around,  Bearing the hymn which many love.

9.14.d: गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च वराता अपस्यवः | परिष्क्र्ण्वन्ति धर्णसिम ||
9.14.e: When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song  Establish him, the Powerful,

9.14.d: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत | यदी गोभिर्वसायते ||
9.14.e: Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves,  When he hath clothed him in the milk.

9.14.d: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा | अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ||
9.14.e: Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs,  And meets his own Companion here.

9.14.d: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न माम्र्जे युवा | गाः कर्ण्वानो न निर्णिजम ||
9.14.e: He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned,  Making the milk, as ’twere, his robe.

9.14.d: अति शरिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या | वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ||
9.14.e: O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes,  And utters voice which he hath found.

9.14.d: अभि कषिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस पतिम | पर्ष्ठा गर्भ्णत वाजिनः ||
9.14.e: The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength:  They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.

9.14.d: परि दिव्यानि मर्म्र्शद विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा | वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ||
9.14.e: Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth,  Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.

9.15.d: एष धिया यात्यण्व्य शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः | गछन्निन्द्रस्य निष्क्र्तम ||
9.15.e: THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears,  Going to Indra's special place.

9.15.d: एष पुरू धियायते बर्हते देवतातये | यत्राम्र्तास आसते ||
9.15.e: In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods.  Where the Immortals have their seat.

9.15.d: एष हितो वि नीयते.अन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा | यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ||
9.15.e: Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light  The mettled steeds exert their strength.

9.15.d: एष शर्ङगाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो वर्षा | नर्म्णा दधान ओजसा ||
9.15.e: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd,  Doing with might heroic deeds.

9.15.d: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजि शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः | पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन ||
9.15.e: He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold,  Becoming Sovran of the streams.

9.15.d: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवानति | अव शादेषु गछति ||
9.15.e: He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed.  Descends into the reservoirs.

9.15.d: एतं मर्जन्ति मर्ज्यमुप दरोणेष्वायवः | परचक्राणं महीरिषः ||
9.15.e: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified,  Him who brings forth abundant food.

9.15.d: एतमु तयं दश कषिपो मर्जन्ति सप्त धीतयः | सवायुधं मदिन्तमम ||
9.15.e: Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful,  Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.

9.16.d: पर ते सोतार ओण्यो रसं मदाय घर्ष्वय | सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ||
9.16.e: THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy  The speckled sap runs like a flood.

9.16.d: करत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा | गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ||
9.16.e: With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine,  Enrobed in water with his juice.

9.16.d: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सर्ज | पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ||
9.16.e: Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne’er subdued in waters, waterless,  And make it pure for Indra's drink.

9.16.d: पर पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति | करत्वा सधस्थमासदत ||
9.16.e: Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve:  By wisdom it hath gained its home.

9.16.d: पर तवा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा अस्र्क्षत | महे भरायकारिणः ||
9.16.e: With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee,  Contending for the glorious prize.

9.16.d: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि शरियः | शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ||
9.16.e: Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he  Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.

9.16.d: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः | वर्था पवित्रे अर्षति ||
9.16.e: Swelling, as ’twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice  Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.

9.16.d: तवं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु | अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ||
9.16.e: Thus, Soma, purifying himwho knoweth song mid living men,  Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.

9.17.d: पर निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घनन्तो वर्त्राणि भूर्णयः | सोमा अस्र्ग्रमाशवः ||
9.17.e: LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vṛtras, full of zeal,  The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.

9.17.d: अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वर्ष्टयः पर्थिवीमिव | इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन ||
9.17.e: The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth:  To Indra flow the Soma-streams.

9.17.d: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति | विघ्नन रक्षांसि देवयुः ||
9.17.e: With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows intoṭhe sieve,  Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.

9.17.d: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते | उक्थैर्यज्ञेषुवर्धते ||
9.17.e: It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong  At sacrifices through the lauds.

9.17.d: अति तरी सोम रोचना रोहन न भराजसे दिवम | इष्णन सूर्यं न चोदयः ||
9.17.e: Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as ’twere above light's triple realm,  And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.

9.17.d: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन यज्ञस्य कारवः | दधानाश्चक्षसि परियम ||
9.17.e: To him, the head of sacnfice, singers and bards have sung their songs,  Offering what he loves to see.

9.17.d: तमु तवा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः | मर्जन्तिदेवतातये ||
9.17.e: The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong &teed,  Deck thee for service of the Gods.

9.17.d: मधोर्धारामनु कषर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः | चारुरताय पीतये ||
9.17.e: Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home,  Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.

9.18.d: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः | मदेषु सर्वधा असि ||
9.18.e: THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: तवं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु पर जातमन्धसः | मदेषु... ||
9.18.e: Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offipring of thy sap:  All-bountcous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत | मदेषु ... ||
9.18.e: All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे | मदेषु ... ||
9.18.e: He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते | मदेषु ... ||
9.18.e: Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति | मदेषु ... ||
9.18.e: Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halvcs:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत | मदेषु ... ||
9.18.e: The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.19.d: यत सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु | तन नः पुनान आ भर ||
9.19.e: O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet  For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.

9.19.d: युवं हि सथः सवर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती | ईशानापिप्यतं धियः ||
9.19.e: For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine:  Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.

9.19.d: वर्षा पुनान आयुषु सतनयन्नधि बर्हिषि | हरिः सन योनिमासदत ||
9.19.e: The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass,  Hath sunk and settled in his home.
Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant,  The mothers of the darling Son.

9.19.d: कुविद वर्षण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत | याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ||
9.19.e: Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine whb long to meet their Lord,  The kine who yield the shining milk?

9.19.d: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु | पवमानविदा रयिम ||
9.19.e: Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies:  O Pavamana, find us wealth.

9.19.d: नि शत्रोः सोम वर्ष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर | दूरेवा सतो अन्ति वा ||
9.19.e: Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r,  Whether he be afar or near.

9.20.d: पर कविर्देववीतये.अव्यो वारेभिरर्षति | साह्वान विश्वाभि सप्र्धः ||
9.20.e: FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods,  Subduing all our enemies.

9.20.d: स हि षमा जरित्र्भ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति | पवमानः सहस्रिणम ||
9.20.e: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold treasure in the shape  Of cattle to the singing-men.

9.20.d: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मर्शसे पवसे मती | स नः सोम शरवो विदः ||
9.20.e: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts  As such, O Soma, find us fame.

9.20.d: अभ्यर्ष बर्हद यशो मघवद्भ्यो धरुवं रयिम | इषं सतोत्र्भ्य आ भर ||
9.20.e: Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords,  Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

9.20.d: तवं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ | पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ||
9.20.e: As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like  A pious King, into the songs.

9.20.d: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मर्ज्यमानो गभस्त्योः | सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ||
9.20.e: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean  With hands, is resting in the jars.

9.20.d: करीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गछसि | दधत सतोत्रे सुवीर्यम ||
9.20.e: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve,  Lending the laud a Hero's strength.

9.21.d: एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घर्ष्वयः | मत्सरासःस्वर्विदः ||
9.21.e: To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood.  Exhilarating, finding light;

9.21.d: परव्र्ण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः | सवयं सतोत्रे वयस्क्र्तः ||
9.21.e: Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly  Bringing their praiser vitalforce.

9.21.d: वर्था करीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित | सिन्धोरूर्मा वयक्षरन ||
9.21.e: Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir,  And fall into the river's wave.

9.21.d: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत | हिता न सप्तयो रथे ||
9.21.e: These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired,  Like coursers harnessed to a car.

9.21.d: आस्मिन पिशङगमिन्दवो दधाता वेनमादिशे | यो अस्मभ्यमरावा ||
9.21.e: With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire  On him who yet hath given us naught.

9.21.d: रभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे | शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ||
9.21.e: Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel:  Flow pure and shining with the stream.

9.21.d: एत उ तये अवीवशन काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत | सतः परासाविषुर्मतिम ||
9.21.e: These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course,  And roused the good man's hymn to life.

9.22.d: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव पर वाजिनः | सर्गाः सर्ष्टा अहेषत ||
9.22.e: THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds,  Like cars, like armies hurried forth.

9.22.d: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वर्ष्टयः | अग्नेरिव भरमा वर्था ||
9.22.e: Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like  The flickering flames of burning fire.

9.22.d: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः | विपा वयानशुर्धियः ||
9.22.e: These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns,  Have gained by song their hearts'desire.

9.22.d: एते मर्ष्टा अमर्त्याः सस्र्वांसो न शश्रमुः | इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः ||
9.22.e: Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain  To reach the regions and their paths.

9.22.d: एते पर्ष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो वयानशुः | उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ||
9.22.e: Advancing they have travelled o’er the ridges of the earth and heaven,  And this the highest realm of all.
Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out,  And this which must be deemed most high.

9.22.d: तवं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः | ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः ||
9.22.e: Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls:  Thou calledst forth the outspun thread.

9.23.d: सोमा अस्र्ग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया | अभि विश्वानिकाव्या ||
9.23.e: SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink,  For sacred lore of every kind.

9.23.d: अनु परत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः | रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम ||
9.23.e: Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come.  They made the Sun that he might shine.

9.23.d: आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयम | कर्धि परजावतीरिषः ||
9.23.e: O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth,  And give us food with progeny.

9.23.d: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम | अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम ||
9.23.e: The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink,  Turned to the vat which drips with meath.

9.23.d: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम | सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ||
9.23.e: Soma gows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength,  Brave Hero who repels the curse.

9.23.d: इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः | इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि ||
9.23.e: For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods:  1ndu, thou fain wilt win us strength

9.23.d: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वर्त्राण्यप्रति | जघान जघनच्च नु ||
9.23.e: When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes:  Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.

9.24.d: पर सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः | शरीणाना अप्सु मर्ञ्जत ||
9.24.e: HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed,  the drops while they are purified:  When bIent, in waters they are rinsed.

9.24.d: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न परवता यतीः | पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ||
9.24.e: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice:  They come to Indra, being cleansed.

9.24.d: पर पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे | नर्भिर्यतो वि नीयसे ||
9.24.e: O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink:  The men have seized and lead thee forth.

9.24.d: तवं सोम नर्मादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे | सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ||
9.24.e: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men,  To him who ruleth o’er mankind.

9.24.d: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि | अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ||
9.24.e: Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art,  Ready for Indra's high decree.
Flow on, best Vṛtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds.  Pure, purifying, wonderful.

9.24.d: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः | देवावीरघशंसहा ||
9.24.e: Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath eflused,  Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

9.25.d: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे | मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ||
9.25.e: GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught  For Vāyu and the Marut host.

9.25.d: पवमान धिया हितो.अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत | धर्मणा वायुमा विश ||
9.25.e: O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place,  Pass into Vāyu as Law bids.

9.25.d: सं देवैः शोभते वर्षा कविर्योनावधि परियः | वर्त्रहा देववीतमः ||
9.25.e: The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home,  Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.

9.25.d: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन पुनानो याति हर्यतः | यत्राम्र्तास आसते ||
9.25.e: Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified,  Thither where- the Immortals sit.

9.25.d: अरुषो जनयन गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक | इन्द्रं गछन कविक्रतुः ||
9.25.e: To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise,  The visitor of living men.

9.25.d: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे | अर्कस्य योनिमासदम ||
9.25.e: Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream  To seat thee in the place of song.

9.26.e: THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed  Upon the lap of Aditi,

9.26.d: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम | इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः ||
9.26.e: The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams,  To Indu who supporteth heaven.

9.26.d: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन पवमानमधि दयवि | धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम ||
9.26.e: Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, they  Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.

9.26.d: तमह्यन भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः | पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम ||
9.26.e: Him, dweller with Vivasvān, they with use of both arms have sent forth,  The Lord of Speech infallible.

9.26.d: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | हर्यतम्भूरिचक्षसम ||
9.26.e: Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones  Send down to ridges of the sieve.

9.26.d: तं तवा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिराव्र्धम | इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम ||
9.26.e: O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee  Who aidest song and cheerest him.

9.27.d: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते | पुनानो घनन्नप सरिधः ||
9.27.e: THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth,  Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

9.27.d: एष इन्द्राय वायवे सवर्जित परि षिच्यते | पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ||
9.27.e: As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vāyu he  Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

9.27.d: एष नर्भिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वर्षा सुतः | सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित ||
9.27.e: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven,  Effused into the vats of wood.

9.27.d: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत पवमानो हिरण्ययुः | इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्त्र्तः ||
9.27.e: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed,  Still Conqueror, never overcome.

9.27.d: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि दयवि | पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ||
9.27.e: This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then  Mounts up with Sūrya to the sky.

9.27.d: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वर्षा हरिः | पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ||
9.27.e: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed,  This Indu, being purified.

9.28.d: एष वाजी हितो नर्भिर्विश्वविन मनसस पतिः | अव्यो वारं वि धावति ||
9.28.e: URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient,  Runs to the woollen straining-cloth.

9.28.d: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः | विश्वा धामान्याविशन ||
9.28.e: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused,  Entering all their essences.

9.28.d: एष देवः शुभायते.अधि योनावमर्त्यः | वर्त्रहा देववीतमः ||
9.28.e: He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place,  Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

9.28.d: एष वर्षा कनिक्रदद दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः | अभि दरोणानि धावति ||
9.28.e: Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer  Runs onward to the wooden vats.

9.28.d: एष सूर्यमरोचयत पवमानो विचर्षणिः | विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित ||
9.28.e: This Pavamana, swiftand strong, Omniscient, gave spleudour to  The Sun and all his forms of light.

9.28.d: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति | देवावीरघशंसहा ||
9.28.e: This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible,  Slayer of sinners, dear toGods.

9.29.d: परास्य धारा अक्षरन वर्ष्णः सुतस्यौजसा | देवाननु परभूषतः ||
9.29.e: FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused,  Of him who sets him by the Gods.

9.29.d: सप्तिं मर्जन्ति वेधसो गर्णन्तः कारवो गिरा | जयोतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम ||
9.29.e: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed,  Brought forth as light that merits laud.

9.29.d: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय परभूवसो | वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम ||
9.29.e: These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth:  Fill full the sea that claims our praise.

9.29.d: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन पवस्व सोम धारया | इनु दवेषांसि सध्र्यक ||
9.29.e: Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream  Drive to one place our enemies.

9.29.d: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः सवनात समस्य कस्य चित | निदो यत्रमुमुच्महे ||
9.29.e: Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all,  That so we may be freed from blame.

9.29.d: एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया | दयुमन्तं शुष्ममा भर ||
9.29.e: O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven,  And splendid vigour, in thy stream.

9.30.d: पर धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वर्था पवित्रे अक्षरन | पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ||
9.30.e: STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth:  While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.
Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified.  Sends forth a very mighty sound.

9.30.d: आ नः शुष्मं नर्षाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्प्र्हम | पवस्व सोम धारया ||
9.30.e: Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream manconquering might which many crave,  Accompanied with hero sons.

9.30.d: पर सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत | अभि दरोणान्यासदम ||
9.30.e: Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream,  To settle in the vats of wood.

9.30.d: अप्सु तवा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ||
9.30.e: To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets,  O Indu, to be Indra's drink.

9.30.d: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे | चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम ||
9.30.e: For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets,  Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.

9.31.d: पर सोमासः सवाध्यः पवमानासो अक्रमुः | रयिं कर्ण्वन्तिचेतनम ||
9.31.e: THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified,  Bestowing wealth which all may see.

9.31.d: दिवस पर्थिव्या अधि भवेन्दो दयुम्नवर्धनः | भवा वाजानां पतिः ||
9.31.e: O Indu, high o’er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might:  The Master of all strength be thou.

9.31.d: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः | सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः ||
9.31.e: The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee  Soma, they multiply thy power.

9.31.d: आ पयायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वर्ष्ण्यम | भवा वाजस्य संगथे ||
9.31.e: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:  Be in the gathering-Place of strength.

9.31.d: तुभ्यं गावो घर्तं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम | वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ||
9.31.e: For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk.  Aloft on the sublimest height.

9.31.d: सवायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम | इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ||
9.31.e: Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms,  With thee, O Lord of all that is.

9.32.d: पर सोमासो मदच्युतः शरवसे नो मघोनः | सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ||
9.32.e: THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have  Flowed forth to glorify our prince.

9.32.d: आदीं तरितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ||
9.32.e: Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones,  Indu for Indra, for his drink.

9.32.d: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन मतिम | अत्योन गोभिरज्यते ||
9.32.e: Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn:  He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.

9.32.d: उभे सोमावचाकशन मर्गो न तक्तो अर्षसि | सीदन्न्र्तस्य योनिमा ||
9.32.e: O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runncst like a darting deer  Set in the place of sacrifice.

9.32.d: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव परियम | अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम ||
9.32.e: The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love  He came as to a settled race.

9.32.d: अस्मे धेहि दयुमद यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च | सनिं मेधामुत शरवः ||
9.32.e: Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me,  Glory, intelligence, and wealth.

9.33.d: पर सोमासो विपश्चितो.अपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः | वनानि महिषा इव ||
9.33.e: LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed  Onward, as buffaloes to woods.

9.33.d: अभि दरोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा रतस्य धारया | वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन ||
9.33.e: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store  Of kine into the wooden vats.

9.33.d: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः | सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे ||
9.33.e: To Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, to Viṣṇu, and the Maruts, flow  The drops of Soma juice effused.

9.33.d: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः | हरिरेति कनिक्रदत ||
9.33.e: Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk:  The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

9.33.d: अभि बरह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरतस्य मातरः | मर्म्र्ज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम ||
9.33.e: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise:  They decorate the Child of Heaven.

9.33.d: रायः समुद्रांश्चतुरो.अस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः | आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ||
9.33.e: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas  Filled full of riches thousandfold.

9.34.d: पर सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति | रुजद दर्ळ्हा वयोजसा ||
9.34.e: THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled.  Rending strong places with its might.

9.34.d: सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः | सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ||
9.34.e: Poured forth to Indra, Varuṇa, to Vāyu and the Marut hosts,  To Viṣṇu, flows the Soma juice.

9.34.d: वर्षाणं वर्षभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः | दुहन्तिशक्मना पयः ||
9.34.e: With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong:  They milk the liquor out with skill.

9.34.d: भुवत तरितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः | सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ||
9.34.e: ’Tis he whom Trita must refine, ’tis he who shall make Indra glad:  The Tawny One is decked with tints.

9.34.d: अभीं रतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पर्श्निमातरः | चारु परियतमं हविः ||
9.34.e: Him do the Sons of Pṛśni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice,  Oblation lovely and most dear.

9.34.d: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः | धेनूर्वाश्रोवीवशत ||
9.34.e: To him in one unitcd stream th-,se songs flow on straight forward. he,  Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.

9.35.d: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पर्थुम | यया जयोतिर्विदासि नः ||
9.35.e: Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream.  Wherewith thou mayest find us light

9.35.d: इन्दो समुद्रमीङखय पवस्व विश्वमेजय | रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ||
9.35.e: O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on,  Bearer of wealth to us with might.

9.35.d: तवया वीरेण वीरवो.अभि षयाम पर्तन्यतः | कषरा णो अभि वार्यम ||
9.35.e: With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies:  Let what is precious flow to us.

9.35.d: पर वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन वाजसा रषिः | वरता विदान आयुधा ||
9.35.e: Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power,  Discovering holy works and means.

9.35.d: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङखयं पुनानं वासयामसि | सोमं जनस्य गोपतिम ||
9.35.e: Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified  Soma, the Guardian of the folk;

9.35.d: विश्वो यस्य वरते जनो दाधार धर्मणस पतेः | पुनानस्य परभूवसोः ||
9.35.e: On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most richi as he is purified.  The people all have set their hearts.

9.36.d: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः | कार्ष्मन वाजीन्यक्रमीत ||
9.36.e: FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve:  The Steed steps forward to the goal.

9.36.d: स वह्निः सोम जाग्र्विः पवस्व देववीरति | अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम ||
9.36.e: Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve,  Turned to the vat that drops with meath.

9.36.d: स नो जयोतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय | करत्वे दक्षायनो हिनु ||
9.36.e: Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us.  Speed us to mental power and skill.

9.36.d: शुम्भमानो रतायुभिर्म्र्ज्यमानो गभस्त्योः | पवते वारे अव्यये ||
9.36.e: He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned,  Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.

9.36.d: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा | पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या ||
9.36.e: May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament  Upon the liberal worshipper.

9.36.d: आ दिवस पर्ष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि | वीरयुः शवसस पते ||
9.36.e: Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine,  And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!

9.37.d: स सुतः पीतये वर्षा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति | विघ्नन रक्षांसि देवयुः ||
9.37.e: SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve,  Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

9.37.d: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः | अभि योनिंकनिक्रदत ||
9.37.e: Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent,  Bellowing, to his place of rest.

9.37.d: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति | रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम ||
9.37.e: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven,  Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.

9.37.d: स तरितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत | जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ||
9.37.e: This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun,  Together with the Sisters, shine.

9.37.d: स वर्त्रहा वर्षा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः | सोमो वाजमिवासरत ||
9.37.e: This Vṛtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne’er deceived,  Hath gone, as ’twere, to win the spoil.

9.37.d: स देवः कविनेषितो.अभि दरोणानि धावति | इन्दुरिन्द्रायमंहना ||
9.37.e: Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood,  Indu to Indra willingly.

9.38.d: एष उ सय वर्षा रथो.अव्यो वारेभिरर्षति | गछन वाजं सहस्रिणम ||
9.38.e: THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woollen filter, as he goes  To war that wins a thousand spoils.

9.38.d: एतं तरितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ||
9.38.e: The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One  Indu to Indra for his drink.

9.38.d: एतं तयं हरितो दश मर्म्र्ज्यन्ते अपस्युवः | याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ||
9.38.e: Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright  And beauteous for the gladdening draught.

9.38.d: एष सय मानुषीष्वा शयेनो न विक्षु सीदति | गछञ जारो न योषितम ||
9.38.e: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men.  Speeding like lover to his love.

9.38.d: एष सय मद्यो रसो.अव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः | य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत ||
9.38.e: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven,  This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.

9.38.d: एष सय पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः | करन्दन योनिमभि परियम ||
9.38.e: Poured for the draught, this tawny juice  flows forth, intelligent, crying out,  Unto the well-beloved place.

9.39.d: आशुरर्ष बर्हन्मते परि परियेण धाम्ना | यत्र देवा इतिब्रवन ||
9.39.e: FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form,  Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

9.39.d: परिष्क्र्ण्वन्ननिष्क्र्तं जनाय यातयन्निषः | वर्ष्टिन्दिवः परि सरव ||
9.39.e: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man,  Make thou the rain descend from heaven.

9.39.d: सुत एति पवित्र आ तविषिं दधान ओजसा | विचक्षाणो विरोचयन ||
9.39.e: With might, bestowing power, thejuice enters the purifying sieve,  Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

9.39.d: अयं स यो दिवस परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ | सिन्धोरूर्मा वयक्षरत ||
9.39.e: This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down  From heaven upon the straining cloth.

9.39.d: आविवासन परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः | इन्द्राय सिच्यतेमधु ||
9.39.e: Inviting him frorh far away, and even from near at hand, the juice  For Indra is poured forth as meath.

9.39.d: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | योनाव रतस्य सीदत ||
9.39.e: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One.  Sit in the place of sacrifice.

9.40.d: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मर्धो विचर्षणिः | शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ||
9.40.e: THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies:  They deck the Sage with holy songs.

9.40.d: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद गमदिन्द्रं वर्षा सुतः | धरुवे सदसि सीदति ||
9.40.e: The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice:  He settles in his firm abode.

9.40.d: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दो.अस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः | आ पवस्वसहस्रिणम ||
9.40.e: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousandfold.

9.40.d: विश्वा सोम पवमान दयुम्नानीन्दवा भर | विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ||
9.40.e: O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splcndours hitherward:  Find for us food in boundless store.

9.40.d: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं सतोत्रे सुवीर्यम | जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ||
9.40.e: As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper,  And prosper thou the singer's hymns.

9.40.d: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम दविबर्हसं रयिम | वर्षन्निन्दो नौक्थ्यम ||
9.40.e: O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doublypiled,  Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.

9.41.d: पर ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः | घनन्तः कर्ष्णामप तवचम ||
9.41.e: ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls,  Driving the black skin far away.

9.41.d: सुवितस्य मनामहे.अति सेतुं दुराव्यम | साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम ||
9.41.e: Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss,  Leaving the bridge of woe behind.

9.41.d: शर्ण्वे वर्ष्टेरिव सवनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः | चरन्तिविद्युतो दिवि ||
9.41.e: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as ’twere the rush of rain  Lightnings are flashing to the sky.

9.41.d: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत | अश्वावद वाजवत सुतः ||
9.41.e: Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth  In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.

9.41.d: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पर्ण | उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ||
9.41.e: Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth,  As Dawn, as Sūrya with his beams.

9.41.d: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः | सरा रसेव विष्टपम ||
9.41.e: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream,  As Rasā flows around the world.

9.42.d: जनयन रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम | वसानो गा अपोहरिः ||
9.42.e: ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued,  Robed in the waters and the milk,

9.42.d: एष परत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस परि | धारया पवते सुतः ||
9.42.e: According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused  Flows purely on, a God for Gods.

9.42.d: वाव्र्धानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये | सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ||
9.42.e: For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers  Are purified for winning spoil.

9.42.d: दुहानः परत्नमित पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते | करन्दन देवानजीजनत ||
