9.42.e: Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve:  He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.

9.42.d: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवान रताव्र्धः | सोमः पुनानोर्षति ||
9.42.e: Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired,  He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.

9.42.d: गोमन नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद वाजवत सुतः | पवस्व बर्हतीरिषः ||
9.42.e: Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil,  Send us abundant store of food.

9.43.d: यो अत्य इव मर्ज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः | तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ||
9.43.e: WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed,  Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.

9.43.d: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा | इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ||
9.43.e: All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way,  Indu for Indra, for his drink.

9.43.d: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्क्र्तः | विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ||
9.43.e: Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs,  Songs of the sage Medhyātithi.

9.43.d: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम | इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम ||
9.43.e: O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us,  Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.

9.43.d: इन्दुरत्यो न वाजस्र्त कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ | यदक्षारति देवयुः ||
9.43.e: Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods,  Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.

9.43.d: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गर्णतो वर्धे | सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम ||
9.43.e: Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee:  Soma, bestow heroic power.

9.44.d: पर ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि | अभि देवानयास्यः ||
9.44.e: INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as ’twere thy wave to Gods,  Unwearied, thou art flowing forQh.

9.44.d: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति | विप्रस्य धारया कविः ||
9.44.e: Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away,  The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,

9.44.d: अयं देवेषु जाग्र्विः सुत एति पवित्र आ | सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ||
9.44.e: Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve  Soma, most active, travels on.

9.44.d: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम | बर्हिष्माना विवासति ||
9.44.e: Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice:  The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.

9.44.d: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदाव्र्धः | सोमो देवेष्वा यमत ||
9.44.e: May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vāyu, Sage  And Hero, lead us to the Gods.

9.44.d: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये करतुविद गातुवित्तमः | वाजं जेषि शरवो बर्हत ||
9.44.e: So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers,  Win for us strength and high renown.

9.45.d: स पवस्व मदाय कं नर्चक्षा देववीतये | इन्दविन्द्रायपीतये ||
9.45.e: FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods,  Indu, to Indra for his drink.

9.45.d: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं तवमिन्द्राय तोशसे | देवान सखिभ्य आ वरम ||
9.45.e: Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to  The Gods, O better than our friends.

9.45.d: उत तवामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम | वि नो राये दुरो वर्धि ||
9.45.e: We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy:  Unbar for us the doors of wealth.

9.45.d: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद वाजी धुरं न यामनि | इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते ||
9.45.e: He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run  Indu belongs unto the Gods.

9.45.d: समी सखायो अस्वरन वने करीळन्तमत्यविम | इन्दुं नावा अनूषत ||
9.45.e: All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece:  Singers have chanted Indu's praise.

9.45.d: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे | इन्दो सतोत्रे सुवीर्यम ||
9.45.e: Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man  Who worships thee heroic strength.

9.46.d: अस्र्ग्रन देववीतये.अत्यासः कर्त्व्या इव | कषरन्तः पर्वताव्र्धः ||
9.46.e: LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods,  joying in mountains, flowing on.

9.46.d: परिष्क्र्तास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती | वायुं सोमा अस्र्क्षत ||
9.46.e: To Vāyu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful  Like a bride dowered by her sire.

9.46.d: एते सोमास इन्दवः परयस्वन्तः चमू सुताः | इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः ||
9.46.e: Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of  juice, the Somas rich in food,  Give strength to Indra with their work.

9.46.d: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गर्भ्णीत मन्थिना | गोभिः शरीणीत मत्सरम ||
9.46.e: Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal,  And cook with milk the gladdening draught.

9.46.d: स पवस्व धनंजय परयन्ता राधसो महः | अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित ||
9.46.e: Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us,  Giver oF ample opulence.

9.46.d: एतं मर्जन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश कषिपः | इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम ||
9.46.e: This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn,  The draught that shall make Indra glad.

9.47.d: अया सोमः सुक्र्त्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत | मन्दान उद्व्र्षायते ||
9.47.e: GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity:  joyous he riseth like a bull.

9.47.d: कर्तानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा | रणा च धर्ष्णुश्चयते ||
9.47.e: His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest:  He sternly reckoneth their debts.

9.47.d: आत सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत | उक्थं यदस्य जायते ||
9.47.e: Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes  A thousand-winning thunderbolt.

9.47.d: सवयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिछति | यदी मर्म्र्ज्यते धियः ||
9.47.e: Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage  When he embellisheth his songs.
Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war  Thou art upon the conquerors' side.

9.48.d: तं तवा नर्म्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः | चारुं सुक्र्त्ययेमहे ||
9.48.e: WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might  In mansions of the lofty heavens;

9.48.d: संव्र्क्तध्र्ष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम | शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम ||
9.48.e: Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway,  Destroyer of a hundred forts.

9.48.d: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः | सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत ||
9.48.e: Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down,  Lord over riches, from the sky.

9.48.d: विश्वस्मा इत सवर्द्र्शे साधारणं रजस्तुरम | गोपां रतस्य विर्भरत ||
9.48.e: That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend  Of all, the speeder through the air.

9.48.d: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं जयायो महित्वमानशे | अभिष्टिक्र्द्विचर्षणिः ||
9.48.e: And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty,  Most active, ready to assist.

9.49.d: पवस्व वर्ष्टिमा सु नो.अपामूर्मिं दिवस परि | अयक्ष्मा बर्हतीरिषः ||
9.49.e: Poust down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky,  And plenteous store of wholesome fbod.

9.49.d: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन | जन्यास उप नो गर्हम ||
9.49.e: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us,  The kine of strangers to our home.

9.49.d: घर्तं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः | अस्मभ्यं वर्ष्टिमा पव ||
9.49.e: Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream,  Ppur down on us a flood of rain.

9.49.d: स न ऊर्जे वयव्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया | देवासः शर्णवन हि कम ||
9.49.e: To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth  For verily the Gods will bear.

9.49.d: पवमानो असिष्यदद रक्षांस्यपजङघनत | परत्नवद रोचयन रुचः ||
9.49.e: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rākṣasas,  Flashing out splendour as of old.

9.50.d: उत ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव सवनः | वाणस्य चोदया पविम ||
9.50.e: LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves:  Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.

9.50.d: परसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः | यदव्य एषिसानवि ||
9.50.e: At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou  Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

9.50.d: अव्यो वारे परि परियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | पवमानम्मधुश्चुतम ||
9.50.e: On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One,  Even Pavamana, dropping meath.

9.50.d: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे | अर्कस्य योनिमासदम ||
9.50.e: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer,  To seat thee in the place of song.

9.50.d: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः | इन्दविन्द्रायपीतये ||
9.50.e: Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm,  Indu, for Indra, for his drink.

9.51.d: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सर्ज | पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ||
9.51.e: ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones,  And make it pure for Indra's drink.

9.51.d: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे | सुनोता मधुमत्तमम ||
9.51.e: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice,  Most excellent, most rich in sweets.

9.51.d: तव तय इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते | पवमानस्य मरुतः ||
9.51.e: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine,  This Pavamana's flowing meath.

9.51.d: तवं हि सोम वर्धयन सुतो मदाय भूर्णये | वर्षन सतोतारमूतये ||
9.51.e: For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse,  O Steer, the singer, for our help.

9.51.d: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः | अभि वाजमुत शरवः ||
9.51.e: Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve:  Flow on to give us strength and fame.

9.52.d: परि दयुक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद वाजं नो अन्धसा | सुवानोर्ष पवित्र आ ||
9.52.e: WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice,  Flow to the filter when effused.

9.52.d: तव परत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि परियः | सहस्रधारो यात तना ||
9.52.e: So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams  Run o’er the fleecy straining-cloth.
Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us  Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.

9.52.d: नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम | यो अस्मानादिदेशति ||
9.52.e: Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men,  Of him who threatens us with war.

9.52.d: शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम | पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ||
9.52.e: Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea,  A thousand of thy pure bright streams.

9.53.d: उत ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः | नुदस्व याः परिस्प्र्धः ||
9.53.e: O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves:  Chase thou the foes who compass us.

9.53.d: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते | सतवा अबिभ्युषा हर्दा ||
9.53.e: Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked:  With fearless heart will I sing praise.

9.53.d: अस्य वरतानि नाध्र्षे पवमानस्य दूढ्या | रुज यस्त्वाप्र्तन्यति ||
9.53.e: No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws:  Crush him who fain would fight with thee.

9.53.d: तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम | इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम ||
9.53.e: For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed,  Indu the bringer of delight.

9.54.d: अस्य परत्नामनु दयुतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः | पयः सहस्रसां रषिम ||
9.54.e: AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from  The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.

9.54.d: अयं सूर्य इवोपद्र्गयं सरांसि धावति | सप्त परवता दिवम ||
9.54.e: In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes,  Seven currents flowing through the sky.

9.54.d: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि | सोमो देवो नसूर्यः ||
9.54.e: He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist-  Soma, a God as Sūrya is.

9.54.d: परि णो देववीतये वाजानर्षसि गोमतः | पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः ||
9.54.e: Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend,  Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.

9.55.d: यवं-यवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम-पुष्टं परि सरव | सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ||
9.55.e: POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment,  And, Soma, all felicities.

9.55.d: ईन्दो यथा तव सतवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः | नि बर्हिषि परिये सदः ||
9.55.e: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice,  Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.

9.55.d: उत नो गोविदश्ववित पवस्व सोमान्धसा | मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ||
9.55.e: And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on  Through days that fly most rapidly.

9.55.d: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य | स पवस्व सहस्रजित ||
9.55.e: As one who conquers, ne’er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy,  Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.

9.56.d: परि सोम रतं बर्हदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति | विघ्नन रक्षांसि देवयुः ||
9.56.e: SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law,  Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

9.56.d: यत सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः | इन्द्रस्यसख्यमाविशन ||
9.56.e: When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams  To Indra's friendship win theirway.

9.56.d: अभि तवा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत | मर्ज्यसे सोम सातये ||
9.56.e: Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love:  O Soma, thou art decked to win.

9.56.d: तवमिन्द्राय विष्णवे सवादुरिन्दो परि सरव | नॄन सतोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ||
9.56.e: Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Viṣṇu: guard  The men, the singers, from distress.

9.57.d: पर ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वर्ष्टयः | अछा वाजं सहस्रिणम ||
9.57.e: THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven,  To bring a thousand stores of strength.

9.57.d: अभि परियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति | हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ||
9.57.e: He flows beholding on his way all wellbeloved sacred lore,  Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.

9.57.d: स मर्म्र्जान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः | शयेनो न वंसु षीदति ||
9.57.e: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants.  Sits as a falcon in the, wood.

9.57.d: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पर्थिव्या अधि | पुनान इन्दवाभर ||
9.57.e: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified,  All treasures both of heaven and earth.

9.58.d: तरत स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः | तरत स मन्दी धावति ||
9.58.e: SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः | तरत स मन्दी धावति ||
9.58.e: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: धवस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे | तरत स मन्दी धावति ||
9.58.e: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Puruṣanti's hands:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे | तरत समन्दी धावति ||
9.58.e: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.59.d: पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद विश्वजित सोम रण्यजित | परजावद रत्नमा भर ||
9.59.e: FLOW onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight:  Bring hither wealth with progeny.
Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants:  Flow onward from the pressing-boards.

9.59.d: तवं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर | कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि ||
9.59.e: Soma, as Pavamana, pass over all trouble and distress:  Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage.

9.59.d: पवमान सवर्विदो जायमानो.अभवो महान | इन्दो विश्वानभीदसि ||
9.59.e: Thou, Pavamana, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great:  O Indu, thou art over all.

9.60.d: पर गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिम | इन्दुं सहस्रचक्षसम ||
9.60.e: SING forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamana, laud  Indu who sees with thousand eyes.

9.60.d: तं तवा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसम | अति वारमपाविषुः ||
9.60.e: Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, they  Have filtered through the fleecy cloth.

9.60.d: अति वारान पवमानो असिष्यदत कलशानभि धावति | इन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन ||
9.60.e: He, Pavamana, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars,  Finding his way to Indra's heart.

9.60.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे | परजावद रेता भर ||
9.60.e: That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal:  Bring genial seed with progeny.

9.61.d: अया वीती परि सरव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा | अवाहन नवतीर्नव ||
9.61.e: FLOW onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delight  Battered the nine-and-ninety down,

9.61.d: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम | अध तयं तुर्वशं यदुम ||
9.61.e: Smote swiftly forts, and gambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga,  For pious Divodāsa's sake.

9.61.d: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत | कषरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ||
9.61.e: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and  wealth in kine and gold,  And, Indu, food in boundless store.

9.61.d: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः | सखित्वमा वर्णीमहे ||
9.61.e: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o’er  The limit of the cleansing sieve.

9.61.d: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयो.अभिक्षरन्ति धारया | तेभिर्नः सोम मर्ळय ||
9.61.e: With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve,  Soma; be gracious unto us.

9.61.d: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम | ईशानःसोम विश्वतः ||
9.61.e: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides,—for thou canst,—  Riches and food with hero sons.

9.61.d: एतमु तयं दश कषिपो मर्जन्ति सिन्धुमातरम | समादित्येभिरख्यत ||
9.61.e: Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautify  With the Ādityas is he seen.

9.61.d: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ | सं सूर्यस्यरश्मिभिः ||
9.61.e: With Indra and with Vāyu he, effused, flows onward with,the beams  Of Sūrya to the cleansing sieve.

9.61.d: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान | चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ||
9.61.e: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vāyu, Pūṣan flow  For Mitra and for Varuṇa.

9.61.d: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि षद भूम्या ददे | उग्रं शर्म महि शरवः ||
9.61.e: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained  Strong sheltering power and great renown.

9.61.d: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ दयुम्नानि मानुषाणाम | सिषासन्तो वनामहे ||
9.61.e: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man,  Yea, all the glories of mankind.

9.61.d: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः | वरिवोवित परिस्रव ||
9.61.e: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore,  For Varuṇa and the Marut host.

9.61.d: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङगं परिष्क्र्तम | इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ||
9.61.e: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk,  The active crusher of the foe.

9.61.d: तमिद वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव | य इन्द्रस्य हर्दंसनिः ||
9.61.e: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him,  Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart.

9.61.d: अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम | वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम ||
9.61.e: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk  Increase the sea that merits laud.

9.61.d: पवमानो अजीजनद दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम | जयोतिर्वैश्वानरं बर्हत ||
9.61.e: From heaven hath Pavamana made, as ’twere, the marvellous thunder, and  The lofty light of all mankind.

9.61.d: पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुछुनः | वि वारमव्यमर्षति ||
9.61.e: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamana, King!  Flows o’er the woollen straining-cloth.

9.61.d: पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति दयुमान | जयोतिर्विश्वं सवर्द्र्शे ||
9.61.e: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill,  Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.

9.61.d: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा | देवावीरघशंसहा ||
9.61.e: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight,  Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods.

9.61.d: जघ्निर्व्र्त्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवे-दिवे | गोषा उ अश्वसा असि ||
9.61.e: Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day,  Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.

9.61.d: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः | सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ||
9.61.e: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast,  Falcon-like resting in thine home.

9.61.d: स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वर्त्राय हन्तवे | वव्रिवांसं महीरपः ||
9.61.e: Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vṛtra who  Compassed and stayed the mighty floods.

9.61.d: सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः | पुनानो वर्धनो गिरः ||
9.61.e: Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons:  Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns.

9.61.d: तवोतासस्तवावसा सयाम वन्वन्त आमुरः | सोम वरतेषुजाग्र्हि ||
9.61.e: Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war:  Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites.

9.61.d: अपघ्नन पवते मर्धो.अप सोमो अराव्णः | गछन्निन्द्रस्य निष्क्र्तम ||
9.61.e: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma flowcth on,  Going to Indra's special place.

9.61.d: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मर्धः | रास्वेन्दो वीरवद यशः ||
9.61.e: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes:  O Indu, grant heroic fame.

9.61.d: न तवा शतं चन हरुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन | यत पुनानो मखस्यसे ||
9.61.e: A hundred obstacles have ne’er checked  thee when fain to give thy boons,  When, being cleansed, thou combatest.

9.61.d: पवस्वेन्दो वर्षा सुतः कर्धी नो यशसो जने | विश्वा अपद्विषो जहि ||
9.61.e: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk:  Drive all our enemies away.

9.61.d: अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेन्दो दयुम्न उत्तमे | सासह्याम पर्तन्यतः ||
9.61.e: Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may we  Subdue all those who war with us.

9.61.d: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे | रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ||
9.61.e: Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down-  Guard us therewith from every foe.

9.62.d: एते अस्र्ग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः | विश्वान्यभिसौभगा ||
9.62.e: THESE rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve  To bring us all felicities.

9.62.d: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः | तना कर्ण्वन्तो अर्वते ||
9.62.e: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny,  Yea, and the warrior steed, success.

9.62.d: कर्ण्वन्तो वरिवो गवे.अभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम | इळामस्मभ्यं संयतम ||
9.62.e: Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Iḷā flow  To us for noble eulogy.

9.62.d: असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः | शयेनो न योनिमासदत ||
9.62.e: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been  pressed in the streams for rapturous joy:  Hawk-like he settles in his home.

9.62.d: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धूतो नर्भिः सुतः | सवदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ||
9.62.e: Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by men  The milch-kine sweeten it with milk.

9.62.d: आदीमश्वं न हेतारो.अशूशुभन्नम्र्ताय | मध्वो रसं सधमादे ||
9.62.e: As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice for  Ambrosia, for the festival.

9.62.d: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतो.अस्र्ग्रमिन्द ऊतये | ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ||
9.62.e: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for  help,  Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

9.62.d: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया | सीदन योना वनेष्वा ||
9.62.e: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink,  Finding thine home in vats of wood.

9.62.d: तवमिन्दो परि सरव सवादिष्ठो अङगिरोभ्यः | वरिवोविद घर्तं पयः ||
9.62.e: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk,  O Indu, for the Aṅgirases.

9.62.d: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति | हिन्वान आप्यं बर्हत ||
9.62.e: Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana, sent to us  For lofty friendship, meditates.

9.62.d: एष वर्षा वर्षव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा | करद वसूनि दाशुषे ||
9.62.e: Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamana shall  Bring treasures to the worshipper.

9.62.d: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम | पुरुश्चन्द्रम्पुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.62.e: Pour thou upon us thousandfold possessions, both of kine and steeds,  Exceeding glorious, much-desired.

9.62.d: एष सय परि षिच्यते मर्म्र्ज्यमान आयुभिः | उरुगायः कविक्रतुः ||
9.62.e: Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused,  Made beautiful by living men.

9.62.d: सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः | इन्द्राय पवते मदः ||
9.62.e: For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage,  With countless wealth and endless help.

9.62.d: गिरा जात इह सतुत इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते | विर्योना वसताविव ||
9.62.e: Born on the inountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down,  As in her sheltering nest a bird.

9.62.d: पवमानः सुतो नर्भिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत | चमूषु शक्मनासदम ||
9.62.e: Pressed by the men, as ’twere to war hath Soma Pavamana sped,  To test with might within the vats.

9.62.d: तं तरिप्र्ष्ठे तरिवन्धुरे रथे युञ्जन्ति यातवे | रषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः ||
9.62.e: That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated car  By the Seven Ṛṣis’ holy songs.

9.62.d: तं सोतारो धनस्प्र्तमाशुं वाजाय यातवे | हरिं हिनोत वाजिनम ||
9.62.e: Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war,  Swift Steed who carries off the spoil.

9.62.d: आविशन कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि शरियः | शूरोन गोषु तिष्ठति ||
9.62.e: Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar,  Stands like a hero mid the kine.

9.62.d: आ त इन्दो मदाय कं पयो दुहन्त्यायवः | देवा देवेभ्यो मधु ||
9.62.e: Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught:  Gods for the Gods milk out the meath.

9.62.d: आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सर्जता मधुमत्तमम | देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमम ||
9.62.e: Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets,  Him whom the Gods most gladly hear.

9.62.d: एते सोमा अस्र्क्षत गर्णानाः शरवसे महे | मदिन्तमस्य धारया ||
9.62.e: Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured,  Lauded with songs for lofty fame.

9.62.d: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नर्म्णा पुनानो अर्षसि | सनद्वाजः परि सरव ||
9.62.e: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed:  Winning the spoil flow hitherward.

9.62.d: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः | गर्णानो जमदग्निना ||
9.62.e: And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply,  And general praises, flow to us.

9.62.d: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः | अभि विश्वानि काव्या ||
9.62.e: Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids,  For holy lore of every kind.

9.62.d: तवं समुद्रिया अपो.अग्रियो वाच ईरयन | पवस्व विश्वमेजय ||
9.62.e: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea,  Flow onward, thou who movest all.

9.62.d: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे | तुभ्यमर्षन्तिसिन्धवः ||
9.62.e: O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might:  For thy behoof the rivers flow.

9.62.d: पर ते दिवो न वर्ष्टयो धारा यन्त्यसश्चतः | अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरम ||
9.62.e: Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flow  To the bright fleece spread under them.

9.62.d: इन्द्रायेन्दुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनम | ईशानं वीतिराधसम ||
9.62.e: For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong,  Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord.

9.62.d: पवमान रतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत | दधत सतोत्रेसुवीर्यम ||
9.62.e: Soma, true, Pavamana, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve,  Giving his praiser hero strength.

9.63.d: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यम | अस्मे शरवांसिधारय ||
9.63.e: POUR hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength,  And keep renown secure for us.

9.63.d: इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमः | चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ||
9.63.e: Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners!  Within the cups thou seatest thee.

9.63.d: सुत इन्द्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत | मधुमानस्तुवायवे ||
9.63.e: For Indra and for Viṣṇu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar:  May Vāyu find it rich in sweets.

9.63.d: एते अस्र्ग्रमाशवो.अति हवरांसि बभ्रवः | सोमा रतस्य धारया ||
9.63.e: These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrifice  Have flowed through twisted obstacles,

9.63.d: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कर्ण्वन्तो विश्वमार्यम | अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः ||
9.63.e: Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength,  Driving away the godless ones.

9.63.d: सुता अनु सवमा रजो.अभ्यर्षन्ति बभ्रवः | इन्द्रं गछन्त इन्दवः ||
9.63.e: Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate place  Flow through the region hitherward.

9.63.d: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः | हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ||
9.63.e: Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Sūrya light,  Urging on waters good to men.

9.63.d: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि | अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ||
9.63.e: He, Pavamana, high o’er man yoked the Sun's courser Etaśa  To travel through the realm of air.

9.63.d: उत तया हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे | इन्दुरिन्द्र इतिब्रुवन ||
9.63.e: And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might come  Indu, he said, is Indra's self.

9.63.d: परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इन्द्राय मत्सरम | अव्यो वारेषुसिञ्चत ||
9.63.e: Hence, singers, pour the gladdeningjuice to Vāyu and to Indra, pour  The drops upon the fleecy cloth.

9.63.d: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरम | यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता ||
9.63.e: O Soma Pavamana, find wealth for us not to be assailed,  Wealth which the foeman may not win.

9.63.d: अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम | अभि वाजमुत शरवः ||
9.63.e: Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine,  Send spoil of war and high renown.

9.63.d: सोमो देवो न सूर्यो.अद्रिभिः पवते सुतः | दधानः कलशे रसम ||
9.63.e: Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Sūrya, floweth on his way,  Pouring the juice within the jar.

9.63.d: एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा रतस्य धारया | वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन ||
9.63.e: These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice,  Worshipful laws and strength in kine.

9.63.d: सुता इन्द्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः | पवित्रमत्यक्षरन ||
9.63.e: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk,  Effused for Indra Thunder-armed.

9.63.d: पर सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ | मदो यो देववीतमः ||
9.63.e: Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods,  Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth.

9.63.d: तमी मर्जन्त्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम | इन्दुमिन्द्रायमत्सरम ||
9.63.e: For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams, Indu, the giver of delight.

9.63.d: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत सोम वीरवत | वाजं गोमन्तमा भर ||
9.63.e: Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons,  Bring hither strength in herds of kine.

9.63.d: परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत | इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमम ||
9.63.e: For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs.  For battle as it were in war.

9.63.d: कविं मर्जन्ति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः | वर्षा कनिक्रदर्षति ||
9.63.e: The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs:  Loud bellowing the Steer comes on,

9.63.d: वर्षणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोमं रतस्य धारया | मती विप्राः समस्वरन ||
9.63.e: The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice,  Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar.

9.63.d: पवस्व देवायुषगिन्द्रं गछतु ते मदः | वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ||
9.63.e: God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice:  To Vāyu mount as Law commands

9.63.d: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम शरवाय्यम | परियः समुद्रमा विश ||
9.63.e: O Soma, Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown:  Enter the lake, as one we love.

9.63.d: अपघ्नन पवसे मर्धः करतुवित सोम मत्सरः | नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम ||
9.63.e: Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight:  Drive off the folk who love not Gods.

9.63.d: पवमाना अस्र्क्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः | अभि विश्वानिकाव्या ||
9.63.e: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice,  For holy lore of every kind.

9.63.d: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा अस्र्ग्रमिन्दवः | घनन्तो विश्वा अप दविषः ||
9.63.e: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops,  Driving all enemies afar.

9.63.d: पवमना दिवस पर्यन्तरिक्षादस्र्क्षत | पर्थिव्या अधि सानवि ||
9.63.e: From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamana been effused  Upon the summit of the earth.

9.63.d: पुनानः सोम धारयेन्दो विश्वा अप सरिधः | जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ||
9.63.e: O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy stream  All foes, all Rākṣasas away.

9.63.d: अपघ्नन सोम रक्षसो.अभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत | दयुमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम ||
9.63.e: Driving the Rākṣasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for us  Most excellent and splendid strength.

9.63.d: अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा | इन्दो विश्वानिवार्या ||
9.63.e: Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earih and heaven,  Indu, all boons to be desired.

9.64.d: वर्षा सोम दयुमानसि वर्षा देव वर्षव्रतः | वर्षा धर्माणि दधिषे ||
9.64.e: Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steerlike sway:  Thou as a Steer ordainest laws.

9.64.d: वर्ष्णस्ते वर्ष्ण्यं शवो वर्षा वनं वर्षा मदः | सत्यं वर्षन वर्षेदसि ||
9.64.e: Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steerstrong thywood, steer-like thy drink  A Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.

9.64.d: अश्वो न चक्रदो वर्षा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः | वि नो राये दुरो वर्धि ||
9.64.e: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine:  Unbar for us the doors to wealth.

9.64.d: अस्र्क्षत पर वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया | शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ||
9.64.e: Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops,  Brilliant and swift, have been effused.

9.64.d: शुम्भमाना रतायुभिर्म्र्ज्यमाना गभस्त्योः | पवन्ते वारेव्यये ||
9.64.e: They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men,  Flow onward to the fleecy cloth.

9.64.d: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा | पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ||
9.64.e: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper  From heaven and earth and firmament.

9.64.d: पवमानस्य विश्ववित पर ते सर्गा अस्र्क्षत | सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ||
9.64.e: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Finder of all, have been effused,  Even as Sūrya's rays of light.

9.64.d: केतुं कर्ण्वन दिवस परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि | समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ||
9.64.e: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form  Soma, thou swellest like a sea.

9.64.d: हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि | अक्रान देवो नसूर्यः ||
9.64.e: Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana; thou hast moved,  Like the God Sūrya, to the sieve.

9.64.d: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः परियः कवीनां मती | सर्जदश्वं रथीरिव ||
9.64.e: Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns:  So starts the charioteer his steed-

9.64.d: ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत | सीदन्न्र्तस्य योनिमा ||
9.64.e: Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive,  Alighting in the home of Law.

9.64.d: स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः | इन्दविन्द्रायपीतये ||
9.64.e: Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods,  Indu, to Indra for his drink.

9.64.d: इषे पवस्व धारया मर्ज्यमानो मनीषिभिः | इन्दो रुचाभिगा इहि ||
9.64.e: Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men:  Indu with sheen approach the milk.

9.64.d: पुनानो वरिवस कर्ध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः | हरे सर्जानाशिरम ||
9.64.e: While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk,  Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds.

9.64.d: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्क्र्तम | दयुतानो वाजिभिर्यतः ||
9.64.e: Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place,  Resplendent, guided by the strong.

9.64.d: पर हिन्वानास इन्दवो.अछा समुद्रमाशवः | धिया जूता अस्र्क्षत ||
9.64.e: Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juice  Have flowed, urged onward, to the lake.

9.64.d: मर्म्र्जानास आयवो वर्था समुद्रमिन्दवः | अग्मन्न्र्तस्य योनिमा ||
9.64.e: Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake,  Yea, to the place of sacrifice.

9.64.d: परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा | पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत ||
9.64.e: Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might:  Guard, hero like, our sheltering home.

9.64.d: मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान रक्वभिः | पर यत समुद्र आहितः ||
9.64.e: Loud neighs the Courser Etaśa, with singers, harnessed for the place,  Guided for travel to the lake.

9.64.d: आ यद योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुरतस्य सीदति | जहात्यप्रचेतसः ||
9.64.e: What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice,  He leaves the foolish far away.

9.64.d: अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षन्ति परचेतसः | मज्जन्त्यविचेतसः ||
9.64.e: The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice:  Down sink the unintelligent.

9.64.d: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः | रतस्य योनिमासदम ||
9.64.e: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets,  To sit in place of sacrifice.

9.64.d: तं तवा विप्रा वचोविदः परिष कर्ण्वन्ति वेधसः | सं तवा मर्जन्त्यायवः ||
9.64.e: Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well:  The living make thee beautiful.

9.64.d: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्ति वरुनः कवे | पवमानस्य मरुतः ||
9.64.e: Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine:  O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof.

9.64.d: तवं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि | इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसम ||
9.64.e: O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech.  Thousandfold, with the lore of hymns.

9.64.d: उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवम | पुनान इन्दवा भर ||
9.64.e: Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to us  Speech thousandfold that longs for war.

9.64.d: पुनान इन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम | परियः समुद्रमा विश ||
9.64.e: O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend.  Of these men enter thou the lake.

9.64.d: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कर्पा | सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ||
9.64.e: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly. And form that utters loud acclaim.

9.64.d: हिन्वानो हेत्र्भिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत | सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ||
9.64.e: Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil,  Like warriors when they stand arrayed.

9.64.d: रधक सोम सवस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः | पवस्व सूर्योद्र्शे ||
9.64.e: Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us,  Flow like the Sun for us to see.

9.65.d: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः सवसारो जामयस पतिम | महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ||
9.65.e: THE, glittering maids send Sūra forth, the glorious sisters, close-allied,  Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.

9.65.d: पवमान रुचा-रुचा देवो देवेभ्यस परि | विश्वा वसून्याविश ||
9.65.e: Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light,  God, coming hither from the Gods.

9.65.d: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वर्ष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः | इषे पवस्व संयतम ||
9.65.e: Pour on us, Pavamana, rain, as service and rain praise for Gods:  Pour all to be our nourishment.

9.65.d: वर्षा हयसि भानुना दयुमन्तं तवा हवामहे | पवमान सवाध्यः ||
9.65.e: Thou art a Steer by lustre: we, O Pavamana, faithfully  Call upon thee the Splendid One.

9.65.d: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः सवायुध | इहो षविन्दवा गहि ||
9.65.e: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength:  O Indu, come thou bitherward.

9.65.d: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मर्ज्यमानो गभस्त्योः | दरुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे ||
9.65.e: When thou art cleansed with both the hands and dipped in waters, with the wood.  Thou comest to the gathering-place.

9.65.d: पर सोमाय वयश्ववत पवमानाय गायत | महे सहस्रचक्षसे ||
9.65.e: Sing forth your songs, as Vyaśva sang, to Soma Pavamana, to,  The Mighty One with thousand eyes;

9.65.d: यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः | इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ||
9.65.e: Whose coloured sap they drive with stones, the yellow meath-distilling juice,  Indu for Indra, for his drink.

9.65.d: तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः | सखित्वमा वर्णीमहे ||
9.65.e: We seek to gain the friendly love of thee that Strong and Mighty One,  Of thee the winner of all wealth.

9.65.d: वर्षा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः | विश्वा दधान ओजसा ||
9.65.e: Flow onward with thy stream, a Steer, inspiriting the Maruts’ Lord,  Winning all riches by thy might.

9.65.d: तं तवा धर्तारमोण्योः पवमान सवर्द्र्शम | हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम ||
9.65.e: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, Strong,  Sustainer, looker on the light.

9.65.d: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया | युजं वाजेषु चोदय ||
9.65.e: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawny-coloured, with thy stream  Incite to battle thine ally.

9.65.d: आ न इन्दो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः | अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित ||
9.65.e: O Indu, visible to all pour out for us abundant food:  Soma, be thou our prosperer.

9.65.d: आ कलशा अनूषतेन्दो धाराभिरोजसा | एन्द्रस्य पीतयेविश ||
9.65.e: The pitchers, Indu, with thy streams have sung aloud in vigorous might  Enter them, and let Indra drink.

9.65.d: यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः | स पवस्वाभिमातिहा ||
9.65.e: O thou whose potent gladdening juice they milk out with the stones, flow on,  Destroyer of our enemies.

9.65.d: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि | अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ||
9.65.e: King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf,  To travel through the firmament.

9.65.d: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं सवश्व्यम | वहा भगत्तिमूतये ||
9.65.e: Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds,  The gift of fortune for our help.

9.65.d: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर | सुष्वाणो देववीतये ||
9.65.e: Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might, and speed,  Like beauty for a brilliant show.

9.65.d: अर्षा सोम दयुमत्तमो.अभि दरोणानि रोरुवत | सीदञ्छ्येनोन योनिमा ||
9.65.e: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the wooden vats,  Falcon-like resting in thine home.

9.65.d: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः | सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ||
9.65.e: Soma, the Water-winner flows to Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa,  To Viṣṇu and the Marut host.

9.65.d: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः | आ पवस्वसहस्रिणम ||
9.65.e: Soma , bestowing food upon our progeny, from every sides,  Pour on us riches thousandfold

9.65.d: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे | ये वादः शर्यणावति ||
9.65.e: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand,  Or there on Śaryaṇāvān's bank,

9.65.d: य आर्जीकेषु कर्त्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम | ये वा जनेषुपञ्चसु ||
9.65.e: Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in men's homes,  Or pressed among the Races Five-

9.65.d: ते नो वर्ष्टिं दिवस परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम | सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ||
9.65.e: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow,  Rain from the heavens apd hero strength.

9.65.d: पवते हर्यतो हरिर्ग्र्णानो जमदग्निना | हिन्वानो गोरधित्वचि ||
9.65.e: Urged forward o’er the ox-hide flows the Lovely One of tawny hue,  Lauded by Jamadagni's song.

9.65.d: पर शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः | शरीणानाप्सु मर्ञ्जत ||
9.65.e: Like horses urged to speed, the drops, bright, stirring vital power, when blent  With milk, are beautified in streams.

9.65.d: तं तवा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये | स पवस्वानया रुचा ||
9.65.e: So they who toil with juices send thee forward for the Gods’ repast:  So with this splendour flow thou on.

9.65.d: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वर्णीमहे | पान्तमापुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.65.e: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the Strong, that brings us bliss,  The Guardian, the desire of all,

9.65.d: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम | पान्तमा पुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.65.e: The Excellent, the Gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands,  The Guardian, the desire of all;

9.65.d: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा | पान्तमा पुरुस्प्र्हम ||
9.65.e: Who for ourselves, O thou Most Wise, is wealth and fair intelligence,  The Guardian, the desire of all.

9.66.d: पवस्व विश्वचर्षणे.अभि विश्वानि काव्या | सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ||
9.66.e: FOR holy lore of every sort, flow onward thou whom all men love.  A Friend to be besought by friends.

9.66.d: ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी | परतीची सोम तस्थतुः ||
9.66.e: O'er all thou rulest with these Two which, Soma Pavamana, stand,  Turned, as thy stations, hitherward.

9.66.d: परि धामानि यानि ते तवं सोमासि विश्वतः पवमान रतुभिः कवे ||
9.66.e: Wise Soma Pavamana, thou encompassest on every side  Thy stations as the seasons come.

9.66.d: पवस्व जनयन्निषो.अभि विश्वानि वार्या | सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये ||
9.66.e: Flow onward, generating food, for precious boons of every kind,  A Friend for friends, to be our help.

9.66.d: तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस पर्ष्ठे वि तन्वते | पवित्रं सोम धामभिः ||
9.66.e: Upon the lofty ridge of heaven thy bright rays with their essences,  Soma, spread purifying power.

9.66.d: तवेमे सप्त सिन्धवः परशिषं सोम सिस्रते | तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ||
9.66.e: O Soma, these Seven Rivers flow, as being thine, to give command:  The Streams of milk run forth to thee.

9.66.d: पर सोम याहि धारया सुत इन्द्राय मत्सरः | दधानो अक्षिति शरवः ||
9.66.e: Flow onward, Soma in a stream, effused to gladden Indra's heart,  Bringing imperishable fame.

9.66.d: समु तवा धीभिरस्वरन हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः | विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः ||
9.66.e: Driving thee in Vivasvān's course, the Seven Sisters with their hymns  Made melody round thee the Sage.

9.66.d: मर्जन्ति तवा समग्रुवो.अव्ये जीरावधि षवनि | रेभो यदज्यसे वने ||
9.66.e: The virgins deck thee o’er fresh streams to drive thee to the sieve when thou,  A singer, bathest in the wood.

9.66.d: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन सर्गा अस्र्क्षत | अर्वन्तो न शरवस्यवः ||
9.66.e: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, Mighty One, have pouredthem forth.  Like coursers eager for renown.

9.66.d: अछा कोशं मधुश्चुतमस्र्ग्रं वारे अव्यये | अवावशन्तधीतयः ||
9.66.e: They have been poured upon the fleece towards the meath-distilling vat:  The holy songs have sounded forth.

9.66.d: अछा समुद्रमिन्दवो.अस्तं गावो न धेनवः | अग्मन्न्र्तस्य योनिमा ||
9.66.e: Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake,  Have reached the place of sacrifice.

9.66.d: पर ण इन्दो महे रण आपो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः | यद गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ||
9.66.e: O Indu, to our great delight the running waters flow to us,  When thou wilt robe thyself in milk.

9.66.d: अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षन्तस्त्वोतयः | इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ||
9.66.e: In this thy friendship, and with thee to help us, fain to sacrifice,  Indu, we crave thy friendly love.

9.66.d: आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नर्चक्षसे | एन्द्रस्य जठरेविश ||
9.66.e: Flow on, O Soma, for the great Viewer of men, for gain of Idne  Enter thou into Indra's throat.

9.66.d: महानसि सोम जयेष्ठ उग्राणामिन्द ओजिष्ठः | युध्वा सञ्छश्वज्जिगेथ ||
9.66.e: Best art thou, Soma, of the great, Strongest of strong ones, Indu: thou  As Warrior ever hast prevailed.

9.66.d: य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयाञ्छूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः | भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन मंहीयान ||
9.66.e: Mightier even than the strong, more valiant even than the brave,  More libpral than the bountiful,

9.66.d: तवं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनाम | वर्णीमहे सख्याय वर्णीमहे युज्याय ||
9.66.e: Soma, as Sūra, bring us food, win offspring of our bodies: we  Elect thee for our friendship, we elect thee for companionship.

9.66.d: अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः | आरे बाधस्व दुछुनाम ||
9.66.e: Agni, thou pourest life; send down upon us food and vigorous strength;  Drive thou misfortune far away,

9.66.d: अग्निरषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः | तमीमहेमहागयम ||
9.66.e: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the Races Five:  To him whose wealth is great we pray.

9.66.d: अग्ने पवस्व सवपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम | दधद रयिं मयि पोषम ||
9.66.e: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us,  Granting me wealth that nourishes.

9.66.d: पवमानो अति सरिधो.अभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिम | सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः ||
9.66.e: Beyond his enemies away to sweet praise Pavamana flows,  Like Sūrya visible to all.

9.66.d: स मर्म्र्जान आयुभिः परयस्वान परयसे हितः | इन्दुरत्योविचक्षणः ||
9.66.e: Adorned by living men, set forth for entertainment, rich in food,  Far-sighted Indu is a Steed.

9.66.d: पवमान रतं बर्हच्छुक्रं जयोतिरजीजनत | कर्ष्णा तमांसि जङघनत ||
9.66.e: He, Pavamana, hath produced the lofty Law, the brilliant light,  Destroying darkness black of hue.

9.66.d: पवमानस्य जङघनतो हरेश्चन्द्रा अस्र्क्षत | जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ||
9.66.e: From tawny Pavamana, the Destroyer, radiant streams have sprung,  Quick streams from him whose gleams are swift.

9.66.d: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः | हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ||
9.66.e: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise mid beauteous ones,  Gold-gleaming with the Marut host,

9.66.d: पवमानो वयश्नवद रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः | दधत सतोत्रेसुवीर्यम ||
9.66.e: May Pavamana, best to win the booty, penetrate with rays,  Giving the singer hero strength.

9.66.d: पर सुवान इन्दुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययम | पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ||
9.66.e: Over the fleecy sieve hath flowed the drop effused: to Indra comes  Indu while he is purified

9.66.d: एष सोमो अधि तवचि गवां करीळत्यद्रिभिः | इन्द्रं मदाय जोहुवत ||
9.66.e: This Soma, through the pressing-stones, is sporting on the oxhide, and  Summoning Indra to the draught.

9.66.d: यस्य ते दयुम्नवत पयः पवमानाभ्र्तं दिवः | तेन नो मर्ळ जीवसे ||
9.66.e: O Pavamana, bless us, so that we may live, with that bright milk  Of thine which hath been brought from heaven.

9.67.d: तवं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे | पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ||
9.67.e: THOU, Soma, hast a running stream, joyous, most strong at sacrifice:  Flow bounteously bestowing wealth.

9.67.d: तवं सुतो नर्मादनो दधन्वान मत्सरिन्तमः | इन्द्राय सूरिरन्धसा ||
9.67.e: Effused as cheerer of the men, flowing best gladdener, thou art  A Prince to Indra with thy juice.

9.67.d: तवं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत | दयुमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम ||
9.67.e: Poured forth by pressing-stones, do thou with loud roar send us in a stream  Most excellent illustrious might.

9.67.d: इन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया | हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत ||
9.67.e: Indu, urged forward, floweth through the fleecy cloth: the Tawny One  With his loud roar hath brought as strength.

9.67.d: इन्दो वयव्यमर्षसि वि शरवांसि वि सौभगा | वि वाजांसोम गोमतः ||
9.67.e: Indu, thou flowest through the fleece, bringing felicities and fame,  And, Soma, spoil and wealth in kine.

9.67.d: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम | भरा सोम सहस्रिणम ||
9.67.e: Hither, O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds and cattle hundredfold:  Bring wealth, O Soma, thousandfold.

9.67.d: पवमानास इन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः | इन्द्रं यामेभिराशत ||
9.67.e: In purifying, through the sieve the rapid drops of'Soma juice  Come nigh to Indra in their course.

9.67.d: ककुहः सोम्यो रस इन्दुरिन्द्राय पूर्व्यः | आयुः पवत आयवे ||
9.67.e: For Indra floweth excellent Indu, the noblest Soma juice  The Living for the Living One.

9.67.d: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम | अभि गिरा समस्वरन ||
9.67.e: The glittering maids send Sūra forth they with their song have sung aloud  To Pavamana dropping meath.

9.67.d: अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनि-यामनि | आ भक्षत कन्यासु नः ||
9.67.e: May Pūṣan, drawn by goats, be our protector, and on all his paths  Bestow on us our share of maids.

9.67.d: अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घर्तं न पवते मधु | आ भक्षत कन्यासु नः ||
9.67.e: This Soma flows like gladdening oil for him who wears the braided locks:  He shall give us our share of maids.

9.67.d: अयं त आघ्र्णे सुतो घर्तं न पवते शुचि | आ भक्षत कन्यासु नः ||
9.67.e: This Soma juice, O glowing God, flows like pure oil, effused for thee:  He shall give us our share of maids.

9.67.d: वाचो जन्तुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया | देवेषु रत्नधा असि ||
9.67.e: Flow onward, Soma, in thy stream, begetter of the sages' speech:  Wealth-giver among Gods art thou.

9.67.d: आ कलशेषु धावति शयेनो वर्म वि गाहते | अभि दरोणा कनिक्रदत ||
9.67.e: The Falcon dips within the jars: he wrapḥim in his robe and goes  Loud roaring to the vats of wood.

9.67.d: परि पर सोम ते रसो.असर्जि कलशे सुतः | शयेनो न तक्तोर्षति ||
9.67.e: Soma, thy juice hath been effused and poured into the pitcher: like  A rapid hawk it rushes on.

9.67.d: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ||
9.67.e: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight.

9.67.d: अस्र्ग्रन देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ||
9.67.e: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots that display their strength.

9.67.d: ते सुतासो मदिन्तमाः शुक्रा वायुमस्र्क्षत ||
9.67.e: Brilliant, best givers of delight, these juices have sent Vāyu forth.

9.67.d: गराव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गछसि | दधत सतोत्रे सुवीर्यम ||
9.67.e: Bruised by the press-stones and extolled, Soma, thou goest to the sieve,  Giving the worshipper hero strength.

9.67.d: एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते | रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम ||
9.67.e: This juice bruised by the pressing-stones and lauded passes through the sieve,  Slayer of demons, through the fleece.

9.67.d: यदन्ति यच्च दूरके भयं विन्दति मामिह | पवमानवि तज्जहि ||
9.67.e: O Pavamana, drive away the danger, whether near at hand  Or far remote, that finds me here.

9.67.d: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः | यः पोतास पुनातु नः ||
9.67.e: This day may Pavamana cleanse us with his purifying power,  Most active purifying Priest.

9.67.d: यत ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा | बरह्म तेन पुनीहि नः ||
9.67.e: O Agni, with the cleansing light diffused through all thy fiery glow,  Purify thou this prayer of ours.

9.67.d: यत ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः | बरह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः ||
9.67.e: Cleanse us with thine own cleansing power, O Agni, that is bright with flame,  And by libations poured to thee.

9.67.d: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च | मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ||
9.67.e: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power,  Purify me on every side.

9.67.d: तरिभिष टवं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः | अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः ||
9.67.e: Cleanse us, God Savitar, with Three, O Soma, with sublimest forms,  Agni, with forms of power and might.

9.67.d: पुनन्तु मां देवजनाः पुनन्तु वसवो धिया | विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ||
9.67.e: May the Gods’ company make me clean, and Vasus make rue pure by song.  Purify me, ye General Gods; O Jātavedas, make me pure.

9.67.d: पर पयायस्व पर सयन्दस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः | देवेभ्य उत्तमं हविः ||
9.67.e: Fill thyself full of juice, flow forth, O Soma, thou with all thy stalks,  The best oblation to the Gods.

9.67.d: उप परियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीव्र्धम | अगन्म बिभ्रतोनमः ||
9.67.e: We with our homage have approached the Friend who seeks our wondering praise,  Young, strengthener of the solemn rite.

9.67.d: अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम | आखुं चिदेव देव सोम ||
9.67.e: Lost is Alayya's axe. O Soma, God do thou send it back hither in thy flow  Even, Soma, God, if ’twere a mole.

9.67.d: यः पावमानीरध्येत्य रषिभिः सम्भ्र्तं रसम | सर्वंस पूतमश्नाति सवदितं मातरिश्वना ||
9.67.e: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,  Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Mātariśvan's touch.

9.67.d: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्य रषिभिः सम्भ्र्तं रसम | तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे कषीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम ||
9.67.e: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns,  Sarasvatī draws forth for him water and butter, milk and meath.

9.68.d: पर देवमछा मधुमन्त इन्दवो.असिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः | बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रियानिर्णिजं धिरे ||
9.68.e: THE drops of Soma juice like cows who yield their milk have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the Shining One,  And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the udders stream.

9.68.d: स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः शरथयन सवादतेहरिः | तिरः पवित्रमप्रियन्नुरु जरयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरम ||
9.68.e: He bellows with a roar arourd the highest twigs: the Tawny One is sweetened as he breaks them up.  Then passing through the sieve into the ample room, the God throws off the dregs according to his wish.

9.68.d: वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंव्र्धा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता | मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे ||
9.68.e: The gladdening drink that measured out the meeting Twins fills full with milk the Eternal Ever-waxing Pair.  Bringing to light the Two great Regions limitless, moving above them he gained sheen that never fades.

9.68.d: स मातरा विचरन वाजयन्नपः पर मेधिरः सवधया पिन्वते पदम | अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नर्भिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः ||
9.68.e: Wandering through, the Parents, strengthening the floods, the Sage makes his place swell with his own native might.  The stalk is mixed with grain: he comes led by the men together with the sisters, and preserves the Head.

9.68.d: सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविरतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः | यूना ह सन्ता परथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतम ||
9.68.e: With energetic intellect the Sage is born, deposited as germ of Law, far from the Twins.  They being young at first showed visibly distinct the Creature that is half-concealed and half-exposed.

9.68.d: मन्द्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः शयेनो यदन्धो अभरत परावतः | तं मर्जयन्त सुव्र्धं नदीष्वा उशन्तमंशुं परियन्तं रग्मियम ||
9.68.e: The sages knew the form of him the Gladdener, what time the Falcon brought the plant from far away.  Him who assures success they beautified in streams, the stalk who yearned therefor, mighty and meet for praise.

9.68.d: तवां मर्जन्ति दश योषणः सुतं सोम रषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितम | अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्न्र्भिर्यतोवाजमा दर्षि सातये ||
9.68.e: Together with the Ṛṣis, with their prayers and hymns ten women deck thee, Soma, friendly when effused.  Led by the men, with invocations of the Gods, through the fleece, thou hast given us strength to win the spoil.

9.68.d: परिप्रयन्तं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत सतुभः | यो धारया मधुमानूर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळ अमर्त्यः ||
9.68.e: Songs resonant with praise have celebrated him. Soma, Friend, springing forth with his fair company.  Even him who rich in meath, with undulating stream, Winnner of Wealth, Immortal, sends his voice from heaven,

9.68.d: अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति | अद्भिर्गोभिर्म्र्ज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इन्दुर्वरिवो विदत परियम ||
9.68.e: He sends it into all the region forth from heaven. Soma, while he is filtcred, settles in the jars.  With milk and waters is he decked when pressed with stones: Indu, when purified, shall find sweet rest and room.

9.68.d: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व | अद्वेषे दयावाप्र्थिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम ||
9.68.e: Even thus poured forth How on thy way, O Soma, vouchsafing us most manifold lively vigour.  We will invoke benevolent Earth and Heaven. Give us, ye Gods, riches with noble heroes.

9.69.d: इषुर्न धन्वन परति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि | उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य वरतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते ||
9.69.e: LAID like an arrow on the bow the hymn hath been loosed like a young calf to the udder of its dam.  As one who cometh first with full stream she is milked the Soma is impelled to this man's holy rites.

9.69.d: उपो मतिः पर्च्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि | पवमानः सन्तनिः परघ्नतामिव मधुमान दरप्सः परि वारमर्षति ||
9.69.e: The thought is deeply fixed; the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth;  And Pavamana, like the shout of combatants, the drop rising in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.

9.69.d: अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि तवचि शरथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेरतं यते | हरिरक्रान यजतः संयतो मदो नर्म्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते ||
9.69.e: He flows about the sheep-skin, longing for a bride: he looses Aditi's Daughters for the worshipper.  The sacred drink hath come, gold-tinted, well-restrained: like a strong Bull he shines, whetting his manly might.

9.69.d: उक्षा मिमाति परति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्क्र्तम | अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तम्परि सोमो अव्यत ||
9.69.e: The Bull is bellowing; the Cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place.  Onward hath Soma passed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as ’twere, endued a garment newly washed.

9.69.d: अम्र्क्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि वयत | दिवस पर्ष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कर्तोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयम ||
9.69.e: The golden-hued, Immortal, newly bathed, puts on a brightly shining vesture that is never harmed.  He made the ridge of heaven to be his radiant robe, by sprinkling of the bowls from moisture of the sky.

9.69.d: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो दरावयित्नवो मत्सरासः परसुपः साकमीरते | तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्राद रते पवते धाम किं चन ||
9.69.e: Even as the beams of Sūrya, urging men to speed, that cheer and send to sleep, together rush they forth,  These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.

9.69.d: सिन्धोरिव परवणे निम्न आशवो वर्षच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत | शं नो निवेशे दविपदे चतुष्पदे.अस्मे वाजः सोम तिष्ठन्तु कर्ष्टयः ||
9.69.e: As down the steep slope of a river to the vale, drawn from the Steer the swift strong draughts have found a way.  Well be it with the men and cattle in our home. May powers, O Soma, may the people stay with us.

9.69.d: आ नः पवस्व वसुमद धिरण्यवदश्वावद गोमद यवमत सुवीर्यम | यूयं हि सोम पितरो मम सथन दिवो मूर्धानःप्रस्थिता वयस्क्र्तः ||
9.69.e: Pour out upon us wealth in goods, in gold, in steeds, in cattle and in corn, and great heroic strength.  Ye, Soma, are my Fathers, lifted up on high as heads of heaven and makers of the strength of life.

9.69.d: एते सोमाः पवमानास इन्द्रं रथा इव पर ययुः सातिमछ | सुताः पवित्रमति यन्त्यव्यं हित्वी वव्रिं हरितोव्र्ष्तिमछ ||
9.69.e: These Pavamanas here, these drops of Soma, to Indra have sped forth like cars to booty.  Effused, they pass the cleansing fleece, while, gold-hued, they cast their covering off to pour the rain down.

9.69.d: इन्दविन्द्राय बर्हते पवस्व सुम्र्ळीको अनवद्यो रिशादाः | भरा चन्द्राणि गर्णते वसूनि देवैर्द्यावाप्र्थिवी परावतं नः ||
9.69.e: O Indu, flow thou on for lofty Indra, flow blameless, very gracious, foe-destroyer.  Bring splendid treasures to the man who lauds thee. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect. us.

9.70.d: तरिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रे सत्यामाशिरं पूर्व्ये वयोमनि | चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यद रतैरवर्धत ||
9.70.e: THE three times seven Milch-kine in the eastern heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught.  Four other beauteous Creatures hath he made for his adornment, when he waxed in strength through holy rites.

9.70.d: स भिक्षमाणो अम्र्तस्य चारुण उभे दयावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे | तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि वयत यदी देवस्य शरवसा सदो विदुः ||
9.70.e: Longing for lovely Amṛta, by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven.  He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they found the God's resting-place.

9.70.d: ते अस्य सन्तु केतवो.अम्र्त्यवो.अदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु | येभिर्न्र्म्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद राजानं मनना अग्र्भ्णत ||
9.70.e: May those his brilliant rays he ever free from death, inviolate, for both classes of created things,—  Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified. Yea, even for this have sageswelcomed him as King.

9.70.d: स मर्ज्यमानो दशभिः सुकर्मभिः पर मध्यमासु मात्र्षुप्रमे सचा | वरतानि पानो अम्र्तस्व चारुण उभे नर्चक्षानु पश्यते विशौ ||
9.70.e: He, while he is adorned by the ten skilful ones, that he too in the Midmost Mothers may create,  While he is watching o’er the lovely Amṛta's ways, looks on both races as Beholder of mankind.

9.70.d: स मर्म्र्जान इन्द्रियाय धायस ओभे अन्ता रोदसी हर्षते हितः | वर्षा शुष्मेण बाधते वि दुर्मतीरादेदिशानः शर्यहेव शुरुधः ||
9.70.e: He, while he is adorned to stream forth mighty strength, rejoices in his place between the earth and heaven.  The Steer dispels the evil-hearted with his might, aiming at offerings as an archer at the game.

9.70.d: स मातरा न दद्र्शान उस्रियो नानददेति मरुतामिव सवनः | जानन्न्र्तं परथमं यत सवर्णरं परशस्तये कमव्र्णीत सुक्रतुः ||
9.70.e: Beholding, as it were, Two Mother Cows, the Steer goes roaring on his way even as the Maruts roar.  Knowing Eternal Law, the earliest light of heaven, he, passing wise, was chosen out to tell it forth.

9.70.d: रुवति भीमो वर्षभस्तविष्यया शर्ङगे शिशानो हरिणीविचक्षणः | आ योनिं सोमः सुक्र्तं नि षीदति गव्ययीत्वग भवति निर्णिगव्ययी ||
9.70.e: The fearful Bull is bellowing with violent might, far-sighted, sharpening his yellowcoloured horns.  Soma assumes his seat in the well-fashioned place: the cowhide and the sheepskin are his ornament.

9.70.d: शुचिः पुनानस्तन्वमरेपसमव्ये हरिर्न्यधाविष्ट सानवि | जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे तरिधातु मधु करियते सुकर्मभिः ||
9.70.e: Bright, making pure his body free from spot and stain, on the sheep's back the Golden-coloured hath flowed down.  Acceptable to Mitra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, he is prepared as threefold meal by skilful men.

9.70.d: पवस्व सोम देववीतये वर्षेन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश | पुरा नो बाधाद दुरिताति पारय कषेत्रविद धि दिश आहा विप्र्छते ||
9.70.e: Flow on for the God's banquet, Soma, as a Steer, and enter Indra's heart, the Soma's reservoir.  Bear us beyond misfortune ere we be oppres. sed. the man who knows the land directs the man who asks.

9.70.d: हितो न सप्तिरभि वाजमर्षेन्द्रस्येन्दो जठरमा पवस्व | नावा न सिन्धुमति पर्षि विद्वाञ्छूरो न युध्यन्नव नो निद सपः ||
9.70.e: Urged like a car-steed flow to strength, O Soma: Indu, flow onward to the throat of Indra.  Skilled, bear us past, as in a boat o’er water: as battling Hero save us from the foeman.

9.71.d: आ दक्षिणा सर्ज्यते शुष्म्यासदं वेति दरुहो रक्षसः पाति जाग्र्विः | हरिरोपशं कर्णुते नभस पय उपस्तिरे चम्वोर्ब्रह्म निर्णिजे ||
9.71.e: THE guerdon is bestowed: the Mighty takes his Seat, and, ever-Watchful, guards from fiend and evil sprite.  Gold-hued, he makes the cloud his diadem, the milk his carpet in both worlds, and prayer his robe of state.

9.71.d: पर करिष्टिहेव शूष एति रोरुवदसुर्यं वर्णं नि रिणीते अस्य तम | जहाति वव्रिं पितुरेति निष्क्र्तमुपप्रुतं कर्णुते निर्णिजं तना ||
9.71.e: Strong, bellowing, he goes, like one who slays the folk; he lets this hue of Asuras flow off from him,  Throws off his covering, seeks his father's meeting-place, and thus makes for himself the bright robe he assumes.

9.71.d: अद्रिभिः सुतः पवते गभस्त्योर्व्र्षायते नभसा वेपते मती | स मोदते नसते साधते गिरा नेनिक्ते अप्सु यजते परीमणि ||
9.71.e: Onward he flows, from both the hands, pressed out with stones: excited by the prayer, the water makes him wild.  He frolics and draws near, completes his work with song, and bathes in streams to satisfy the worshipper.

9.71.d: परि दयुक्षं सहसः पर्वताव्र्धं मध्वः सिञ्चन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिम | आ यस्मिन गावः सुहुताद ऊधनि मूर्धंछ्रीणन्त्यग्रियं वरीमभिः ||
9.71.e: They pour out meath around the Master of the house, Celestial Strengthener of the mountain that gives might;  In whom, through his great powers, oblation-eating cows in their uplifted udder mix their choicest milk.

9.71.d: समी रथं न भुरिजोरहेषत दश सवसारो अदितेरुपस्थ आ | जिगादुप जरयति गोरपीच्यं पदं यदस्य मतुथा अजीजनन ||
9.71.e: They, the ten sisters, on the lap of Aditi, have sent him forward like a car from both the arms.  He wanders and comes near the Cow's mysterious place, even the place which his inventions have produced.

9.71.d: शयेनो न योनिं सदनं धिया कर्तं हिरण्ययमासदं देव एषति | ए रिणन्ति बर्हिषि परियं गिराश्वो न देवानप्येति यज्ञियः ||
9.71.e: Like as a falcon to his home, so speeds the God to his own golden wisely-tashioned place to rest.  With song they urge the darling to the sacred grass: the Holy One goes like a courser to the Gods.

9.71.d: परा वयक्तो अरुषो दिवः कविर्व्र्षा तरिप्र्ष्ठो अनविष्टगा अभि | सहस्रणीतिर्यतिः परायती रेभो न पूर्वीरुषसो वि राजति ||
9.71.e: From far away, from heaven, the redhued noted Sage, Steer of the triple height, hath sung unto the kine.  With thousand guidings he, leading this way and that, shines, as a singer, splendidly through many a morn.

9.71.d: तवेषं रूपं कर्णुते वर्णो अस्य स यत्राशयत सम्र्ता सेधति सरिधः | अप्सा याति सवधया दैव्यं जनं सं सुष्टुती नसते सं गोग्रया ||
9.71.e: His covering assumes a radiant hue; where’er he comes into the fight he drives the foe afar.  The Winner of the Floods, with food he seeks the host of heaven, he comes to praises glorified with milk.

9.71.d: उक्षेव यूथा परियन्नरावीदधि तविषीरधित सूर्यस्य | दिव्यः सुपर्णो.अव चक्षत कषां सोमः परि करतुना पश्यते जाः ||
9.71.e: Like a bull roaming round the herds he bellows: he hath assumed the brilliancy of Sūrya.  Down to the earth hath looked the heavenly Falcon: Soma with wisdom views all living creatures.

9.72.d: हरिं मर्जन्त्यरुषो न युज्यते सं धेनुभिः कलशे सोमो अज्यते | उद वाचमीरयति हिन्वते मती पुरुष्टुतस्य कति चित्परिप्रियः ||
9.72.e: THEY cleanse the Gold-hued: like a red Steed is he yoked, and Soma in the jar is mingled with the milk.  He sendeth out his voice, and many loving friends of him the highly lauded hasten with their songs.

9.72.d: साकं वदन्ति बहवो मनीषिण इन्द्रस्य सोमं जठरे यदादुहुः | यदी मर्जन्ति सुगभस्तयो नरः सनीळाभिर्दशभिः काम्यं मधु ||
9.72.e: The many sages utter words in unison, while into Indra's throat they pour the Soma juice,  When, with the ten that dwell together closely joined, the men whose hands are skilful cleanse the lovely meath.

9.72.d: अरममाणो अत्येति गा अभि सूर्यस्य परियं दुहितुस्तिरो रवम | अन्वस्मै जोषमभरद विनंग्र्सः सं दवयीभिः सवस्र्भिः कषेति जामिभिः ||
9.72.e: He goes upon his way, unresting, to the cows, over the roaring sound which Sarya's Daughter loves.  The Falcon brought it to him for his own delight: now with the twofold kindred sisters is his home.

9.72.d: नर्धूतो अद्रिषुतो बर्हिषि परियः पतिर्गवां परदिव इन्दुरतवियः | पुरन्धिवान मनुषो यज्ञसाधनः शुचिर्धियापवते सोम इन्द्र ते ||
9.72.e: Washed by the men, stone-pressed, dear on the holy grass, faithful to seasons, Lord of cattle from of old,  Most liberal, completing sacrifice for men, O Indra, pure bright Soma, Indu, flows for thee.

9.72.d: नर्बाहुभ्यां चोदितो धारया सुतो.अनुष्वधं पवते सोम इन्द्र ते | आप्राः करतून समजैरध्वरे मतीर्वेर्न दरुषच्चम्वोरासदद धरिः ||
9.72.e: O Indra, urged by arms of men and poured in streams, Soma flows on for thee afterḥis Godlike kind.  Plans thou fulfillest, gatherest thoughts for sacrifice: in the bowls sits the Gold-hued like a roosting bird.

9.72.d: अंशुं दुहन्ति सतनयन्तमक्षितं कविं कवयो.अपसो मनीषिणः | समी गावो मतयो यन्ति संयत रतस्य योना सदने पुनर्भुवः ||
9.72.e: Sages well-skilled in work, intelligent, drain out the stalk that roars, the Sage, the Everlasting One.  The milk, the hymns unite them with him in the place of sacrifice, his seat who is produced anew.

9.72.d: नाभा पर्थिव्या धरुणो महो दिवो.अपामूर्मौ सिन्धुष्वन्तरुक्षितः | इन्द्रस्य वज्रो वर्षभो विभूवसुः सोमो हर्देपवते चारु मत्सरः ||
9.72.e: Earth's central point, sustainer of the mighty heavens, distilled into the streams, into the waters' wave,  As Indra's thunderbolt, Steer with farspreading wealth, Soma is flowing on to make the heart rejoice.

9.72.d: स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रज सतोत्रे शिक्षन्नाधून्वते च सुक्रतो | मा नो निर्भाग वसुनः सादनस्प्र्शो रयिं पिशङगं बहुलं वसीमहि ||
9.72.e: Over the earthly region flow thou on thy way, helping the praiser and the pourer, thou Most Wise.  Let us not lack rich treasure reaching to our home, and may we clothe ourselves in manifold bright wealth.

9.72.d: आ तू न इन्दो शतदात्वश्व्यं सहस्रदातु पशुमद धिरण्यवत | उप मास्व बर्हती रेवतीरिषो.अधि सतोत्रस्य पवमान नो गहि ||
9.72.e: Hither, O Indu, unto us a hundred gifts of steeds, a thousand gifts of cattle and of gold,  Measure thou forth, yea, splendid ample strengthening food do thou, O Pavamana, heed this laud of ours.

9.73.d: सरक्वे दरप्सस्य धमतः समस्वरन्न्र्तस्य योना समरन्तनाभयः | तरीन स मूर्ध्नो असुरश्चक्र आरभे सत्यस्यनावः सुक्र्तमपीपरन ||
9.73.e: THEY from the spouting drop have sounded at the rim: naves speed together to the place of sacrifice.  That Asura hath formed, to seize, three lofty heights. The ships of truth have borne the pious man across.

9.73.d: सम्यक सम्यञ्चो महिषा अहेषत सिन्धोरूर्मावधि वेना अवीविपन | मधोर्धाराभिर्जनयन्तो अर्कमित परियामिन्द्रस्य तन्वमवीव्र्धन ||
9.73.e: The strong Steers, gathering, have duly stirred themselves,and over the stream's wave the friends sent forth the song.  Engendering the hymn, with flowing streams of meath, Indra's dear body have they caused to wax in strength.

9.73.d: पवित्रवन्तः परि वाचमासते पितैषां परत्नो अभि रक्षति वरतम | महः समुद्रं वरुणस्तिरो दधे धीरा इच्छेकुर्धरुणेष्वारभम ||
9.73.e: With sanctifying gear they sit around the song: their ancient Father guards their holy work from harm.  Varuṇa hath o’erspread the mighty sea of air. Sages had power to hold him in sustaining floods.

9.73.d: सहस्रधारे.अव ते समस्वरन दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः | अस्य सपशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदे-पदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवः ||
9.73.e: Sweet-tongued, exhaustless, they have sent their voices down togetlier, in heaven's vault that pours a thousand streams.  His wildly-restless warders never close an eye: in every place are found the bonds that bind man last.

9.73.d: पितुर्मातुरध्या ये समस्वरन्न्र्चा शोचन्तः सन्दहन्तो अव्रतान | इन्द्रद्विष्टामप धमन्ति मायया तवचमसिक्नीं भूमनो दिवस परि ||
9.73.e: O'er Sire and Mother they have roared in unison bright with the verse of praise, burning up riteless men,  Blowing away with supernatural might from earth and from the heavens the swarthy skin which Indra hates.

9.73.d: परत्नान मानादध्या ये समस्वरञ्छ्लोकयन्त्रासो रभसस्य मन्तवः | अपानक्षासो बधिरा अहासत रतस्य पन्थां न तरन्ति दुष्क्र्तः ||
9.73.e: Those which, as guides of song and counsellors of speed, were manifested from their ancient dwelling place,—  From these the eyeless and the deaf have turned aside: the wicked travel not the pathway of the Law.

9.73.d: सहस्रधारे वितते पवित्र आ वाचं पुनन्ति कवयो मनीषिणः | रुद्रास एषामिषिरासो अद्रुह सपशः सवञ्चः सुद्र्शो नर्चक्षसः ||
9.73.e: What time the filter with a thousand streams is stretched, the thoughtful sages purify their song therein.  Bright-coloured are their spies, vigorous, void of guile, excellent, fair to see, beholders of mankind.

9.73.d: रतस्य गोपा न दभाय सुक्रतुस्त्री ष पवित्रा हर्द्यन्तरा दधे | विद्वान स विश्वा भुवनाभि पश्यत्यवाजुष्टान विध्यति कर्ते अव्रतान ||
9.73.e: Guardian of Law, most wise, he may not be deceived: three Purifiers hath he set within his heart.  With wisdom he beholds all creatures that exist: he drives into the pit the hated riteliess ones.

9.73.d: रतस्य तन्तुर्विततः पवित्र आ जिह्वाया अग्रे वरुणस्य मायया | धीराश्चित तत समिनक्षन्त आशतात्रा कर्तमव पदात्यप्रभुह ||
9.73.e: The thread of sacrifice spun in the cleansing sieve, on Varuṇa's tongue-tip, by supernatural might,—  This, by their striving, have the prudent ones attained: he who hath not this power shall sink into the pit.

9.74.d: शिशुर्न जातो.अव चक्रदद वने सवर्यद वाज्यरुषः सिषासति | दिवो रेतसा सचते पयोव्र्धा तमीमहे सुमती शर्म सप्रथः ||
9.74.e: BORN like a youngling he hath clamoured in the wood, when he, the Red, the Strong, would win the light of heaven.  He comes with heavenly seed that makes the water swell: him for wide-spreading shelter we implore with prayer.

9.74.d: दिवो य सकम्भो धरुणः सवातत आपूर्णो अंशुः पर्येतिविश्वतः | सेमे मही रोदसी यक्षदाव्र्ता समीचीने दाधार समिषः कविः ||
9.74.e: A far-extended pillar that supports the sky the Soma-stalk, filled full, moves itself every way.  He shall bring both these great worlds while the rite proceeds: the Sage holds these who move! together and all food.

9.74.d: महि पसरः सुक्र्तं सोम्यं मधूर्वी गव्यूतिरदितेरतं यते | ईशे यो वर्ष्टेरित उस्रियो वर्षापां नेता य इतूतिरगमियः ||
9.74.e: Wide space hath he who follows Aditi's right path, and mighty, well-made food, meath blent with Soma juice;  He who from hence commands the rain, Steer of the kine, Leader of floods, who helps us hence, who claims our laud.

9.74.d: आत्मन्वन नभो दुह्यते घर्तं पय रतस्य नाभिरम्र्तं विजायते | समीचीनाः सुदानवः परीणन्ति तं नरो हितमव मेहन्ति पेरवः ||
9.74.e: Butter and milk are drawn from animated cloud; thence Amṛta is produced, centre of sacrifice.  Hini the Most Bounteous Ones, ever united, love; him as ouir Friend the Men who make all swell rain down.

9.74.d: अरावीदंशुः सचमान ऊर्मिणा देवाव्यं मनुषे पिन्वतित्वचम | दधाति गर्भमदितेरुपस्थ आ येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे ||
9.74.e: The Soma-stalk hath roared, following with the wave: he swells with sap for man the skin which Gods enjoy.  Upon the lap of Aditi he lays the germ, by means whereof we gain children and progeny.

9.74.d: सहस्रधारे.अव ता असश्चतस्त्र्तीये सन्तु रजसि परजावतीः | चतस्रो नाभो निहिता अवो दिवो हविर्भरन्त्यम्र्तं घर्तश्चुतः ||
9.74.e: In the third region which distils a thousand streams, may the Exhaustless Ones descend with procreant power.  The kindred Four have been sent downward from the heavens: dropping with oil they bring Amṛta and sacred gifts.

9.74.d: शवेतं रूपं कर्णुते यत सिषासति सोमो मीढ्वानसुरो वेद भूमनः | धिया शमी सचते सेमभि परवद दिवस कवन्धमव दर्षदुद्रिणम ||
9.74.e: Soma assumes white colour when he strives to gain: the bounteous Asura knows full many a precious boon.  Down the steep slope, through song, he comes to sacrifice, and he will burst the water-holding cask of heaven,

9.74.d: अध शवेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तं कार्ष्मन्ना वाज्यक्रमीत ससवान | आ हिन्विरे मनसा देवयन्तः कक्षीवते शतहिमाय गोनाम ||
9.74.e: Yea, to the shining milk-anointed beaker, as to his goal, hath stepped the conquering Courser.  Pious-souled men have sent their giffi of cattle unto Kakṣīvān of the hundred winters.

9.74.d: अद्भिः सोम पप्र्चानस्य ते रसो.अव्यो वारं वि पवमान धावति | स मर्ज्यमानः कविभिर्मदिन्तम सवदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान पीतये ||
9.74.e: Soma, thy juice when thou art blended with the streams, flows, Pavamana, through the long wool of the sheep.  So, cleansed by sages. O best giver of delight, grow sweet for Indra, Pavamana! for his drink.

9.75.d: अभि परियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते | आ सूर्यस्य बर्हतो बर्हन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद विचक्षणः ||
9.75.e: GRACIOUSLY-MINDED he is flowing on his way to win dear names o’er which the Youthful One grows great.  The Mighty and Far-seeing One hath mounted now the mighty Sūrya's car which moves to every side.

9.75.d: रतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु परियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः | दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्यं नाम तर्तीयमधि रोचने दिवः ||
9.75.e: The Speaker, unassailable Master of this hymn, the Tongue of sacrifice pours forth the pleasant meath.  Within the lustrous region of the heavens the Son makes the third secret name of Mother and of Sire.

9.75.d: अव दयुतानः कलशानचिक्रदन नर्भिर्येमानः कोश आ हिरण्यये | अभीं रतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि तरिप्र्ष्ठ उषसो वि राजति ||
9.75.e: Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir.  The milky streams of sacrifice have sung to him: he of the triple height shines brightly through the morns.

9.75.d: अद्रिभिः सुतो मतिभिश्चनोहितः पररोचयन रोदसी मातराशुचिः | रोमाण्यव्या समया वि धावति मधोर्धारा पिन्वमाना दिवे-दिवे ||
9.75.e: Pressed by the stones, with hymns, and graciously inclined, illuminating both the Parents, Heaven and Earth,  He flows in ordered season onward through the flee, a current of sweet juice still swelling day by day.

9.75.d: परि सोम पर धन्वा सवस्तये नर्भिः पुनानो अभि वासयाशिरम | ये ते मदा आहनसो विहायसस्तेभिरिन्द्रं चोदय दातवे मघम ||
9.75.e: Flow onward, Soma, flow to bring prosperity: cleansed by the men, invest thee with the milky draught.  What gladdening drinks thou hast, foaming, exceeding strong, even with these incite Indra to give us wealth.

9.76.d: धर्ता दिवः पवते कर्त्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नर्भिः | हरिः सर्जानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्व्र्था पाजांसि कर्णुते नदीष्वा ||
9.76.e: ON flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy.  The Gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, impetuously winneth splendour in the streams.

9.76.d: शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः सवः सिषासन रथिरो गविष्टिषु | इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः ||
9.76.e: He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine.  Indu, while stimulating India's might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skilful in their task.

9.76.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वाविश | पर णः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया न वाजानुप मासि शश्वतः ||
9.76.e: Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra's throat.  Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us, as ’twere through song.

9.76.d: विश्वस्य राजा पवते सवर्द्र्श रतस्य धीतिं रषिषाळ अवीवशत | यः सूर्यस्यासिरेण मर्ज्यते पिता मतीनामसमष्टकाव्यः ||
9.76.e: Onward he flows, the King of all that sees the light: the Ṛṣis’ Lord hath raised the song of sacrifice;  Even he who is adorned with Sūrya's arrowy beam, Father of hymns, whose wisdom is beyond our reach.

9.76.d: वर्षेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षस्यपामुपस्थे वर्षभः कनिक्रदत | स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरिन्तमो यथा जेषाम समिथे तवोतयः ||
