9.76.e: Like as a bull to herds, thou flowest to the pail, bellowing as a steer upon the water's lap.  So, best of Cheerers, thou for Indra flowest on that we, with thy protection, may o’ercome in fight.

9.77.d: एष पर कोशे मधुमानचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य वज्रो वपुषो वपुष्टरः | अभीं रतस्य सुदुघा घर्तश्चुतो वाश्रा अर्षन्तिपयसेव धेनवः ||
9.77.e: MORE beauteous than the beautiful, as Indra's bolt, this Soma, rich in sweets, hath clamoured in the vat.  Dropping with oil, abundant, streams of sacrifice flow unto him like milch-kine, lowing, with their milk.

9.77.d: स पूर्व्यः पवते यं दिवस परि शयेनो मथायदिषितस्तिरो रजः | स मध्व आ युवते वेविजान इत कर्शानोरस्तुर्मनसाह बिभ्युषा ||
9.77.e: On flows that Ancient One whom, hitherward, from heaven, sped through the region of the air, the Falcon snatched.  He, quivering with alarm and terrified in heart before bow-armed Kṛśānu, holdeth fast the sweet.

9.77.d: ते नः पूर्वास उपरास इन्दवो महे वाजाय धन्वन्तु गोमते | ईक्षेण्यासो अह्यो न चारवो बरह्म-बरह्म ये जुजुषुर्हविर हविः ||
9.77.e: May those first freshest drops of Soma juice effused flow on, their way to bring us mighty strength in kine.  Beauteous as serpents, worthy to be looked upon, they whom each sacred gift and all our prayers have pleased.

9.77.d: अयं नो विद्वान वनवद वनुष्यत इन्दुः सत्राचा मनसा पुरुष्टुतः | इनस्य यः सदने गर्भमादधे गवामुरुब्जमभ्यर्षति वरजम ||
9.77.e: May that much-lauded Indu, with a heart inclined to us, well-knowing, fight against our enemies.  He who hath brought the germ beside the Strong One's seat moves onward to the widely-opcned stall of kine.

9.77.d: चक्रिर्दिवः पवते कर्त्व्यो रसो महानदब्धो वरुणो हुरुग्यते | असावि मित्रो वर्जनेषु यज्ञियो.अत्यो न यूथे वर्षयुः कनिक्रदत ||
9.77.e: The active potent juice of heaven is flowing on, great Varuṇa whom the forward man can ne’er deceive.  Mitra, the Holy, hath been pressed for troubled times, neighing like an impatient horse amid the herd,

9.78.d: पर राजा वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यददपो वसानो अभि गा इयक्षति | गर्भ्णाति रिप्रमविरस्य तान्वा शुद्धो देवानामुप याति निष्क्र्तम ||
9.78.e: RAISING his voice the King hath flowed upon his way: invested with the waters he would win the kine.  The fleece retains his solid parts as though impure, and bright and cleansed he seeks the special place of Gods.

9.78.d: इन्द्राय सोम परि षिच्यसे नर्भिर्न्र्चक्षा ऊर्मिः कविरज्यसे वने | पूर्वीर्हि ते सरुतयः सन्ति यातवे सहस्रमश्वा हरयश्चमूषदः ||
9.78.e: Thou, Soma, art effused for Indra by the men, balmed in the wood as wave, Sage, Viewer of mankind.  Full many are the paths whereon thou mayest go: a thousand bay steeds hast thou resting in the bowls.

9.78.d: समुद्रिया अप्सरसो मनीषिणमासीना अन्तरभि सोममक्षरन | ता ईं हिन्वन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिं याचन्ते सुम्नं पवमानमक्षितम ||
9.78.e: Apsarases who dwell in waters of the sea, sitting within, have flowed to Soma wise of heart.  They urge the Master of the house upon his way, and to the Eternal Pavamana pray for bliss.

9.78.d: गोजिन नः सोमो रथजिद धिरण्यजित सवर्जिदब्जित पवते सहस्रजित | यं देवासश्चक्रिरे पीतये मदं सवादिष्ठं दरप्समरुणं मयोभुवम ||
9.78.e: Soma flows on for u's as winner of the kine, winner of thousands, cars, water, and light, and gold;  He whom the Gods have made a gladdening draught to drink, the drop most sweet to taste, weal-bringing, red of hue.

9.78.d: एतानि सोम पवमानो अस्मयुः सत्यानि कर्ण्वन दरविणान्यर्षसि | जहि शत्रुमन्तिके दूरके च य उर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं च नस कर्धि ||
9.78.e: Soma, as Pavamana thou, our faithful Friend, making for us these real treasures, flowest on.  Slay thou the enemy both near and,far away: grant us security and ample pasturage.

9.79.d: अचोदसो नो धन्वन्त्विन्दवः पर सुवानासो बर्हद्दिवेषु हरयः | वि च नशन न इषो अरातयो.अर्यो नशन्त सनिषन्त नो धियः ||
9.79.e: SPONTANEOUS let our drops of Soma juice flow on, pressed, golden-hued, among the Gods of lofty heaven.  Perish among us they who give no gifts of food! perish the godless! May our prayers obtain success.

9.79.d: पर णो धन्वन्त्विन्दवो मदच्युतो धना वा येभिरर्वतो जुनीमसि | तिरो मर्तस्य कस्य चित परिह्व्र्तिं वयं धनानि विश्वधा भरेमहि ||
9.79.e: Forward to us the drops, distilling meath, shall flow, like riches for whose sake we urge the horses on.  Beyond the crafty hindering of all mortal men may we continually bear precious wealth away.

9.79.d: उत सवस्या अरात्या अरिर्हि ष उतान्यस्या अरात्या वर्को हि षः | धन्वन न तर्ष्णा समरीत तानभि सोम जहिपवमान दुराध्यः ||
9.79.e: Yea, yerily, foe of hate shown to himself is he, yea, verity, destroyer too of other hate.  As thirst subdueth in the desert, conquer thou, O Soma Pavarnana, men of evil thoughts.

9.79.d: दिवि ते नाभा परमो य आददे पर्थिव्यास्ते रुरुहुः सानविक्षिपः | अद्रयस्त्वा बप्सति गोरधि तवच्यप्सु तवा हस्तैर्दुदुहुर्मनीषिणः ||
9.79.e: Near kin to thee is he, raised loftiest in the heavens: upon the earth's high ridge thy scions have grown forth.  The press-stones chew and crunch thee on the ox's hide: sages have milked thee with their hands into the streams.

9.79.d: एवा त इन्दो सुभ्वं सुपेशसं रसं तुञ्जन्ति परथमा अभिश्रियः | निदं-निदं पवमान नि तारिष आविस्ते शुष्मो भवतु परियो मदः ||
9.79.e: So do they hurry on thy strong and beauteous juice, O Indu, as the first ingredient of the draught.  Bring low, thou Pavamana, every single foe, and be thy might shown forth as sweet and gladdening drink.

9.80.d: सोमस्य धारा पवते नर्चक्षस रतेन देवान हवते दिवस परि | बर्हस्पते रवथेना वि दिद्युते समुद्रासो न सवनानि विव्यचुः ||
9.80.e: ON flows the stream of Soma who beholds mankind: by everlasting Law he calls the Gods from heaven.  He lightens with the roaring of Br aspati: h the lakes have not contained the pourings of juice.

9.80.d: यं तवा वाजिन्नघ्न्या अभ्यनूषतायोहतं योनिमा रोहसि दयुमान | मघोनामायुः परतिरन महि शरव इन्द्राय सोमपवसे वर्षा मदः ||
9.80.e: Thou, powerful Soma, thou to whom the cows have -lowed, ascendest bright with sheen, thine iron-fashioned home.  Thou, lengthening our princes' life and high renown, flowest for Indra as his might to gladdening drink.

9.80.d: एन्द्रस्य कुक्षा पवते मदिन्तम ऊर्जं वसानः शरवसे सुमङगलः | परत्यं स विश्वा भुवनाभि पप्रथे करीळन हरिरत्यः सयन्दते वर्षा ||
9.80.e: Best giver of delight, he flows to Indra's throat, robing himself in might, Auspicious One, for fame.  He spreads himself abroad to meet all things that be: the vigorous Tawny Steed flows sporting on his way.

9.80.d: तं तवा देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमं नरः सहस्रधारं दुहते दश कषिपः | नर्भिः सोम परच्युतो गरावभिः सुतो विश्वान्देवाना पवस्वा सहस्रजित ||
9.80.e: The men, the ten swift fingers, milk thee out for Gods, even thee most rich in meath, with thousand flowing streams.  Soma who winnest thousands, driven by the men, expressed with stones, bring, as thou flowest, all the Gods.

9.80.d: तं तवा हस्तिनो मधुमन्तमद्रिभिर्दुहन्त्यप्सु वर्षभन्दश कषिपः | इन्द्रं सोम मादयन दैव्यं जनं सिन्धोरिवोर्मिः पवमानो अर्षसि ||
9.80.e: Deft-handed men with stones, the ten swift fingers, drain thee into waters, thee, the Steer enriched with sweets.  Thou, Soma, gladdening Indra, and the Heavenly Host, flowest as Pavamana like a river's wave.

9.81.d: पर सोमस्य पवमानस्योर्मय इन्द्रस्य यन्ति जठरं सुपेशसः | दध्ना यदीमुन्नीता यशसा गवां दानाय शूरमुदमन्दिषुः सुताः ||
9.81.e: ONWARD to Indra's throat move, beauteously adorned, the waves of Soma as he purifies himself,  When they, brought forward with the lovely curd of kine, effused, have cheered the Hero to bestow his gifts.

9.81.d: अछा हि सोमः कलशानसिष्यददत्यो न वोळ्हा रघुवर्तनिर्व्र्षा | अथा देवानामुभयस्य जन्मनो विद्वानश्नोत्यमुत इतश्च यत ||
9.81.e: Hither hath Soma flowed unto the beakers, like a chariot-horse, a stallion swift upon his way.  Thus, knowing both the generations, he obtains the rights and dues of Gods from yonder and from hence.

9.81.d: आ नः सोम पवमानः किरा वस्विन्दो भव मघवा राधसो महः | शिक्षा वयोधो वसवे सु चेतुना मा नो गयमारे अस्मत परा सिचः ||
9.81.e: While thou art cleansed, O Soma, scatter wealth on us; Indu, bestow great bounty as a liberal Prince.  Giver of life, with wisdom help to opulence; strew not our home possessions far away from us.

9.81.d: आ नः पूषा पवमानः सुरातयो मित्रो गछन्तु वरुणः सजोषसः | बर्हस्पतिर्मरुतो वायुरश्विना तवष्टा सविता सुयमा सरस्वती ||
9.81.e: Hither let Pūṣan Pavamana come to us, Varuṇa, Mitra, bountiful, of one accord,  The Maruts, Aśvins, Vāyu, and Bṛhaspati, Savitar, Tvaṣṭar, tractable Sarasvatī.

9.81.d: उभे दयावाप्र्थिवी विश्वमिन्वे अर्यमा देवो अदितिर्विधाता | भगो नर्शंस उर्वन्तरिक्षं विश्वे देवाः पवमानंजुषन्त ||
9.81.e: Both Heaven and Earth, the all-invigorating Pair, Vidhatar, Aditi, and Aryaman the God,  Bhaga who blesses men, the spacious Firmament,—let all the Gods in Pavamana take delight.

9.82.d: असावि सोमो अरुषो वर्षा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत | पुनानो वारं पर्येत्यव्ययं शयेनो न योनिं घर्तवन्तमासदम ||
9.82.e: EVEN as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed: the Wondrous One hath bellowed to the kine.  While purified he passes through the filtering fleece to seat him hawk-like on the place that drops with oil.

9.82.d: कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मर्ष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि | अपसेधन दुरिता सोम मर्ळय घर्तं वसानः परियासि निर्णिजम ||
9.82.e: To glory goest thou, Sage with disposing skill, like a groomed steed thou rusbest forward to the prize.  O Soma, be thou gracious, driving off distress: thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state.

9.82.d: पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पर्थिव्या गिरिषुक्षयं दधे | सवसार आपो अभि गा उतासरन सं गरावभिर्नसते वीते अध्वरे ||
9.82.e: Parjanya is the Father of the Mighty Bird: on mountains, in earth's centre hath he made his home.  The waters too have flowed, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.

9.82.d: जायेव पत्यावधि शेव मंहसे पज्राया गर्भ शर्णुहि बरवीमि ते | अन्तर्वाणीषु पर चरा सु जीवसे.अनिन्द्यो वर्जने सोम जाग्र्हि ||
9.82.e: Thou givest pleasure as a wife delights her lord. Listen, O Child of Pajri, for to thee I speak.  Amid the holy songs go on that we may live: in time of trouble, Soma, watch thou free from blame.

9.82.d: यथा पूर्वेभ्यः शतसा अम्र्ध्रः सहस्रसाः पर्यया वाजमिन्दो | एवा पवस्व सुविताय नव्यसे तव वरतमन्वापः सचन्ते ||
9.82.e: As to the men of old thou camest, Indu unharmed, to strengthen, winning hundreds, thousands,  So now for new felicity flow onward: the waters follow as thy law ordaineth.

9.83.d: पवित्रं ते विततं बरह्मणस पते परभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषिविश्वतः | अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शर्तास इद वहन्तस्तत समाशत ||
9.83.e: SPREAD is thy cleansing filter, Brahmaṇaspati: as Prince, thou enterest its limbs from every side.  The raw, whose mass hath not been heated gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.

9.83.d: तपोष पवित्रं विततं दिवस पदे शोचन्तो अस्य तन्तवो वयस्थिरन | अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवस पर्ष्ठमधितिष्ठन्ति चेतसा ||
9.83.e: High in the seat of heaven is spread the Scorcher's sieve: its threads are standing separate, glittering with light.  The Swift Ones favour him who purifieth this: with consciousness they stand upon the height of heaven.

9.83.d: अरूरुचदुषसः पर्श्निरग्रिय उक्षा बिभर्ति भुवनानि वाजयुः | मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नर्चक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः ||
9.83.e: The foremost spotted Steer hath made the Mornings shine, and yearning after strength sustains all things that be.  By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ,

9.83.d: गन्धर्व इत्था पदमस्य रक्षति पाति देवानां जनिमान्यद्भुतः | गर्भ्णाति रिपुं निधया निधापतिः सुक्र्त्तमा मधुनो भक्षमाशत ||
9.83.e: Gandharva verily protects his dwellingplace; Wondrous, he guards the generations of the Gods.  Lord of the snare, he takes the foeman with the snare: those who are most devout have gained a share of meath.

9.83.d: हविर्हविष्मो महि सद्म दैव्यं नभो वसानः परि यास्यध्वरम | राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहः सहस्रभ्र्ष्टिर्जयसि शरवो बर्हत ||
9.83.e: Rich in oblations! robed in cloud, thou corapassest oblation, sacrifice, the mighty seat of Gods.  King, on thy chariot-sieve thou goest up to war, and with a thousand weapons winnest lofty fame.

9.84.d: पवस्व देवमादनो विचर्षणिरप्सा इन्द्राय वरुणाय वायवे | कर्धी नो अद्य वरिवः सवस्तिमदुरुक्षितौ गर्णीहि दैव्यं जनम ||
9.84.e: FLOW, cheering Gods, most active, winner of the flood, for Indra, and for Vāyu, and for Varuṇa.  Bestow on us to-day wide room with happiness, and in tbine ample dwelling laud the Host of Heaven.

9.84.d: आ यस्तस्थौ भुवनान्यमर्त्यो विश्वानि सोमः परि तान्यर्षति | कर्ण्वन संच्र्तं विच्र्तमभिष्टय इन्दुः सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः ||
9.84.e: He who hath come anear to creatures that have life, Immortal Soma flows onward to all of them.  Effecting, for our aid, both union and release, Indu, like Sūrya, follows closely after Dawn.

9.84.d: आ यो गोभिः सर्ज्यत ओषधीष्वा देवानां सुम्न इषयन्नुपावसुः | आ विद्युता पवते धारया सुत इन्द्रं सोमो मादयन दैव्यं जनम ||
9.84.e: He who is poured with milk, he who within the plants hastes bringing treasure for the happiness of Gods,  He, poured forth in a stream flows with the lightning's flash, Soma who gladdens Indra and the Host of Heaven.

9.84.d: एष सय सोमः पवते सहस्रजिद धिन्वानो वाचमिषिरामुषर्बुधम | इन्दुः समुद्रमुदियर्ति वायुभिरेन्द्रस्य हार्दिकलशेषु सीदति ||
9.84.e: Winner of thousands, he, this Soma, flows along, raising a vigorous voice that wakens with the dawn.  Indu with winds drives on the ocean of the air, he sinks within the jars, he rests in Indra's heart.

9.84.d: अभि तयं गावः पयसा पयोव्र्धं सोमं शरीणन्ति मतिभिः सवर्विदम | धनंजयः पवते कर्त्व्यो रसो विप्रः कविःकाव्येना सवर्चनाः ||
9.84.e: The kine with milk dress him who makes the milk increase, Soma, amid the songs, who finds the light of heaven.  Winner of wealth, the effectual juice is flowing on, Singer and Sage by wisdom, dear as heaven itself.

9.85.d: इन्द्राय सोम सुषुतः परि सरवापामीवा भवतु रक्षसा सह | मा ते रसस्य मत्सत दवयाविनो दरविणस्वन्त इह सन्त्विन्दवः ||
9.85.e: FLOW on to Indra, Soma, carefully effused: let sickness stay afar together with the fiends.  Let not the double-tongued delight them with thy juice. here be thy flowing drops laden with opulence.

9.85.d: अस्मान समर्ये पवमान चोदय दक्षो देवानामसि हि परियो मदः | जहि शत्रून्रभ्या भन्दनायतः पिबेन्द्र सोममव नो मर्धो जहि ||
9.85.e: O Pavamana, urge us forward in the fight thou art the vigour of the Gods, the well-loved drink.  Smite thou our enemies who raise the shout of joy: Indra, drink Soma juice, and drive away our foes.

9.85.d: अदब्ध इन्दो पवसे मदिन्तम आत्मेन्द्रस्य भवसि धासिरुत्तमः | अभि सवरन्ति बहवो मनीषिणो राजानमस्य भुवनस्यनिंसते ||
9.85.e: Unharmed, best Cheerer, thou, O Indu, flowest on: thou, even thou thyself, art Indra's noblest food.  Full many a wise man lifts to thee the song of praise, and hails thee with a kiss as Sovran of this world.

9.85.d: सहस्रणीथः शतधारो अद्भुत इन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते काम्यं मधु | जयन कषेत्रमभ्यर्षा जयन्नप उरुं नो गातुं कर्णु सोम मीढ्वः ||
9.85.e: Wondrous, with hundred streams, hymned in a thousand songs, Indu pours out for Indra his delightrul meath.  Winning us land and waters, flow thou hitherward: Rainer of bounties, Soma, make broad way for us.

9.85.d: कनिक्रदत कलशे गोभिरज्यसे वयव्ययं समया वारमर्षसि | मर्म्र्ज्यमानो अत्यो न सानसिरिन्द्रस्य सोम जठरे समक्षरः ||
9.85.e: Roaring within the beaker thou art balmed with milk: thou passest through the fleecy filter all at once.  Carefully cleansed and decked like a prizewinning steed, O Soma, thou hast flowed down within Indra's throat.

9.85.d: सवादुः पवस्व दिव्याय जन्मने सवादुरिन्द्राय सुहवीतुनाम्ने | सवादुर्मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे बर्हस्पतये मधुमानदाभ्यः ||
9.85.e: Flow onward sweet of flavour for the Heavenly Race, for Indra sweet, whose name is easily invoked:  Flow sweet for Mitra, Varuṇa, and Vāyu, rich in meath, inviolable for Bṛhaspati.

9.85.d: अत्यं मर्जन्ति कलशे दश कषिपः पर विप्राणां मतयो वाच ईरते | पवमाना अभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिमेन्द्रं विशन्तिमदिरास इन्दवः ||
9.85.e: Ten rapid fingers deck the Courser in the jar: with hymns the holy singers send their voices forth.  The filtering juices hasten to their eulogy, the drops that gladden find their way to Indra's heart.

9.85.d: पवमानो अभ्यर्षा सुवीर्यमुर्वीं गव्यूतिं महि शर्म सप्रथः | माकिर्नो अस्य परिषूतिरीशतेन्दो जयेम तवयाधनं-धनम ||
9.85.e: While thou art purified pour on us hero strength, great, far-extended shelter, spacious pasturage.  Let no oppression master this our holy work: may we, O Indu, gain all opulence through thee.

9.85.d: अधि दयामस्थाद वर्षभो विचक्षणो.अरूरुचद वि दिवो रोचना कविः | राजा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवद दिवः पीयूषन्दुहते नर्चक्षसः ||
9.85.e: The Steer who sees afar hath risen above the sky: the Sage hath caused the lights of heaven to give their shine.  The. King is passing through the filter with a roar: they drain the milk of heaven from him who looks on men.

9.85.d: दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतो वेना दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम | अप्सु दरप्सं वाव्र्धानं समुद्र आ सिन्धोरूर्मामधुमन्तं पवित्र आ ||
9.85.e: High in the vault of heaven, unceasing, honey-tongued, the Loving Ones drain out the mountain-haunting Steer,—  The drop that hath grown great in waters, in the lake meath-rich, in the stream's wave and in the cleansing sieve.

9.85.d: नाके सुपर्णमुपपप्तिवांसं गिरो वेनानामक्र्पन्त पूर्वीः | शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं हिरण्ययं शकुनं कषामणि सथाम ||
9.85.e: The Loving Ones besought with many voices the Eagle who had flown away to heaven.  Hymns kiss the Youngling worthy of laudation, resting on earth, the Bird of golden colour.

9.85.d: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थाद विश्वा रूपा परतिचक्षाणो अस्य | भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा वयद्यौत परारूरुचद रोदसी मातरा शुचिः ||
9.85.e: High to heaven's vault hath the Gandharva risen, beholding all his varied forms and figures.  His ray hath shone abroad with gleaming splendour: pure, he hath lighted both the worlds, the Parents.

9.86.d: पर त आशवः पवमान धीजवो मदा अर्षन्ति रघुजा इव तमना | दिव्याः सुपर्णा मधुमन्त इन्दवो मदिन्तमासः परि कोशमासते ||
9.86.e: THY gladdening draughts, O Pavamana, urged by song flow swiftly of themselves like sons of fleet-foot mares.  The drops of Soma juice, those eagles of the heavens, most cheering, rich in meath, rest in the reservoir.

9.86.d: पर ते मदासो मदिरास आशवो.अस्र्क्षत रथ्यासो यथा पर्थक | धेनुर्न वत्सं पयसाभि वज्रिणमिन्द्रमिन्दवो मधुमन्त ऊर्मयः ||
9.86.e: As rapid chariot-steeds, so turned in several ways have thine exhilarating juices darted forth,  Soma-drops rich in meath, waves, to the Thunder-armed, to Indra, like milch-kine who seek their calf with milk.

9.86.d: अत्यो न हियानो अभि वाजमर्ष सवर्वित कोशं दिवो अद्रिमातरम | वर्षा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्यये सोमः पुनान इन्द्रियाय धायसे ||
9.86.e: Like a steed urged to battle, finder of the light; speed onward to the cloud-born reservoir of heaven,  A Steer that o’er the woolly surface seeks the sieve, Soma while purified for Indra's nourishment.

9.86.d: पर त आश्विनीः पवमान धीजुवो दिव्या अस्र्ग्रन पयसा धरीमणि | परान्तरषयः सथाविरीरस्र्क्षत ये तवा मर्जन्त्य रषिषाण वेधसः ||
9.86.e: Fleet as swift steeds, thy drops, divine, thought-swift, have been, O Pavamana, poured with milk into the vat.  The Ṛṣis have poured in continuous Soma drops, ordainers who adorn thee, Friend whom Ṛṣis love.

9.86.d: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष रभ्वसः परभोस्ते सतः परियन्ति केतवः | वयानशिः पवसे सोम धर्मभिः पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ||
9.86.e: O thou who seest all things, Sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass all abodes.  Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world's Lord, O Soma, thou art King.

9.86.d: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो धरुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः | यदी पवित्रे अधि मर्ज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योना कलशेषु सीदति ||
9.86.e: The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven, his ensigns who is ever steadfast, travel round.  When on the sieve the Golden-hued is cleansed, he rests within the vats as one who seats him in his place.

9.86.d: यज्ञस्य केतुः पवते सवध्वरः सोमो देवानामुप याति निष्क्र्तम | सहस्रधारः परि कोशमर्षति वर्षा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवत ||
9.86.e: Served with fair rites he flows, ensign of sacrifice: Soma advances to the special place of Gods.  He speeds with thousand currents to the reservoir, and passes through the filter bellowing as a bull.

9.86.d: राजा समुद्रं नद्यो वि गाहते.अपामूर्मिं सचते सिन्धुषु शरितः | अध्यस्थात सानु पवमानो अव्ययं नाभा पर्थिव्या धरुणो महो दिवः ||
9.86.e: The Sovran dips him in the seain and the streams, and set in rivers with the waters' wave moves on.  High heaven's Sustainer at the central point of earth, raised on the fleecy surface Pavamana stands.

9.86.d: दिवो न सानु सतनयन्नचिक्रदद दयौश्च यस्य पर्थिवी च धर्मभिः | इन्द्रस्य सख्यं पवते विवेविदत सोमः पुनानःकलशेषु सीदति ||
9.86.e: He on whose high decree the heavens and earth depend nath roared and thundered like the summit of the sky.  Soma flows on obtaining Indra's friendly love, and, as they purify him, settles in the jars.

9.86.d: जयोतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु परियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः | दधाति रत्नं सवधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः ||
9.86.e: He, light of sacrifice distils delicious meath, most wealthy, Father and begetter of the Gods.  He, gladdening, best of Cheerers, juice!hat Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.

9.86.d: अभिक्रन्दन कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः | हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्म्र्जानो.अविभिःसिन्धुभिर्व्र्षा ||
9.86.e: The vigorous and far-seeing one, the Lord of heaven, flows, shouting to the beaker, with his thousand streams.  Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.

9.86.d: अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गछति | अग्रे वाजस्य भजते महाधनं सवायुधः सोत्र्भिः पूयते वर्षा ||
9.86.e: In forefront of the rivers Pavamana speeds, in forefront of the hymn, foremost among the kine.  He shares the mighty booty in the van of war: the well-armed Steer is purified by worshippers.

9.86.d: अयं मतवाञ्छकुनो यथा हितो.अव्ये ससार पवमान ऊर्मिणा | तव करत्वा रोदसी अन्तरा कवे शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ||
9.86.e: This heedful Pavamana, like a bird sent forth, hath with his wave flowed onward to the fleecy sieve.  O Indra, through thy wisdom, b thy thought, O Sage, Soma flows bright and pure between the earth and heaven.

9.86.d: दरापिं वसानो यजतो दिविस्प्र्शमन्तरिक्षप्रा भुवनेष्वर्पितः | सवर्जज्ञानो नभसाभ्यक्रमीत परत्नमस्य पितरमा विवासति ||
9.86.e: He, clad in mail that reaches heaven, the Holy One, filling the firmament stationed amid the worlds,  Knowing. the realm of light, hath come to us in rain: he summons to himself his own primeval Sire.

9.86.d: सो अस्य विशे महि शर्म यछति यो अस्य धाम परथमं वयानशे | पदं यदस्य परमे वयोमन्यतो विश्वा अभि संयाति संयतः ||
9.86.e: He who was first of all to penetrate his form bestowed upon his race wide shelter and defence.  From that high station which he hath in loftiest heaven he comes victorious to all encounters here.

9.86.d: परो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्क्र्तं सखा सख्युर्न पर मिनाति संगिरम | मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा ||
9.86.e: Indu hath started for Indra's special place and slights not as a Friend the promise of his Friend.  Soma speeds onward like a youth to youtlitial maids, and gains the beaker by a course of bundred paths.

9.86.d: पर वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवसनेष्वक्रमुः | सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत सतुभो.अभि धेनवः पयसेमशिश्रयुः ||
9.86.e: Your songs, exhilarating, tuneful, uttering praise, are come into the placns where the people meet.  Worshippers have exalted Soma with their hymns, and milch kine have come near to meet him with their milk.

9.86.d: आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युशीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमानोस्रिधम | या नो दोहते तरिरहन्नसश्चुषी कषुमद वाजवन मधुमद सुवीर्यम ||
9.86.e: O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, pour on us accumulateds Plentiful, nutritious food,  Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched with store of nourishment, and strength, and Meath.

9.86.d: वर्षा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नः परतरीतोषसो दिवः | कराणा सिन्धूनां कलशानवीवशदिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन मनीषिभिः ||
9.86.e: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the Furtherer of day, of morning, and of heaven.  Mixt with the streams he caused the beakers to resound, and with the singers' aid they entered Indra's heart.

9.86.d: मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्न्र्भिर्यतः परि कोशानचिक्रदत | तरितस्य नाम जनयन मधु कषरदिन्द्रस्य वायोः सख्याय कर्तवे ||
9.86.e: On, with the prudent singers, flows the ancient Sage and guided by the men hath roared about the vats.  Producing Trita's name, may he pour forth the meath, that Vāyu and that Indra may become his Friends.

9.86.d: अयं पुनान उषसो वि रोचयदयं सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोकक्र्त | अयं तरिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरं सोमो हर्दे पवते चारु मत्सरः ||
9.86.e: He, being purified, hath made the Mornings shine: this, even this is he who gave the rivers room.  He made the Three Times Seven pour out the milky flow: Soma, the Cheerer, yields whate’er the heart finds sweet.

9.86.d: पवस्व सोम दिव्येषु धामसु सर्जान इन्दो कलशे पवित्र आ | सीदन्निन्द्रस्य जठरे कनिक्रदन नर्भिर्यतः सूर्यमारोहयो दिवि ||
9.86.e: Flow, onward, Soma, in thine own celestial forms, flow, Indu, poured within the beaker and the sieve.  Sinking into the throat of Indra with a roar, led by the men thou madest Sūrya mount to heaven.

9.86.d: अद्रिभिः सुतः पवसे पवित्र आ इन्दविन्द्रस्य जठरेष्वाविशन | तवं नर्चक्षा अभवो विचक्षण सोम गोत्रमङगिरोभ्यो.अव्र्णोरप ||
9.86.e: Pressed out with stones thou flowest onward to the sieve, O Indu, entering the depths of Indra's throat.  Far-sighted Soma, now thou lookest on mankind: thou didst unbar the cowstall for the Aṅgirases.

9.86.d: तवां सोम पवमानं सवाध्यो.अनु विप्रासो अमदन्नवस्यवः | तवां सुपर्ण आभरद दिवस परीन्दो विश्वाभिर्मतिभिः परिष्क्र्तम ||
9.86.e: In thee, O Soma, while thou purifitedst thee, high-thoughted sages, seeking favour, have rejoiced.  Down from the heavens the Falcon brought thee hitherward, even thee, O Indu, thee whom all our hymns adorn.

9.86.d: अव्ये पुनानं परि वार ऊर्मिणा हरिं नवन्ते अभि सप्त धेनवः | अपामुपस्थे अध्यायवः कविं रतस्य योना महिषा अहेषत ||
9.86.e: Seven Milch-kine glorify the Tawny-coloured One while with his wave in wool he purifies himself.  The living men, the mighty, have impelled the Sage into the waters' lap, the place of sacrifice.

9.86.d: इन्दुः पुनानो अति गाहते मर्धो विश्वानि कर्ण्वन सुपथानि यज्यवे | गाः कर्ण्वानो निर्णिजं हर्यतः कविरत्यो न करीळन परि वारमर्षति ||
9.86.e: Indu, attaining purity, plunges through the foe, making Ilis ways all easy for the pious man.  Making the kine his mantle, he, the lovely Sage, runs like a sporting courser onward through the fleece.

9.86.d: असश्चतः शतधारा अभिश्रियो हरिं नवन्ते.अव ता उदन्युवः | कषिपो मर्जन्ति परि गोभिराव्र्तं तर्तीये पर्ष्ठे अधि रोचने दिवः ||
9.86.e: The ceaseless watery fountains with their hundred streams sing, as they hasten near, to him the Golden-hued  Him, clad in robes of milk, swift fingers beautify on the third height and in the luminous realm of heaven.

9.86.d: तवेमाः परजा दिव्यस्य रेतसस्त्वं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि | अथेदं विश्वं पवमान ते वशे तवमिन्दो परथमोधामधा असि ||
9.86.e: These are thy generations of celestial seed thou art the Sovran Lord of all the world of life.  This universe, O Pavamana, owns thy sway; thou, Indu, art the first establisher of Law.

9.86.d: तवं समुद्रो असि विश्ववित कवे तवेमाः पञ्च परदिशो विधर्मणि | तवं दयां च पर्थिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे तव जयोतींषि पवमान सूर्यः ||
9.86.e: Thou art the sea, O Sage who bringest alf to light: under thy Law are these five regions of the world.  Tlou reachest out beyond the earth, beyond the heavens: thine are the lights, O Pavamana, thine the Sun.

9.86.d: तवं पवित्रे रजसो विधर्मणि देवेभ्यः सोम पवमान पूयसे | तवामुशिजः परथमा अग्र्भ्णत तुभ्येमा विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ||
9.86.e: Thou in the filter, Soma Pavamana, art purified to support the region for the Gods.  The chief, the longing ones have sought to hold thee fast, and all these living creatures have been turned to thee.

9.86.d: पर रेभ एत्यति वारमव्ययं वर्षा वनेष्वव चक्रदद्धरिः | सं धीतयो वावशाना अनूषत शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतम ||
9.86.e: Onward the Singer travels o’er the fleecy sieve. the Tawny Steer hath bellowed in the wooden vats.  Hymns have been sung aloud in resonant harmony, and holy songs kiss him, the Child who claims our praise.

9.86.d: स सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः परि वयत तन्तुं तन्वानस्त्रिव्र्तंयथा विदे | नयन्न्र्तस्य परशिषो नवीयसीः पतिर्जनीनामुप याति निष्क्र्तम ||
9.86.e: He hath assumed the rays of Sūrya for his robe, spinning, as he knows bow, the triply-twisted thread.  He, guiding to the newest rules of Holy Law, comes as the Women's Consort to the special place.

9.86.d: राजा सिन्धूनां पवते पतिर्दिव रतस्य याति पथिभिः कनिक्रदत | सहस्रधारः परि षिच्यते हरिः पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नुपावसुः ||
9.86.e: On flows the King of rivers and the Lord of heaven: he follows with a shout the paths of Holy Law.  The Golden-hued is poured forth, with his hundred streams, Wealth-bringer, lifting up his voice while purified.

9.86.d: पवमान मह्यर्णो वि धावसि सूरो न चित्रो अव्ययानि पव्यया | गभस्तिपूतो नर्भिरद्रिभिः सुतो महे वाजाय धन्याय धन्वसि ||
9.86.e: Fain to be cleansed, thou, Pavamana, pourest out, like wondrous Sūrya, through the fleece, an ample sea.  Purified with the hands, pressed by the men with stones, thou speedest on to mighty booty-bringing war.

9.86.d: इषमूर्जं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि शयेनो न वंसु कलशेषुसीदसि | इन्द्राय मद्वा मद्यो मदः सुतो दिवो विष्टम्भ उपमो विचक्षणः ||
9.86.e: Thou, Pavamana, sendest food and power in streams. thou sittest in the beakers as a hawk on trees,  For Indra poured as cheering juice to make him glad, as nearest and farseeing bearer-up of heaven.

9.86.d: सप्त सवसारो अभि मातरः शिशुं नवं जज्ञानं जेन्यं विपश्चितम | अपां गन्धर्वं दिव्यं नर्चक्षसं सोमंविश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसे ||
9.86.e: The Sisters Seven, the Mothers, stand around the Babe, the noble, new-born Infant, skilled in holy song,  Gandharva of the floods, divine, beholding men, Soma, that he may reign as King of all the world.

9.86.d: ईशान इमा भुवनानि वीयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः | तास्ते कषरन्तु मधुमद घर्तं पयस्तव वरते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कर्ष्टयः ||
9.86.e: As Sovran Lord thereof thou Passest through these worlds, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged Mares.  May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree.

9.86.d: तवं नर्चक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वर्षभ ता वि धावसि | स नः पवस्व वसुमद धिरण्यवद वयं सयाम भुवनेषु जीवसे ||
9.86.e: O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these.  Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be.

9.86.d: गोवित पवस्व वसुविद धिरण्यविद रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः | तवं सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित तं तवा विप्रा उप गिरेम आसते ||
9.86.e: Winner of gold and goods and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu, mid the worlds of life.  Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with the song.

9.86.d: उन मध्व ऊर्मिर्वनना अतिष्ठिपदपो वसानो महिषो वि गाहते | राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहत सहस्रभ्र्ष्टिर्जयति शरवो बर्हत ||
9.86.e: The wave of flowing meath hath wakened up desires: the Steer enrobed in milk plunges into the streams.  Borne on his chariot-sieve the King hath risen to war, and with a thousand rays hath won him high renown.

9.86.d: स भन्दना उदियर्ति परजावतीर्विश्वायुर्विश्वाः सुभरा अहर्दिवि | बरह्म परजावद रयिमश्वपस्त्यं पीत इन्दविन्द्रमस्मभ्यं याचतात ||
9.86.e: Dear to all life, he sends triumphant praises forth, abundant, bringing offspring, each succeeding day.  From Indra crave for us, Indu, when thou art quaffed, the blessing that gives children, wealth that harbours steeds.

9.86.d: सो अग्रे अह्नां हरिर्हर्यतो मदः पर चेतसा चेतयते अनुद्युभिः | दवा जना यातयन्नन्तरीयते नरा च शंसं दैव्यं च धर्तरि ||
9.86.e: When days begin, the strong juice, lovely, golden-hued, is recognized by wisdom more and more each day,  He, stirring both the Races, goes between the two, the bearer of the word of men and word of Gods.

9.86.d: अञ्जते वयञ्जते समञ्जते करतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यञ्जते | सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गर्भ्णते ||
9.86.e: They balm him, balm him over balm him thoroughly, caress the mighty strength and balm it with the meath.  They seize the flying Steer at the stream's breathing-place: cleansing with gold they grasp the Animal herein.

9.86.d: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति | अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति तवचमत्यो न करीळन्नसरद वर्षा हरिः ||
9.86.e: Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song: the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream.  He.glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a playful horse the Tawny Steer hath run.

9.86.d: अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः | हरिर्घ्र्तस्नुः सुद्र्शीको अर्णवो जयोतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः ||
9.86.e: Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measurer of days.  Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on a car of light, sharing one hom-e with wealth.

9.86.d: असर्जि सकम्भो दिव उद्यतो मदः परि तरिधातुर्भुवनान्यर्षति | अंशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं गिरा यदि निर्णिजं रग्मिणो ययुः ||
9.86.e: Loosed is the heavens! support, the uplifted cheering juice: the triply-mingled draught flows round into the worlds.  The holy hymns caress the stalk that claims our praise, when singers have approached his beauteous robe with song.

9.86.d: पर ते धारा अत्यण्वानि मेष्यः पुनानस्य संयतो यन्तिरंहयः | यद गोभिरिन्दो चम्वोः समज्यस आ सुवानः सोम कलशेषु सीदसि ||
9.86.e: Thy strearns that flow forth rapidly collected run over the fine fleece of the sheep as thou art cleansed.  When, Indu, thou art. balmed with milk within the bowl, thou sinkest in the jars, O Soma, when expressed.

9.86.d: पवस्व सोम करतुविन न उक्थ्यो.अव्यो वारे परि धाव मधु परियम | जहि विश्वान रक्षस इन्दो अत्रिणो बर्हद वदेम विदथेसुवीराः ||
9.86.e: Winner of power, flow, Soma, worthy of our laud: run onward to the fleece as well-beloved meath.  Destroy, O Indu, all voracious Rākṣasas. With brave sons in the assembly let our speech be bold.

9.87.d: पर तु दरव परि कोशं नि षीद नर्भिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष | अश्वं न तवा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तो.अछा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति ||
9.87.e: RUN onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle.  Making thee beauteous like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.

9.87.d: सवायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वर्जनं रक्षमाणः | पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पर्थिव्याः ||
9.87.e: Indu, the well-armed God, is flowing onward, who quells the curse and guards from treacherous onslaught,  Father, begetter of the Gods, most skilful, the buttress of the heavens and earth's supporter.

9.87.d: रषिर्विप्रः पुरेता जनानां रभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन | स चिद विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्यं गुह्यं नाम गोनाम ||
9.87.e: Ṛṣi and Sage, the Champion of the people, cleft and sagacious, Uśanā in wisdom,  He hath discovered even their hidden nature, the Cows' concealed and most mysterious title.

9.87.d: एष सय ते मधुमानिन्द्र सोमो वर्षा वर्ष्णे परि पवित्रे अक्षाः | सहस्रसाः शतसा भूरिदावा शश्वत्तमं बर्हिरा वाज्यस्थात ||
9.87.e: This thine own Soma rich in meath, O Indra, Steer for the Steer, hath flowed into the filter.  The strong Free-giver, winning hundreds, thousands, hath reached the holy grass that never fails him.

9.87.d: एते सोमा अभि गव्या सहस्रा महे वाजायाम्र्ताय शरवांसि | पवित्रेभिः पवमाना अस्र्ग्रञ्छ्रवस्यवो न पर्तनाजो अत्याः ||
9.87.e: These Somas are for wealth of countless cattle, renown therefor, and mighty strength immortal.  These have been sent forth, urified by strainers, like steeds who rusg to battle fain for glory.

9.87.d: परि हि षमा पुरुहूतो जनानां विश्वासरद भोजना पूयमानः | अथा भर शयेनभ्र्त परयांसि रयिं तुञ्जानो अभि वाजमर्ष ||
9.87.e: He, while he cleanses him, invoked of many, hath flowed to give the people all enjoyment.  Thou whom the Falcon brought, bring, dainty viands, bestir thyself and send us wealth and booty.

9.87.d: एष सुवानः परि सोमः पवित्रे सर्गो न सर्ष्टो अदधावदर्वा | तिग्मे शिशानो महिषो न शर्ङगे गा गव्यन्नभिशूरो न सत्वा ||
9.87.e: This Soma, pressed into the cleansing filter, hath run as ’twere a host let loose, the Courser;  Like a strong bull who whets his horns kpen-pointed, like a brave warrior in the fray for cattle.

9.87.d: एषा ययौ परमादन्तरद्रेः कूचित सतीरूर्वे गा विवेद | दिवो न विद्युत सतनयन्त्यभ्रैः सोमस्य ते पवत इन्द्रधारा ||
9.87.e: He issued forth from out the loftiest mountain, and found kine hidden somewhere in a stable.  Soma's stream clears itself for thee, O Indra, like lightning thundering through the clouds of heaven,

9.87.d: उत सम राशिं परि यासि गोनामिन्द्रेण सोम सरथं पुनानः | पूर्वीरिषो बर्हतीर्जीरदानो शिक्षा शचीवस्तव ता उपष्टुत ||
9.87.e: Cleansing thyselr, and borne along with Indra, Soma, thou goest round the herd of cattle.  May thy praise help us, Mighty One, prompt Giver, to the full ample food which thou bestowest.

9.88.d: अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते तवमस्य पाहि | तवं ह यं चक्र्षे तवं वव्र्ष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम ||
9.88.e: FOR thee this Soma is effused, O Indra: drink of this juice; for thee the stream is flowing-  Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu, for thy special drink to cheer thee.

9.88.d: स ईं रथो न भुरिषाळ अयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि | आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता सवर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त ||
9.88.e: Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the Mighty; to acquire abundant treasures.  Then in the sacrifice they celebrated all triumphs won by Nahus -n the battle.

9.88.d: वायुर्न यो नियुत्वानिष्टयामा नासत्येव हव आ शम्भविष्ठः | विश्ववारो दरविणोदा इव तमन पूषेव धीजवनो.असि सोम ||
9.88.e: Like Vāyu with his team, moving at pleasure, most gracious when invoked like both Nāsatyas,  Thou art thyself like the Wealth-Giver, Soma! who grants all boons, like song-inspiring Pūṣan.

9.88.d: इन्द्रो न यो महा कर्माणि चक्रिर्हन्ता वर्त्राणामसि सोमपूर्भित | पैद्वो न हि तवमहिनाम्नां हन्ता विश्वस्यासिसोम दस्योः ||
9.88.e: Like Indra who hath done great deeds, thou, Soma, art slayer of the Vṛtras, Fort-destroyer.  Like Pedu's horse who killed the brood of serpents, thus thou, O Soma, slayest every Dasyu.

9.88.d: अग्निर्न यो वन आ सर्ज्यमानो वर्था पाजांसि कर्णुते नदीषु | जनो न युध्वा महत उपब्दिरियर्ति सोमः पवमानूर्मिम ||
9.88.e: Like Agni loosed amid the forest, fiercely he winneth splendour in the running waters.  Like one who fights, the roaring of the mighty, thus Soma Pavamana sends his current.

9.88.d: एते सोमा अति वाराण्यव्या दिव्या न कोशासो अभ्रवर्षाः | वर्था समुद्रं सिन्धवो न नीचीः सुतासो अभि कलशानस्र्ग्रन ||
9.88.e: These Somas passing through the fleecy filter, like rain descending from the clouds of heaven,  Have been effused and poured into the beakers, swiftly like rivers running lowly seaward.

9.88.d: शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथाविट | आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पर्तनाषाण न यज्ञः ||
9.88.e: Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that Celestial Host whom none revileth.  Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned.
Thine are King Varuṇa's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory.  All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

9.89.d: परो सय वह्निः पथ्याभिरस्यान दिवो न वर्ष्टिः पवमानोक्षाः | सहस्रधारो असदन नयस्मे मातुरुपस्थे वन आच सोमः ||
9.89.e: THIS Chariot-horse hath moved along the pathways, and Pavamana flowed like rain from heaven.  With us hath Soma with a thousand currents sunk in the wood, upon his Mother's bosom.

9.89.d: राजा सिन्धूनामवसिष्ट वास रतस्य नावमारुहद रजिष्ठाम | अप्सु दरप्सो वाव्र्धे शयेनजूतो दुह ईं पिता दुह ईं पितुर्जाम ||
9.89.e: King, he hath clothed him in the robe of rivers, mounted the straightest-going ship of Order.  Sped by the Hawk the drop hath waxed in waters: the father drains it, drains the Father's offspring.

9.89.d: सिंहं नसन्त मध्वो अयासं हरिमरुषं दिवो अस्य पतिम | शूरो युत्सु परथमः पर्छते गा अस्य चक्षसा परि पात्युक्षा ||
9.89.e: They come to him, red, tawny, Lord of Heaven, the watchful Guardian of the meath, the Lion.  First, Hero in the fight, he seeks the cattle, and with his eye the Steer is our protector.

9.89.d: मधुप्र्ष्ठं घोरमयासमश्वं रथे युञ्जन्त्युरुचक्रर्ष्वम | सवसार ईं जामयो मर्जयन्ति सनाभयो वाजिनमूर्जयन्ति ||
9.89.e: They harness to the broad-wheeled car the mighty Courser whose back bears meath, unwearied, awful.  The twins, the sisters brighten him, and strengthen-these children of one damethe vigorous Racer.

9.89.d: चतस्र ईं घर्तदुहः सचन्ते समाने अन्तर्धरुणे निषत्ताः | ता ईमर्षन्ति नमसा पुनानास्ता ईं विश्वतः परि षन्ति पूर्वीः ||
9.89.e: Four pouring out the holy oil attend him, sitting together in the same container.  To him they flow, when purified, with homage, and still, from every side, are first about him.

9.89.d: विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पर्थिव्या विश्वा उत कषितयो हस्ते अस्य | असत त उत्सो गर्णते नियुत्वान मध्वो अंशुः पवतैन्द्रियाय ||
9.89.e: He is the buttress of the heavens, supporter of earth, and in his hand are all the people.  Be the team's Lord a well to thee the singer: cleansed is the sweet plant's stalk for deed of glory.

9.89.d: वन्वन्नवातो अभि देववीतिमिन्द्राय सोम वर्त्रहा पवस्व | शग्धि महः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः सयाम ||
9.89.e: Fighting, uninjured come where Gods are feasted; Soma, as Vitra-slayer flow for Indra.  Vouchsafe us ample riches very splendid may we be masters of heroic vigour.

9.90.d: पर हिन्वानो जनिता रोदस्यो रथो न वाजं सनिष्यन्नयासीत | इन्द्रं गछन्नायुधा संशिशानो विश्वा वसु हस्तयोरादधानः ||
9.90.e: URGED On, the Father of the Earth and Heaven hath gone forth like a car to gather booty,  Going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, and in his hand containing every treasure.

9.90.d: अभि तरिप्र्ष्ठं वर्षणं वयोधामाङगूषाणामवावशन्त वाणीः | वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धून वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि ||
9.90.e: To him the tones of sacred song have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the Life-bestower.  Dwelling in wood as Varuṇa in rivers, lavishing treasure he distributes blessings

9.90.d: शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावाञ जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि | तिग्मायुधः कषिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाळ्हः साह्वान्प्र्तनासु शत्रून ||
9.90.e: Great Conqueror, warnor-girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches;  With sharpened. arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen.

9.90.d: उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कर्ण्वन समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरन्धी | अपः सिषासन्नुषसः सवर्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान ||
9.90.e: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both earth and heaven with all their fulness.  Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant vigour.

9.90.d: मत्सि सोम वरुणं मत्सि मित्रं मत्सीन्द्रमिन्दो पवमान विष्णुम | मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान मत्सि महामिन्द्रमिन्दो मदाय ||
9.90.e: O Soma, gladden Varuṇa and Mitra; cheer, Indu Pavamana! Indra, Viṣṇu.  Cheer thou the Gods, the Company of Maruts: Indu, cheer mighty Indra to rejoicing.

9.90.d: एवा राजेव करतुमानमेन विश्वा घनिघ्नद दुरिता पवस्व | इन्दो सूक्ताय वचसे वयो धा यूयं पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
9.90.e: Thus like a wise and potent King flow onward, destroying with thy vigour all misfortunes.  For our well-spoken hymn give life, O Indu. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

9.91.d: असर्जि वक्वा रथ्ये यथाजौ धिया मनोता परथमो मनीषी | दश सवसारो अधि सानो अव्ये.अजन्ति वह्निं सदनान्यछ ||
9.91.e: As for a chariot-race, the skilful Speaker, Chief, Sage, Inventor, hath, with song, been started.  The sisters ten upon the fleecy summit drive on the Car-horse to the resting places.

9.91.d: वीती जनस्य दिव्यस्य कव्यैरधि सुवानो नहुष्येभिरिन्दुः | पर यो नर्भिरम्र्तो मर्त्येभिर्मर्म्र्जानो.अविभिर्गोभिरद्भिः ||
9.91.e: The drop of Soma, pressed by wise Nahusyas, becomes the banquet of the Heavenly People-  Indu, by hands of mortal men made beauteous, immortal, with the sheep and cows and waters.

9.91.d: वर्षा वर्ष्ने रोरुवदंशुरस्मै पवमानो रुशदीर्ते पयोगोः | सहस्रं रक्वा पथिभिर्वचोविदध्वस्मभिः सूरो अण्वं वि याति ||
9.91.e: Steer roaring unto Steer, this Pavamana, this juice runs to the white milk of the milch-cow.  Through thousand fine hairs goes the tuneful Singer, like Sūra by his fair and open pathways.

9.91.d: रुजा दर्ळ्हा चिद रक्षसः सदांसि पुनान इन्द ऊर्णुहि विवाजान | वर्श्चोपरिष्टात तुजता वधेन ये अन्ति दूरादुपनायमेषाम ||
9.91.e: Break down the, strong seats even of the demons: cleansing thee, Indu, robd thyself in vigour.  Rend with thy swift bolt, coming from above them, those who are near and those who yet are distant.

9.91.d: स परत्नवन नव्यसे विश्ववार सूक्ताय पथः कर्णुहि पराचः | ये दुःषहासो वनुषा बर्हन्तस्तांस्ते अश्याम पुरुक्र्त पुरुक्षो ||
9.91.e: Prepare the forward paths in ancient manner for the new bymn, thou Giver of all bounties.  Those which are high and hard for foes to conquer may we gain from thee, Active! Food-bestower!

9.91.d: एवा पुनानो अपः सवर्गा अस्मभ्यं तोका तनयानि भूरि | शं नः कषेत्रमुरु जयोतींषि सोम जयों नः सूर्यन्द्र्शये रिरीहि ||
9.91.e: So purifying thee vouchsafe us waters, heaven's light, and cows, offipring and many children.  Give us health, ample land, and lights, O Soma, and grant us long to look upon the sunshine.

9.92.d: परि सुवानो हरिरंशुः पवित्रे रथो न सर्जि सनये हियानः | आपच्छ्लोकमिन्द्रियं पूयमानः परति देवानजुषत परयोभिः ||
9.92.e: THE gold-hued juice, poured out upon the filter, is started like a car sent forth to conquer.  He hath gained song and vigour while they cleansed him, and hath rejoiced the Gods with entertainments.

9.92.d: अछा नर्चक्षा असरत पवित्रे नाम दधानः कविरस्य योनौ | सीदन होतेव सदने चमूषूपेमग्मन्न्र्षयः सप्त विप्राः ||
9.92.e: He who beholdeth man hath reached the filter: bearing his name, the Sage hath sought his dwelling.  The Ṛṣis came to him, seven holy singers, when in the bowls he settled as Invoker.

9.92.d: पर सुमेधा गातुविद विश्वदेवः सोमः पुनानः सद एति नित्यम | भुवद विश्वेषु काव्येषु रन्तानु जनान यतते पञ्च धीरः ||
9.92.e: Shared by all Gods, mobt wise, propitious, Soma goes, while they cleanse him, to his constant station.  Let him rejoice in all his lofty wisdom to the Five Tribes the Sage attains with labour.

9.92.d: तव तये सोम पवमान निण्ये विश्वे देवास्त्रय एकादशासः | दश सवधाभिरधि सानो अव्ये मर्जन्ति तवा नद्यः सप्त यह्वीः ||
9.92.e: In thy mysterious place, O Pavamana Soma, are all the Gods, the Thrice-Eleven.  Ten on the fleecy height, themselves, self-prompted, and seven fresh rivers, brighten and adorn thee.

9.92.d: तन नु सत्यं पवमानस्यास्तु यत्र विश्वे कारवः संनसन्त | जयोतिर्यदह्ने अक्र्णोदु लोकं परावन मनुं दस्यवे करभीकम ||
9.92.e: Now let this be the truth of Pavamana, there where all singers gather them together,  That he hath given us room and made the daylight, hath holpen Manu and repelled the Dasyu.

9.92.d: परि सद्मेव पशुमान्ति होता राजा न सत्यः समितीरियानः | सोमः पुनानः कलशानयासीत सीदन मर्गो न महिषो वनेषु ||
9.92.e: As the priest seeks the station rich in cattle, like a true King who goes to great assemblies,  Soma hath sought the beakers while they cleansed him, and like a wild bull, in the wood hath settled.

9.93.d: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त सवसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः | हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य दरोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी ||
9.93.e: TEN sisters, pouring out the rain together, swift-moving thinkers of the sage, adorn him.  Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Sūrya and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.

9.93.d: सं मात्र्भिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वर्षा दधन्वे पुरुवारोद्भिः | मर्यो न योषामभि निष्क्र्तं यन सं गछते कलश उस्रियाभिः ||
9.93.e: Even as a youngling crying to his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along to waters.  As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the. chose meeting-place, the beaker.

9.93.d: उत पर पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः | मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि शरीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः ||
9.93.e: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow: thither in streams goes very sapient Indu.  The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the Head and Chief with milk within the vessels.

9.93.d: स नो देवेभिः पवमान रदेन्दो रयिमश्विनं वावशानः | रथिरायतामुशती पुरन्धिरस्मद्र्यगा दावने वसूनाम ||
9.93.e: With all the Gods, O Indu Pavamana, while thou art roaring send us wealth in horses.  Hither upon her car come willing Plenty, inclined to us, to give us of her treasures.

9.93.d: नू नो रयिमुप मास्व नर्वन्तं पुनानो वाताप्यं विश्वश्चन्द्रम | पर वन्दितुरिन्दो तार्यायुः परातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात ||
9.93.e: Now unto us mete riches, while they cleansethee, all-glorious, swelling wealth, with store of heroes.  Long be his life who worships, thee, O Indu. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

9.94.d: अधि यदस्मिन वाजिनीव शुभ सपर्धन्ते धियः सूर्ये नविशः | अपो वर्णानः पवते कवीयन वरजं न पशुवर्धनाय मन्म ||
9.94.e: WHEN beauties strive for him as for a charger, then strive the songs like soldiers for the sunlight.  Acting the Sage, he flows enrobed in waters and song as ’twere a stall that kine may prosper.

9.94.d: दविता वयूर्ण्वन्नम्र्तस्य धाम सवर्विदे भुवनानि परथन्त | धियः पिन्वानाः सवसरे न गाव रतायन्तीरभि वावश्र इन्दुम ||
9.94.e: The worlds expand to hirn who from aforetime found light to spread the law of life eternal.  The swelling songs, like kine within the stable, in deep devotion call aloud on Indu.

9.94.d: परि यत कविः काव्या भरते शूरो न रथो भुवनानि विश्वा | देवेषु यशो मर्ताय भूषन दक्षाय रायः पुरुभूषु नव्यः ||
9.94.e: When the sage bears his holy wisdom round him, like a car visiting all worlds, the Hero,  Becoming fame, mid Gods, unto the mortal, wealth to the skilled, worth praise mid the Ever-present,

9.94.d: शरिये जातः शरिय आ निरियाय शरियं वयो जरित्र्भ्यो दधाति | शरियं वसाना अम्र्तत्वमायन भवन्ति सत्या समिथा मितद्रौ ||
9.94.e: For glory born be hath come forth to glory: he giveth life and glory to the singers.  They, clothed in glory, have become immortal. He, measured in his course, makes frays successful.

9.94.d: इषमूर्जमभ्यर्षाश्वं गामुरु जयोतिः कर्णुहि मत्सि देवान | विश्वानि हि सुषहा तानि तुभ्यं पवमान बाधसेसोम शत्रून ||
9.94.e: Stream to us food and vigour, kine and horses: give us broad lights and fill thGods with rapture.  All ther are easy things for thee to master thou, Pavamana Soma, quellest foemen.

9.95.d: कनिक्रन्ति हरिरा सर्ज्यमानः सीदन वनस्य जठरे पुनानः | नर्भिर्यतः कर्णुते निर्णिजं गा अतो मतीर्जनयतस्वधाभिः ||
9.95.e: Loud neighs the Tawny Steed when started, settling deep in the wooden vessel while they cleanse him.  Led by the men he takes the milk for raiment: then shall he, through his powers, engender praise-songs.

9.95.d: हरिः सर्जानः पथ्यां रतस्येयर्ति वाचमरितेव नावम | देवो देवानां गुह्यानि नामाविष कर्णोति बर्हिषि परवाचे ||
9.95.e: As one who rows drives on his boat, he, Gold-hued, sends forth his voice, loosed on the path of Order.  As God, the secret names of Gods he utters, to be declared on sacred grass more widely.

9.95.d: अपामिवेदूर्मयस्तर्तुराणाः पर मनीषा ईरते सोममछ | नमस्यन्तीरुप च यन्ति सं चा च विशन्त्युशतीरुशन्तम ||
9.95.e: Hastening onward like the waves of waters, our holy hymns are pressing nigh to Soma.  To him they come with lowly adoration, and, longing, enter him who longs to meet them.

9.95.d: तं मर्म्र्जानं महिषं न सानावंशुं दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम | तं वावशानं मतयः सचन्ते तरितो बिभर्ति वरुणं समुद्रे ||
9.95.e: They drain the stalk, the Steer who dwells on mountains, even as a Bull who decks him on the upland.  Hymns follow and attend him as he bellows: Trita bears Varuṇa aloft in ocean.

9.95.d: इष्यन वाचमुपवक्तेव होतुः पुनान इन्दो वि षया मनीषाम | इन्द्रश्च यत कषयथः सौभगाय सुवीर्यस्य पतयःस्याम ||
9.95.e: Sending thy voice out as Director, loosen the Invoker's thought, O Indu, as they cleanse thee.  While thou and Indra rule for our advantage, may we be masters of heroic vigour.

9.96.d: पर सेनानीः शूरो अग्रे रथानां गव्यन्नेति हर्षते अस्य सेना | भद्रान कर्ण्वन्निन्द्रहवान सखिभ्य आ सोमो वस्त्रा रभसानि दत्ते ||
9.96.e: IN forefront of the cars forth goes the Hero, the Leader, winning spoil: his host rejoices.  Soma endues his robes of lasting colours, and blesses, for his friends, their calls on Indra.

9.96.d: समस्य हरिं हरयो मर्जन्त्यश्वहयैरनिशितं नमोभिः | आ तिष्ठति रथमिन्द्रस्य सखा विद्वानेना सुमतिं यात्यछ ||
9.96.e: Men decked with gold adorn his golden tendril, incessantly with steed-impelling homage.  The Friend of Indra mounts his car well-knowing, he comes thereon to meet the prayer we offer.

9.96.d: स नो देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम पसरस इन्द्रपानः | कर्ण्वन्नपो वर्षयन दयामुतेमामुरोरा नो वरिवस्या पुनानः ||
9.96.e: O God, for service of the Gods flow onward, for food sublime, as Indra's drink, O Soma.  Making the floods, bedewing earth and heaven, come from the vast, comfort us while we cleanse thee

9.96.d: अजीतये.अहतये पवस्व सवस्तये सर्वतातये बर्हते | तदुशन्ति विश्व इमे सखायस्तदहं वश्मि पवमान सोम ||
9.96.e: Flow for prosperity and constant Vigour, flow on for happiness and high perfection.  This is the wish of these friends assembled: this is my wish, O Soma Pavamana.

9.96.d: सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पर्थिव्याः | जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः ||
9.96.e: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward the Father of the earth, Father of heaven:  Father of Agni, Sūrya's generator, the Father who begat Indra and Viṣṇu.

9.96.d: बरह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनां रषिर्विप्राणां महिषोम्र्गाणाम | शयेनो गर्ध्राणां सवधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन ||
9.96.e: Brahman of Gods, the Leader of the poets, Ṛṣi of sages, Bull of savage creatures,  Falcon amid the vultures, Axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.

9.96.d: परावीविपद वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिरः सोमः पवमानोमनीषाः | अन्तः पश्यन वर्जनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वर्षभो गोषु जानन ||
9.96.e: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises.  Beholding these inferior powers in cattle, he rests among them as a Steer well-knowing.

9.96.d: स मत्सरः पर्त्सु वन्वन्नवातः सहस्ररेता अभि वाजमर्ष | इन्द्रायेन्दो पवमानो मनीष्यंशोरूर्मिमीरय गा इषण्यन ||
9.96.e: As Gladdener, Warrior never harmed in battle, with thousand genial streams, pour strength and vigour.  As thoughtful Pavamana, urge O Indu, speeding the kine, the plant's wave on to Indra.

9.96.d: परि परियः कलशे देववात इन्द्राय सोमो रण्यो मदाय | सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुर्वाजी न सप्तिः समना जिगाति ||
9.96.e: Dear, grateful to the Gods, on to the beaker moves Soma, sweet to Indra, to delight him.  With hundred powers, with thousand currents, Indu, like a strong car-horse, goes to the assembly.

9.96.d: स पूर्व्यो वसुविज्जायमानो मर्जानो अप्सु दुदुहानो अद्रौ | अभिशस्तिपा भुवनस्य राजा विदद गातुं बरह्मणे पूयमानः ||
9.96.e: Born in old time as finder-out of treasures, drained with the stone, decking himself in waters,  Warding off curses, King of all existence, he shall find way for prayer the while they cleanse him.

9.96.d: तवया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमानधीराः | वन्वन्नवातः परिधीन्रपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः ||
9.96.e: For our sage fathers, Soma Pavamana, of old performed, by thee, their sacred duties.  Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

9.96.d: यथापवथा मनवे वयोधा अमित्रहा वरिवोविद धविष्मान | एवा पवस्व दरविणं दधान इन्द्रे सं तिष्ठ जनयायुधानि ||
9.96.e: As thou didst flow for Manu Life-bestowing, Foe-queller, Comforter, rich in oblations,  Even thus flow onward now conferring riches: combine with Indra, and bring forth thy weapons.

9.96.d: पवस्व सोम मधुमान रतावापो वसानो अधि सानो अव्ये | अव दरोणानि घर्तवान्ति सीद मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रपानः ||
9.96.e: Flow onward, Soma, rich in sweets and holy,. enrobed in waters on the fleecy summit.  Settle in vessels that are full of fatness, as cheering and most gladdening drink for Indra.

9.96.d: वर्ष्टिं दिवः शतधारः पवस्व सहस्रसा वाजयुर्देववीतौ | सं सिन्धुभिः कलशे वावशानः समुस्रियाभिःप्रतिरन न आयुः ||
9.96.e: Pour, hundred-streamed, winner of thousands, mighty at the Gods’ banquet, Pour the rain of heaven,  While thou with rivers roarest in the beaker, and blent with milk prolongest our existence.

9.96.d: एष सय सोमो मतिभिः पुनानो.अत्यो न वाजी तरतीदरातीः | पयो न दुग्धमदितेरिषिरमुर्विव गातुः सुयमोन वोळहा ||
9.96.e: Purified with our holy hymns, this Soma o’ertakes malignities like some strong charger,  Like fresh milk poured by Aditi, like passage in ample room, or like a docile car-horse.

9.96.d: सवायुधः सोत्र्भिः पूयमानो.अभ्यर्ष गुह्यं चारु नाम | अभि वाजं सप्तिरिव शरवस्याभि वायुमभि गा देवसोम ||
9.96.e: Cleansed by the pressers, armed with noble weapons, stream to us the fair secret name thou bearest.  Pour booty, like a horse, for love of glory God, Soma, send us kine, and send us Vāyu.

9.96.d: शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मर्जन्ति शुम्भन्ति वह्निं मरुतो गणेन | कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन ||
9.96.e: They deck him at his birth, the lovely Infant, the Maruts with their troop adorn the Car-horse.  By songs a Poet and a Sage by wisdom, Soma joes singing through the cleansing filter.

9.96.d: रषिमना य रषिक्र्त सवर्षाः सहस्रणीथः पदवीः कवीनाम | तर्तीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन सोमो विराजमनुराजति षटुप ||
9.96.e: Light-winner, Ṛṣi-mindcd, Ṛṣi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, Leader of sages,  A Steer who strives to gain his third form, Soma is, like Virāj, resplendent as a Singer.

9.96.d: चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभ्र्त्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानिबिभ्रत | अपामूर्मिं सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाममहिषो विवक्ति ||
9.96.e: Hawk seated in the bowls, Bird wide-extended, the Banner seeking kine and wielding weapons,  Following close the sea, the wave of waters, the great Bull tells his fourth form and declares it.

9.96.d: मर्यो न शुभ्रस्तन्वं मर्जानो.अत्यो न सर्त्वा सनये धनानाम | वर्षेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षन कनिक्रदच्चम्वोराविवेश ||
9.96.e: Like a fair youth who decorates his body, a courser rushing to the gain of riches,  A steer to herds, so, flowing to the pitcher, he with a roar hath passed into the beakers.

9.96.d: पवस्वेन्दो पवमानो महोभिः कनिक्रदत परि वाराण्यर्ष | करीळञ्चम्वोरा विश पूयमान इन्द्रं ते रसो मदिरो ममत्तु ||
9.96.e: Flow on with might as Pavamana, Indu flow loudly roaring through the fleecy filter.  Enter the beakers sporting, as they cleanse thee, and let thy gladdening juice make Indra joyful.

9.96.d: परास्य धारा बर्हतीरस्र्ग्रन्नक्तो गोभिः कलशाना विवेश | साम कर्ण्वन सामन्यो विपश्चित करन्दन्नेत्यभि सख्युर्न जामिम ||
9.96.e: His streams have been effused in all their fulness, and he hath entered, balmed with milk, the goblets.  Singing his psalm, well-skilled in song, a Chanter, be comes as ’twere to his friend's sister roaring.

9.96.d: अपघ्नन्नेषि पवमान शत्रून परियां न जारो अभिगीत इन्दुः | सीदन वनेषु शकुनो न पत्वा सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सत्ता ||
9.96.e: Chasing our foes thou comest, Pavamana Indu, besting, as lover to his darling.  As a bird flies and settles in the forest, thus Soma settles, purified, in goblets.

9.96.d: आ ते रुचः पवमानस्य सोम योषेव यन्ति सुदुघाः सुधाराः | हरिरानीतः पुरुवारो अप्स्वचिक्रदत कलशे देवयूनाम ||
9.96.e: With full stream and abundant milk, O Soma, thy beams come, like a woman, as they cleanse thee.  He, gold-hued, rich in boons, brought to the waters, hath roared within the goblet of the pious.

9.97.d: अस्य परेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समप्र्क्त रसम | सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन मितेव सद्म पशुमान्ति होता ||
9.97.e: MADE pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse the God hath to the Gods his juice imparted.  He goes, effused and singing, to the filter, like priest to measured seats supplied with cattle.

9.97.d: भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या वसानो महान कविर्निवचनानि शंसन | आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जाग्र्विर्देववीतौ ||
9.97.e: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in battle, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations.  Roll onward to the beakers as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods, and watchful.

9.97.d: समु परियो मर्ज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां कषैतो अस्मे | अभि सवर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
9.97.e: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a Prince among us, nobler than the noble.  Roar out as thou art purified, run forward. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

9.97.d: पर गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान सोमं हिनोत महते धनाय | सवादुः पवाते अति वारमव्यमा सीदाति कलशं देवयुर्नः ||
9.97.e: Let us sing praises to the Gods: sing loudly, send ye the Soma forth for mighty riches.  Let him flow, sweetly-flavoured, through the filter, and let our pious one rest in the pitcher.

9.97.d: इन्दुर्देवानामुप सख्यमायन सहस्रधारः पवते मदाय | नर्भिः सतवानो अनु धाम पूर्वमगन्निन्द्रं महते सौभगाय ||
9.97.e: Winning the friendship of the Deities, Indu flows in a thousand streams to make them joyful.  Praised by the men after the ancient statute, he hath come nigh, for our great bliss, to Indra.

9.97.d: सतोत्रे राये हरिरर्षा पुनान इन्द्रं मदो गछतु ते भराय | देवैर्याहि सरथं राधो अछा यूयं पात सवस्तिभिः सदा नः ||
9.97.e: Flow, Gold-hued, cleansing thee, to enrich the singer: let thy juice go to Indra to support him.  Come nigh, together with the Gods, for bounty. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

9.97.d: पर काव्यमुशनेव बरुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति | महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन ||
9.97.e: The God declares the Deities' generations, like Uśanā, proclaiming lofty wisdom.  With brilliant kin, far-ruling, sanctifying, the Boar advances, singing, to the places.

9.97.d: पर हंसासस्त्र्पलं मन्युमछामादस्तं वर्षगणा अयासुः | आङगूष्यं पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं साकं परवदन्ति वाणम ||
9.97.e: The Swans, the Vrsaganas from anear us have brought their restless spirit to our dwelling.  Friends come to Pavamana meet for praises, and sound in concert their resistless music.

9.97.d: स रंहत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वर्था करीळन्तं मिमते न गावः | परीणसं कर्णुते तिग्मश्र्ङगो दिवा हरिर्दद्र्शे नक्तं रज्रः ||
9.97.e: He follows the Wide-strider's rapid movement: cows low, as ’twere, to him who sports at pleasure.  He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the Silvery shines by night, by day the Golden.

9.97.d: इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन मदाय | हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातीर्वरिवः कर्ण्वन वर्जनस्य राजा ||
9.97.e: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, to make him joyful.  He quells malignities and slays the demons, the King of mighty power who brings us comfort.

9.97.d: अध धारया मध्वा पर्चानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः | इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय ||
9.97.e: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter-  Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens, for the God's enjoyment.

9.97.d: अभि परियाणि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान सवेन रसेन पर्ञ्चन | इन्दुर्धर्माण्य रतुथा वसानो दश कषिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये ||
9.97.e: As he is purified he pours out treasures, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices.  Indu hath, wearing qualities by seasons, on the raised fleece engaged, the ten swift fingers.

9.97.d: वर्षा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद गा नदयन्नेति पर्थिवीमुत दयाम | इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शर्ण्व आजौ परचेतयन्नर्षति वाचमेमाम ||
9.97.e: The Red Bull bellowing to the kine advances, causing the heavens and earth to roar and tbunder.  Well is he beard like Indra's shout in battle: letting this voice be known he hastens hither.

9.97.d: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमंशुम | पवमानः सन्तनिमेषि कर्ण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः ||
9.97.e: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet flavours, urging the meath-rich plant thou goest onward.  Raising a shout thou flowest as they cleanse thee, when thou, O Soma, art effused for Indra.

9.97.d: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन वधस्नैः | परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः ||
9.97.e: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, aiming deatb-shafts at him who stays the waters,  Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine, O Soma.

9.97.d: जुष्ट्वी न इन्दो सुपथा सुगान्युरौ पवस्व वरिवांसि कर्ण्वन | घनेव विष्वग दुरितानि विघ्नन्नधि षणुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ||
9.97.e: Pleased with us, Indu, send us as thou flowest good easy paths in ample space and comforts.  Dispelling, as ’twere with a club, misfortunes, run o’er the height, run o’er the fleecy summit.

9.97.d: वर्ष्टिं नो अर्ष दिव्यां जिगत्नुमिळावतीं शंगयीं जीरदानुम | सतुकेव वीता धन्वा विचिन्वन बन्धून्रिमानवरानिन्दो वायून ||
9.97.e: Pour on us rain celestial, quickly streaming, refreshing, fraught with health and ready bounty.  Flow, Indu, send these Winds thy lower kinsmen, setting them free like locks of hair unbraided.

9.97.d: गरन्थिं न वि षय गरथितं पुनान रजुं च गातुं वर्जिनं च सोम | अत्यो न करदो हरिरा सर्जानो मर्यो देव धन्व पस्त्यावान ||
9.97.e: Part, like a knotted tangle, while they cleanse thee, O Soma, righteous and unrighteous conduct.  Neigh like a tawny courser who is loosened, come like a youth, O God, a house-possessor.

9.97.d: जुष्टो मदाय देवतात इन्दो परि षणुना धन्व सानो अव्ये | सहस्रधारः सुरभिरदब्धः परि सरव वाजसातौ नर्षह्ये ||
9.97.e: For the God's service, for delight, O Indu, run o’er the height, run o'ver the fleecy summit.  With thousand streams, inviolate, sweet-scented, flow on for gain of strength that conquers heroes.

9.97.d: अरश्मानो ये.अरथा अयुक्ता अत्यासो न सस्र्जानास आजौ | एते शुक्रासो धन्वन्ति सोमा देवासस्तानुप याता पिबध्यै ||
9.97.e: Without a car, without a rein to guide them, unyoked, like coursers started in the contest,  These brilliant drops of Soma juice run forward. Do ye, O Deities, come nigh to drink them.

9.97.d: एवा न इन्दो अभि देववीतिं परि सरव नभो अर्णश्चमूषु | सोमो अस्मभ्यं काम्यं बर्हन्तं रयिं ददातु वीरवन्तमुग्रम ||
9.97.e: So for our banquet of the Gods, O Indu, pour down the rain of heaven into the vessels.  May Soma grant us riches sought with longing, mighty, exceeding strong, with store of heroes.

9.97.d: तक्षद यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग जयेष्ठस्य वा धर्मणि कषोरनीके | आदीमायन वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इन्दुम ||
9.97.e: What time the loving spirit's word had formed him Chief of all food, by statute of the Highest,  Then loudly lowing came the cows to Indu, the chosen, well-loved Master in the beaker.

9.97.d: पर दानुदो दिव्यो दानुपिन्व रतं रताय पवते सुमेधाः | धर्मा भुवद वर्जन्यस्य राजा पर रश्मिभिर्दशभिर्भारि भूम ||
9.97.e: The Sage, Celestial, liberal, raining bounties, pours as he flows the Genuine for the Truthful.  The King shall be effectual strength's upholder: he by the ten bright reins is mostly guided.

9.97.d: पवित्रेभिः पवमानो नर्चक्षा राजा देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम | दविता भुवद रयिपती रयीणां रतं भरत सुभ्र्तं चार्विन्दुः ||
9.97.e: He who beholds mankind, made pure with filters, the King supreme of Deities and mortals,  From days of old is Treasure-Lord of riches: he, Indu, cherishes fair well-kept Order.

9.97.d: अर्वानिव शरवसे सातिमछेन्द्रस्य वायोरभि वीतिमर्ष | स नः सहस्रा बर्हतीरिषो दा भवा सोम दरविणोवित पुनानः ||
9.97.e: Haste, like a steed, to vittory for glory, to Indra's and to Vāyu's entertainment.  Give us food ample, thousandfold: be, Soma, the finder-out of riches when they cleanse thee.

9.97.d: देवाव्यो नः परिषिच्यमानाः कषयं सुवीरं धन्वन्तु सोमाः | आयज्यवः सुमतिं विश्ववारा होतारो न दिवियजो मन्द्रतमाः ||
9.97.e: Effused by us let God-delighting Somas bring as they flow a home with noble heroes.  Rich in all boons like priests acquiring favour, the worshippers of heaven, the best of Cheerers.

9.97.d: एवा देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम पसरसे देवपानः | महश्चिद धि षमसि हिताः समर्ये कर्धि सुष्ठाने रोदसी पुनानः ||
9.97.e: So, God, for service of the Gods flow onward, flow, drink of Gods, for ample food, O Soma.  For we go forth to war against the mighty make heaven and earth well stablished by thy cleansing.

9.97.d: अश्वो नो करदो वर्षभिर्युजानः सिंहो न भीमो मनसो जवीयान | अर्वाचीनैः पथिभिर्ये रजिष्ठा आ पवस्व सौमनसं न इन्दो ||
9.97.e: Thou, yoked by strong men, neighest like a courser, swifter than thought is, like an awful lion.  By paths directed hitherward, the straightest, send thou us happiness, Indu, while they cleanse thee.

9.97.d: शतं धारा देवजाता अस्र्ग्रन सहस्रमेनाः कवयो मर्जन्ति | इन्दो सनित्रं दिव आ पवस्व पुरेतासि महतो धनस्य ||
9.97.e: Sprung from the Gods, a hundred streams, a thousand, have been effused: sages prepare and purge them.  Bring us from heaven the means of winnning, Indu; thou art-forerunnner of abundant riches.

9.97.d: दिवो न सर्गा असस्र्ग्रमह्नां राजा न मित्रं पर मिनातिधीरः | पितुर्न पुत्रः करतुभिर्यतान आ पवस्व विशेस्या अजीतिम ||
9.97.e: The streams of days, were poured as ’twere from heaven: the wise King doth not treat his friend unkindly.  Like a son following his father's wishes, grant to this family success and safety.

9.97.d: पर ते धारा मधुमतीरस्र्ग्रन वारान यत पूतो अत्येष्यव्यान | पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जज्ञानः सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः ||
9.97.e: Now are thy streams poured forth with all their sweetness, when, purified. thou goest through the filter.  The race of kine is thy gift, Pavarridna: when born thou madest Sūrya rich with brightness.

9.97.d: कनिक्रददनु पन्थां रतस्य शुक्रो वि भास्यम्र्तस्य धाम | स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरवान हिन्वानो वाचं मतिभिः कवीनाम ||
9.97.e: Bright, bellowing aiong the path of Order, thou shinest as the form of life eternal.  Thou flowest on as gladdening drink for Indra, sending thy voice out with the hymns of sages.

9.97.d: दिव्यः सुपर्णो.अव चक्षि सोम पिन्वन धाराः कर्मणा देववीतौ | एन्दो विश कलशं सोमधानं करन्दन्निहि सूर्यस्योप रश्मिम ||
9.97.e: Pouring out streams at the Gods’ feast with service, thou, Soma, lookest down, a heavenly Eagle.  Enter the Soma-holding beaker, Indu, and with a roar approach the ray of Sarya.

9.97.d: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति पर वह्निरतस्य धीतिं बरह्मणो मनीषाम | गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पर्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः ||
9.97.e: Three are the voices that the Courser utters: he speaks the thought of prayer, the law of Order.  To the Cow's Master come the Cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.

9.97.d: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पर्छमानाः | सोमः सुतः पूयते अज्यमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभिः सं नवन्ते ||
9.97.e: To Soma come the Cows, the Milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hvmns inquiring.  Soma, effused, is purified and blended our hymns and Tṛṣṭup songs unite in Soma.

9.97.d: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः सवस्ति | इन्द्रमा विश बर्हता रवेण वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरन्धिम ||
9.97.e: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified flow for our welfare.  Pass into Indra with a mighty roaring make the voice swell, and generate abundance.

9.97.d: आ जाग्र्विर्विप्र रता मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु | सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः ||
9.97.e: Singer of true songs, ever-watchful, Soma hath settled in the ladles when they cleanse him.  Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.

9.97.d: स पुनान उप सूरे न धातोभे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः | परिया चिद यस्य परियसास ऊती स तू धनं कारिणेन पर यंसत ||
9.97.e: Cleansed near the Sun as ’twere he as Creator hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them.  He by whose dear help men gain all their wishes shall yield the precious meed as to a victor.

9.97.d: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वानभि नो जयोतिषावीत | येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः सवर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमुष्णन ||
9.97.e: He, being cleansed, the Strengthener and Increaser, Soma the Bounteous, helped us with his lustre,  Wherewith our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and stole the cattle from the mountain.

9.97.d: अक्रान समुद्रः परथमे विधर्मञ जनयन परजा भुवनस्यराजा | वर्षा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बर्हत सोमो वाव्र्धे सुवान इन्दुः ||
9.97.e: In the first vault of heaven loud roared the Ocean, King of all being, generating creatures.  Steer, in the filter, on the fleecy summit, Soma, the Drop effused, hath waxen mighty.

9.97.d: महत तत सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद गर्भो.अव्र्णीत देवान | अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजो.अजनयत सूर्ये जयोतिरिन्दुः ||
9.97.e: Soma the Steer, in that as Child of Waters he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement.  He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra; he, Indu, generated light in Sūrya.

9.97.d: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः | मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान मत्सि दयावाप्र्थिवी देव सोम ||
9.97.e: Make Vāyu glad,, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuṇa and Mitra, as they cleanse thee.  Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma.

9.97.d: रजुः पवस्व वर्जिनस्य हन्तापामीवां बाधमानो मर्धश्च | अभिश्रीणन पयः पयसाभि गोनामिन्द्रस्य तवं तव वयं सखायः ||
9.97.e: Flow onward righteous slayer of the wicked, driving away our enemies and sickness,  Blending thy milk with milk which cows afford us. We are thy friends, thou art the Friend of Indra.

9.97.d: मध्वः सूदं पवस्व वस्व उत्सं वीरं च न आ पवस्वा भगं च | सवदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान इन्दो रयिं च न आ पवस्वा समुद्रात ||
9.97.e: Pour us a fount of meath, a spring of treasure; send us a hero son and happy fortune.  Be sweet to India when they cleanse thee, Indu, and pour down riches on us from the ocean.

9.97.d: सोमः सुतो धारयात्यो न हित्वा सिन्धुर्न निम्नमभि वाज्यक्षाः | आ योनिं वन्यमसदत पुनानः समिन्दुर्गोभिरसरत समद्भिः ||
9.97.e: Strong Soma, pressed, like an impetuous courser, hath flowed in stream as a flood speeding downward.  Cleansed, he hath settled in his wooden dwelling: Indu hath flowed with milk and with the waters.

9.97.d: एष सय ते पवत इन्द्र सोमश्चमूषु धीर उशते तवस्वान | सवर्चक्षा रथिरः सत्यशुष्मः कामो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ||
9.97.e: Strong, wise, for thee who longest for his coming this Soma here flows to the bowls, O Indra.  He, chariot-borne, sun-bright, and truly potent, was poured forth like the longing of the pious.

9.97.d: एष परत्नेन वयसा पुनानस्तिरो वर्पांसि दुहितुर्दधानः | वसानः शर्म तरिवरूथमप्सु होतेव याति समनेषुरेभन ||
9.97.e: He, purified with ancient vital vigour, pervading all his Daughter's forms and figures,  Finding his threefold refuge in the waters, goes singing, as a priest, to the assemblies.

9.97.d: नू नस्त्वं रथिरो देव सोम परि सरव चम्वोः पूयमानः | अप्सु सवादिष्ठो मधुमान रतावा देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा ||
9.97.e: Now, chariot-borne, flow unto us, God Soma, as thou art purified flow to the saucers,  Sweetest in waters, rich in meath, and holy, as Savitar the God is, truthfulminded.

9.97.d: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गर्णानो.अभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः | अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वर्षणं वज्रबाहुम ||
9.97.e: To feast him, flow mid song and hymn, to Vāyu, flow purified to Varuṇa and Mitra.  Flow to the song-inspiring car-borne Hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder.

9.97.d: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः | अभि चन्द्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान रथिनो देव सोम ||
9.97.e: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, miIch-kine, abundant yielders.  God Soma, send us chariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden.

9.97.d: अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः | अभि येन दरविणमश्नवामाभ्यर्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः ||
9.97.e: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us, when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth,  So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rsihood in Jamadagni's manner.

9.97.d: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि मांश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि पर धन्व | बरध्नश्चिदत्र वातो न जातः पुरुमेधश्चित तकवे नरं दात ||
9.97.e: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu.  Here, too, the Ruddy, wind-swift, full of wisdom, Shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.

9.97.d: उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि शरुते शरवाय्यस्य तीर्थे | षष्टिं सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वर्क्षं न पक्वं धूनवद रणाय ||
9.97.e: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory.  May the Foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures.

9.97.d: महीमे अस्य वर्षनाम शूषे मांश्चत्वे वा पर्शने वा वधत्रे | अस्वापयन निगुतः सनेहयच्चापामित्रानपाचितो अचेतः ||
9.97.e: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prsana, wrought in battle.  He sent our enemies to sleep and slew thern, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.

9.97.d: सं तरी पवित्रा विततान्येष्यन्वेकं धावसि पूयमानः | असि भगो असि दात्रस्य दातासि मघवा मघवद्भ्य इन्दो ||
9.97.e: Thou comest unto three extended filters, and hasteriest through each one as they cleanse thee.  Thou art the giver of the gift, a Bhaga, a Maghavan for liberal lords, O Indu.

9.97.d: एष विश्ववित पवते मनीषी सोमो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा | दरप्सानीरयन विदथेष्विन्दुर्वि वारमव्यं समयाति याति ||
9.97.e: This Soma here, the Wise, the All-obtainer, flows on his way as King of all existence.  Driving the drops at our assemblies, Indu completely traverses the fleecy filter.

9.97.d: इन्दुं रिहन्ति महिषा अदब्धाः पदे रेभन्ति कवयो न गर्ध्राः | हिन्वन्ति धीरा दशभिः कषिपाभिः समञ्जते रूपमपां रसेन ||
9.97.e: The Great Inviolate are kissing Indu, and singing in his place like eager sages.  The wise men send him forth with ten swift fingers, and balm his form with essence of the waters.

9.97.d: तवया वयं पवमानेन सोम भरे कर्तं वि चिनुयाम शश्वत | तन नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पर्थिवीुत दयौः ||
9.97.e: Soma, may we, with thee as Pavamana, pile up together all our spoil in battle.  This boon vouchsafe us Varuṇa and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

9.98.d: अभि नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष पुरुस्प्र्हम | इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभ्वासहम ||
9.98.e: STREAM on us riches that are sought by many, best at winning strength  Riches, O Indu, thousandfold, glorious, conquering the great.

9.98.d: परि षय सुवानो अव्ययं रथे न वर्माव्यत | इन्दुरभिद्रुणा हितो हियानो धाराभिरक्षाः ||
9.98.e: Effused, he hath, as on a car, invested him in fleecy mail:  Onward hath Indu flowed in streams, impelled, surrounded by the wood.

9.98.d: परि षय सुवानो अक्षा इन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः | धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भराजा नैति गव्ययुः ||
9.98.e: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece:  He goes erect, as seeking kine in stream, with light, to sacrifice.

9.98.d: स हि तवं देव शश्वते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे | इन्दो सहस्रिणं रयिं शतात्मानं विवाससि ||
9.98.e: For thou thyself, O Indu, God, to every mortal worshipper  Attractest riches thousandfold, made manifest in hundred forms.

9.98.d: वयं ते अस्य वर्त्रहन वसो वस्वः पुरुस्प्र्हः | नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः सयाम सुम्नस्याध्रिगो ||
9.98.e: Good Vṛtra-slayer, may we be still nearest to this wealth of thine  Which many crave, nearest to food and happiness, Resistless One!

9.98.d: दविर्यं पञ्च सवयशसं सवसारो अद्रिसंहतम | परियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं परस्नापयन्त्यूर्मिणम ||
9.98.e: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the pair of pressingstones-  The wavy Friend whom Indra loves-the twice-five sisters dip and bathe,

9.98.d: परि तयं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण | यो देवान विश्वानित परि मदेन सह गछति ||
9.98.e: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all,  Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the Deities.

9.98.d: अस्य वो हयवसा पान्तो दक्षसाधनम | यः सूरिषु शरवोब्र्हद दधे सवर्ण हर्यतः ||
9.98.e: Through longing for this sap of yours ye drink what brings ability,  Even him who, dear as heaven's own light, gives to our princes high renown.

9.98.d: स वां यज्ञेषु मानवी इन्दुर्जनिष्ट रोदसी | देवो देवी गिरिष्ठा अस्रेधन तं तुविष्वणि ||
9.98.e: Indu at holy rites produced you, Heaven and Earth, the Friends of men,  Hill-haunting God the Goddesses. They bruised him where the roar was loud.

9.98.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वर्त्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे | नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे ||
9.98.e: For Vṛtra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink,  Poured for the guerdon-giving man, poured for the God who sitteth there.

9.98.d: ते परत्नासो वयुष्टिषु सोमाः पवित्रे अक्षरन | अपप्रोथन्तः सनुतर्हुरश्चितः परातस्तानप्रचेतसः ||
9.98.e: These ancient Somas, at the break of day, have flowed into the sieve,  Snorting away at early morn these foolish evil-hearted ones.

9.98.d: तं सखायः पुरोरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः | अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यम ||
9.98.e: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this Most Resplendent One.  Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength.

9.99.d: आ हर्यताय धर्ष्णवे धनुस्तन्वन्ति पौंस्यम | शुक्रांवयन्त्यसुराय निर्णिजं विपामग्रे महीयुवः ||
9.99.e: THEY for the Bold and Lovely One ply manly vigour like a bow:  joyous, in front of songs they weave bright raiment for the Lord Divine.

9.99.d: अध कषपा परिष्क्र्तो वाजानभि पर गाहते | यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वन्ति यातवे ||
9.99.e: And he, made beautiful by night, dips forward into strengthening food',  What time the sacrificer's thoughts speed on his way the Golden-hued.

9.99.d: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः | यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः ||
9.99.e: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his the juice which Indra chiefly drinks—-  That which kine took into their mouths, of old, and princes take it now.

9.99.d: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत | उतो कर्पन्तधीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः ||
9.99.e: To him, while purifying, they have raised the ancient psalm of praise:  And sacred songs which bear the names of Gods have supplicated him.

9.99.d: तमुक्षमाणमव्यये वारे पुनन्ति धर्णसिम | दूतं न पूर्वचित्तय आ शासते मनीषिणः ||
9.99.e: They purify him as he drops, courageous, in the fleecy sieve.  Him they instruct as messenger to bear the sage's morning prayer.

9.99.d: स पुनानो मदिन्तमः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति | पशौ न रेत आदधत पतिर्वचस्यते धियः ||
9.99.e: Soma, best Cheerer, takes his seat, the while they cleanse him in the bowls.  He as it were impregns the cow, and babbles on, the Lord of Song.

9.99.d: स मर्ज्यते सुकर्मभिर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः | विदे यदासु सन्ददिर्महीरपो वि गाहते ||
9.99.e: He is effused and beautified, a God for Gods, by skilful men.  He penetrates the mighty floods collecting all he knows therein.

9.99.d: सुत इन्दो पवित्र आ नर्भिर्यतो वि नीयसे | इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमश्चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ||
9.99.e: Pressed, Indu, guided by the men, thou art led to the cleaning sieve.  Thou, yielding Indra highest joy, takest thy seat within the bowls.

9.100.d: अभी नवन्ते अद्रुहः परियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम | वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातं रिहन्ति मातरः ||
9.100.e: THE Guileless Ones are singing praise to Indra's well beloved Friend,  As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf.

9.100.d: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम दविबर्हसं रयिम | तवं वसूनिपुष्यसि विश्वानि दाशुषो गर्हे ||
9.100.e: O Indu, while they cleanse thee bring, O Soma, doubly-waxing wealth  Thou in the worshipper's abode causest all treasures to increase.

9.100.d: तवं धियं मनोयुजं सर्जा वर्ष्टिं न तन्यतुः | तवं वसूनि पार्थिवा दिव्या च सोम पुष्यसि ||
9.100.e: Set free the. song which mind hath yoked, even as thunder frees the rain:  All treasures of the earth and heaven, O Soma, thou dost multiply.

9.100.d: परि ते जिग्युषो यथा धारा सुतस्य धावति | रंहमाणाव्यव्ययं वारं वाजीव सानसिः ||
9.100.e: Thy stream when thou art pressed runs on like some victorious warrior's steed  Hastening onward through the fleece like a fierce horse who wins the prize.

9.100.d: करत्वे दक्षाय नः कवे पवस्व सोम धारया | इन्द्राय पातवे सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय च ||
9.100.e: Flow on, Sage Soma, with thy stream to give us mental power and strength,  Effused for Indra, for his drink, for Mitra and for Varuṇa.

9.100.d: पवस्व वाजसातमः पवित्रे धारया सुतः | इन्द्राय सोमविष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः ||
9.100.e: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, best winner, thou, of spoil,  O Soma, as most rich in sweets for Indra, Viṣṇu, and the Gods.

9.100.d: तवां रिहन्ति मातरो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः | वत्सं जातंन धेनवः पवमान विधर्मणि ||
9.100.e: The mothers, void of guiles, caress thee Golden-coloured, in the sieve,  As cows, O Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.

9.100.d: पवमान महि शरवश्चित्रेभिर्यासि रश्मिभिः | शर्धन तमांसि जिघ्नसे विश्वानि दाशुषो गर्हे ||
9.100.e: Thou, Pavamana, movest on with wondrous rays to great renown.  Striving within the votary's house thou drivest all the glooms away.

9.100.d: तवं दयां च महिव्रत पर्थिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे | परति दरापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना ||
9.100.e: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth.  Thou, Pavamana hast assumed thy coat of mail in majesty.
